text: It starts off good. No ads, which means the user is the product. It quickly builds and is not quite 'enough' without some purchases. Bonuses and 'cheats' are essential to progress. The 'candy crush' element of the game is what ruins it. The levels soon reach a degree of difficulty where you just turn off for failing all the time. More cheats need to be purchased. Then you use them all but still spend half a day on a level which is practically unbeatable, it all becomes pointless. Uninstalling.

This game used to be a lot of fun. You could build a great town & zoo, play the regatta with your team & there were mini games & challenges. Game cash cost real money, but could also be won. I spent a regular small amount to buy game cash & had fun trying to win it & do well in the challenges. Then the game devs sold it. Since then the buyer has turned it into a cash cow. The game is being changed to make it too difficult to play without spending money. It's no fun any more. It's spoiled.

A really frustrating game which is so inconsistent, Match 3 doesn't give you the same specials. Level 80 doesn't work, nothing turns green and too easy to "buy" extra lives when you are trying to exit the screen. There's also no support function, asks for a screenshot but if you haven't already taken it you don't have any option but to exit the chat which is hard enough to find anyway.

It is very addictive 😍 a lot of fun when competing in competitions. I've joined family members in so we have lots of fun together. After having a bit of a problem with the game, the new update has worked fine. Enjoying playing it again. Problems again.... since the new update, my payment card hasn't worked. So, no in-game purchases anymore. At least I'm saving money!!

Enjoyed this game for a number of years. But a few things that have changed and annoyed me. 1. Chat function has stopped working says not allowed in this region. no idea why its stopped working. 2. on builds for city and zoo, they require large amounts of materials which also needed to exchange at the tool station. it takes months to build anything, which makes you not bother or lose interest. I have at least 12 animals that cannot be housed as I cannot build the enclosures.

ads are a lie, like all these mobile games. in the end its a farmville type game, but building a town instead of one farm. You're forced to make items in factories that take hours, just so you can fulfill orders, or have enough resources to finish building something. You're also locked behind a tiny warehouse to store goods, that only expands a fraction with in game currency that comes to you extremely slowly and in a small amount. Said currency is conveniently available to buy with real money.

I liked this game until they got greedy. Clearly have changed the algorithm on the puzzle game as 8 times out of 10 only once piece remains. 1000 town bucks is 1.79 pounds. its 900 to carry on if you fail the level. it fails often especially after getting the special feature. Bigger packs = more they can rip you off for, its a shame as they have ruined a desire to play this through obvious greed.

Great game with some other in game games, so plenty to keep you entertained. I love that there are no ads! There's the option for in-app purchases but you don't really need these. Once you join a team everyone helps each other which is fantastic, however, until recently there was a chat available for use within your team so you could thank team members, but for some reason that doesn't now appear to be available in our 'region' which is a bit annoying - for that reason I've deducted a star!

I enjoy this game but I have to only give it two stars. It is really only a money collecting grift. Once you get to a certain level you are constantly surrounded by pay walls to advance the game at a decent pace. Otherwise be prepared for a very slow advance through the game. In the side games energy runs out too quickly and you have to either wait or buy more.

Initially rated 5 stars because I used to love this game. Its got more than enough to do to keep you busy and interested. It's so easy to lose hours while playing and you can do almost everything without paying a penny. I do recommend downloading it and giving it a go. So why have I knocked it down to 3 stars. The game advertised is NOT the game you get to play. That is so misleading, there should be penalties when developers do that. To the developers... where can I get the other game???

The game keeps saying there are new features on the friend section. It won't let you open anything else but when you click on the screen to see these "new features" it locks out, freezing everything. You can't get back in without coming out of the game and clearing your phone. It then goes back several steps to where you were when the "update" happened. Very annoying!

Fun early on until you hit the wall of no in game dollars, leaving no way to progress without paying. Match 3 games also earn tiny amounts of the blue lightning needed to break hundreds of obstacles, meaning that part of the game is also very slow. Note, I've uninstalled now, as the match 3 difficulty has been ramped up, and you can't progress without buying packs. The hard and super hard levels are always placed to break any progress streak, so you can't unlock cards, or win the mini games

I'm changing my rate to 1 star and considering to delete this game. Even spending money it takes weeks to pass a level, days to build a house or expand, months to build a community building, hours to produce simple products... you spend all your energy on 2 obstacles on the adventure game...It's absolutely ridiculous!!! And it's a shame, because it's a very good game and relaxing.

Used to really love the game, didn't mind slow progress, loved it had the two sides and happy to pay. I fact only game I pay to buy bits and pieces. But the new upgrade and change in cash structure it's cost £10+ just to pass one of the match 3 games. Suddenly my barn capacity has gone from 340 down to 285 for no reason and I have to pay to get it back up, around £20. Giving it one more week and then I'll uninstall. Won't be putting any more money in

Nothing like what was advertised! The ad made it look fun and cute, but in reality, it's completely different. FALSE ADVERTISING! UPDATE-June 2nd 2026 So after trying this game again I'm quite enjoying it. The issue I'm facing atm is when you visit a friend's place l and want to leave the game, it constantly freezes making it impossible to do anything apart from close and reopen the game. It can be frustrating when you don't have enough money and resources.

All a bit of a con. Match 3 game way too difficult, you have to pay to win games. Game not as advertised .... completely different game (don't understand why they do that as main game is good until it becomes about paying to progress. Why lie? Also, since installing on new phone nothing is loading up properly. Glitches everywhere. Will be uninstalling. Shame as it could be a good game (don't mind spending a little) but it's just a cash cow and developers are liars.

I’ve been playing Township for a long time, but recent changes have made it far less enjoyable. Previously, the in-game economy felt fair. For £1.79 you could get 50 notes, and it only cost 10 notes for 5 extra moves. That meant you could get multiple chances to continue playing without spending much. Now, although £1.79 gives 1000 notes, the cost of 5 extra moves has jumped to 900 notes. In real terms, something that used to cost about £0.36 now costs around £1.60. That’s roughly a 4.5× increas

I used to love this game. One of only two games I've every done in-app purchases for. But your recent update and the pricing structure means you have taken the joy out of playing. What was up to 13 "helps" at the end of match-3 is now less than 3 for the same price. Its now totally worthless and I will be stopping playing as a result. Well done for messing it up for those willing to pay to play.

I like the game. It reminds me of Farmville. I wouldn't mind the wait time if I could do something like build in the process. But I have building that'll never get built because I need to spend real money to buy enough fake money for the materials. I'm not gonna do that so basically my town won't grow or will take forever to grow in population. Other games seem to have figured out how to let people play without paying. I end up spending 5 mins in the game before nothing left to do.

I adore this kind of resource management game. The most recent ad you put out though is a complete lie. I have played 12006 levels of this game, and not once encountered what you advertised. The most recent change to how in-game cash works has also made it far harder to achieve anything in the match-3 section of the game. What used to buy you 10 re-tries of a level now barely gets you one, and getting the cash to do it takes far, far longer or more real life money.

The town building is good, but the matching games are absolutely terrible. It's gotten to the point where I don't even play them anymore. It's literally pay to win and it's very irritating. You have to use EVERY power up just to finish a single puzzle. 15 turns to finish a puzzle that has 2 sections, without power ups going in is pointless. Not even remotely worth your time.

I often fall out of love with this game. I love the farming aspect but the match 3 part of the game is infuriating. I'm on level 2141 and I go from one level which takes days to complete to another. These aren't always marked as hard or really hard either. I'm not sure if this is deliberate, but it makes the game feel like you're grinding against the algorithm every time. I've uninstalled this game so many times, and one day I won't go back. I really hope that Playrix read this...

disappointed. they have just removed the chat feature, which I used to communicate with my coop and now we can't help each other or even say good morning and check on each other like we used to. I have written to support and no answer. Also you don't really get a nice experience anymore unless you spend money. There are too many weekly games going on. other than that I really enjoyed playing it and being in touch with my Italian friends. please reinstate the chat feature in the UK.

A brilliant game, so much to do and continues to improve each time. You can improve all of your factories by using the gold, silver & platinum. This speeds up the production. Expand your field to plant more crops, such as sugar cane, wheat, apples, pine trees, tomatoes etc. Just got the update and the plane icon has gone, they definitely need to put that back. Overall a good game. The ad you get shown and play isn't a true representative of the game. In fact that isn't even the game.

played for years and overall enjoy but some of the main features make you feel rushed. like the connect 3, stories great and cool they constantly update and change but recently it's changed so the levels don't restart meaning they get harder and harder and you get less energy to continue the story unless you buy tools almost finished my first story just to miss it by 8 more stages so was disappointed. and the competitions usually end up giving you less as a reward then you spent to try and get.

played for i would say 5 years building town and getting new factories as the level increased , move on to june 26 , hardly play it now as suddenly it went from a few credits to buy in game things to thousands of credits needed , especially the in game market stall guy wanting 90 credits to 2000 credits, and yes the more in game credits it is the more real money you pay... it feels like 5 years down the drain

I love the game but hate how often it crashes. So far this afternoon I've been unable to play it as it crashes within a second of opening. And I've tried reloading multiple times, tried 'force stop' and cleared cache, nothing works! 2026 updated. Now there is no longer an issue with this game crashing I'd 100% recommend it, I love it

edit.. this was one of my favourite games to pass the time but now after 10 years of it slowly turning into nothing but a cash grab I'm saying goodbye. I've spent over a year trying to gather stuff to build a factory obviously without using real cash and I think thats absurd. Just another game you have to use real cash to get anywhere with now after so many good years. really disappointed 😞

been playing this a while ,great game but unfortunately there's far too much putting it down, the match 3 game is beyond a joke,super hard levels one after another,costumer support do not help in any way, you get told they can't find issues with the so they don't pay for what you lost, if you can't spend real money on this game I wouldn't download it, you be wasting time and money,hope costumer support changes the way the game runs it's beyond a joke

I was on the match 3 mini game and swiping away, only to lose track of how many moves I had left and I swiped for another as the 'spend 900 for 5 more moves' came up. There was no 'are you sure?', instead it just added 5 more moves to a game I had no chance of winning. For saying 900 cash is about £2 this is extremely annoying. Money grabbing game.

I've played this game for over 5 years, and have enjoyed it until recently. The in game cost of making any progress is far too much, have to have cash to get anywhere. However, the icing on the cake is the removal of being able to chat within my Coop in the UK. Being told it's UK regs, that's rubbish, it only applies to minors, not adults. I will need to stop playing as I no longer enjoy it.

A nice game. It can be a grind but is possible to buy little bits cheaply in the game and the game passes are good. Enjoy the ship, the plant growth and the jungle stepping stones. My one main gripe is the notes. I dont like that its changed to 1000s rather than tens. Please, please can you put in an Are you sure? message for spending the notes. Several times ive accidently hit a box or a speed up or a rush customer and lost thousands of them!

Since the update there are so many glitches. The mini games within, if it works properly, only let you continue if you pay... again!! It seems now, for the last few months, the game just wants to take, take, take!! I've been playing for 4 years and pay the monthly pass, but greed seems to be ruining a good game. I've contacted them directly, but end up talking to a bot with no sufficient outcome. Very frustrating from a game that used to be fun & competitive.

used to be great! have had my wee town for over 8 years and used to love playing. Now it's terrible. since the last few updates you can't get past hard levels unless you spend money. the mini games have become very stale and the whole thing is boring now. Not keen to uninstall as have had it for so long but it definitely isn't a game I would go for first. also very misleading as the adverts are NOTHING like the actual game.

Those match-3 stuff has made life frustrating because they wanted you to beat levels and levels so to continue with other tasks, like upgrading the boats, buying goods needed from the shop and so on. I know this is a no ad game and the animations are nice. However, they give you more and more match-3 tasks to fulfill in order to carry on. Moreover, you have no where to win some levels, except if one is willing to put much money to play it. Money to buy the victory. Not for me! No fun

I played the ad many times on a different app. was great so I downloaded the game. sadly the game is very different. You do NOT get to be a person running about collecting and selling eggs, harvesting corn for the chickens, selling these items to the villagers etc. it is just a flat screen map and all you can do is click on icons to collect these now, while building a village. what a disappointment as the ad part was really engaging and fun. Why does the game not have this in reality??

game was really good a few years ago. now its getting boring so quick. its more about buying for real money now, so tasks often not possible to finish without buying tokens for real money. they cut options on regatta. it used to be much more different tasks in regatta, really enjoyable. now its poor. game lost a lot. it was an option to earn some town tokens. now its cut. you need to buy for real money. still got something from the past but compering to the past it has lost a lot of relaxation.

this is a game that's not sure what it is. by that I mean it's 50% a town building game and it's very good at that, and it's 50% a match 3 game that is among the more challenging of that genre. the only knock against the building side is some of the crops, mainly rubber, have an absurdly long wait especially because it is needed in so many different things. the big problem with the match 3 side is the total stupidity of the damn helicopters! I thought a "boost" was help u win, yet they don't !

They just removed the feature to confirm spending cash within the game. The buttons to spend cash are placed so you accidentally press the button. Support refused to refund, and refuses to address the issue by putting cash spend confirmation back. Additionally, in match 3, it's getting more and more complex, to the point of not being fun, and many levels require you to spend cash to complete. Awards have gone sharply downhill. in game currency now worth 90x less with last update.

This is a great and addicting game. Very chill and beautiful graphics. I just wanted to suggest that maybe, the rotation of the houses, buildings and other elements can be turned into 4 ways or can be rotated 360 degrees to provide more flexibility when arranging the elements in the area. Would really appreciate it if this will be adopted and implemented. Once done, I don't have anything more to say but to continue adding more and more elements.

I've been playing this game for over a year and only recently started spending a little bit of real $$ to get cool skins and extra boosters. The recent "economy update" makes it impossible to play the match-3 game (a major tool for acquiring boosters and skins) without spending ridiculous amounts of real $$. You used to be able to play casually for free, but now it feels like a cash grab. you'll get more $$ from me if you didn't make it feel like a waste.

I regret spending a dime on this game. I've been stuck on a level for close to a week in the name of the level being rated hard. I've played this same level over 60 times, it's ridiculous at this point. If I hadn't made much progress in the game, I would have uninstalled this piece of scam in the name of a game. All because you want the player to spend money, you made the level impossible to beat. Pathetic!

update 2026: no longer as fun. Been playing for 8 yrs! Used to be tons of DIFFERENT mini games (building leap, easter hedges, smoothie bar, bridge builder, and many, many more). they're all gone, just match 3 and the same adventure game over and over for years now. play with my 75 yr old mom and I don't think she likes it as much anymore either. PLEASE BRING BACK old games, these are boring, hate match 3! 2019: Love this game! I play every day all throughout the day.

Standard fare, you get what you pay for (or don't). My gripes are: no real explanations esp for the mine; you can't go back thru those rows if they weren't completely clear. Zoom out op. & the angle of the city, and lack of rotation option, sucks. As someone who worked in real estate and dealt with city planning, not knowing where the heck my roads are behind a building, is a major let down. Having to constantly move buildings around just to re-lay a road is a hassle. 2026 tech? Very.. 2015.

yr 2020. Last few Updates are causing game to crash which was not an issue before. Lowered rating from 5 to 3.. updates every week or couple of days is unreal. yr 2026.. recent update turned a once free game into an arcade game🤑. you advance just so far and can not progress farther. you must pay real money to continue. this was fun to play. with recent changes, it isnt.. if i want to throw money away, i would play the Lottery. i dont gamble

Bait and switch is the best way to describe this game. I downloaded this because of the ad that shows people running around providing a service and collecting money. That game only pops up every once in a while, but I still played. This game is pure money grab every month their "improvements" are just ways to make you pay to play. I'm considering deleting the app. It's too stressful and time-consuming. Very addictive as well.

Incredibly boring and tedious, build it and wait clicker clone. If you enjoy that type of game, then guess what, this one is still a bad version of it. Not even an hour or two in and your waiting times are already in the hours, not to mention the absolute clutter and chaos of your town, shops and barn space after getting some levels under your belt. The board is such a hot mess, you can barely tell what is what. Best part of the game is the match-3 side mini game and it rarely ever crashed.

I downloaded the game for the minigame shown in the ad. This shows up 𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑦 𝑟𝑎𝑟𝑒𝑙𝑦, and I'm assuming each egg/crop is coded as its own separate entity, because it lagged so badly it was almost unplayable. Also, I'd only been playing for a few minutes before I had to wait 10+ minutes before I could do anything. Match three (once it's unlocked) is often the only thing to do, and since I really don't care for match three games, it was not enjoyable.

There's a noticeable difference in how difficult it is to obtain prizes from the adventure part of the game as well as land expansion materials. It shouldn't have to play ONE regular level 55 times to get past it. And those levels are often harder than those labeled "super hard". I get that you all want to make money but this is bs. If you don't pay, you can't progress through the game. Zero stars if I could.

If you want a fun town building game where you can decorate and manage a city, don't get this game. If you want a candy crush mini game, then congrats, this is the game for you. It used to be so fun, and now they're making it harder and harder. Tasks in the regatta are basically impossible at this point, and you barely get any rewards. The graphics look like a child's game now and they've gotten rid of everything fun.

The nice thing is that there are a variety of activities...something to appeal to everyone. The irritating thing is that they FORCE you to engage with the mini games every time a new one is added. Everything else freezes and you can do nothing until you've clicked through to the mini game, waited for it to load, waited for the intro, waited for it to exit and reload the original game. I personally use the app for one thing only, and I don't appreciate the manipulation.

It takes forever to get materials, figured I'd buy materials for a few buildings. Built some, played for a bit, saved and closed. Went back hours later, they were back to waiting to be built, but materials and money were still gone. Tried to chat about it, took over 4 hrs for response, so I didn't see til next day. They said it didn't update because app was open on 2 devices. I only have 1 device, never played this game before. They were zero help and did nothing to fix the issue. I uninstalled

Okay so let's state the obvious 1. The ads obviously show a different game and that is why I downloaded this. it's a town building game not the farming game. 2. I'm playing this at a snail pace because there are 2 hour wait times. Throw in a 'watch an ad' option at least. Oh I need 4 bricks to finish building a post office, but my train takes 2 hours to return and really I'm stuck because I need more population. You have to pay if you want to actually enjoy this game.

The level of detail that's put into much of the game is really impressive. I gave it one star now due to the difficulty in obtaining "building supplies"to complete buildings. They take up too much barn space! In addition to that you can't contact a human and now they've almost doubled the cost of the Golden ticket and removed the airport icon so you have to go find the airport in your town to send planes. My barn is full when the ticket expires thanks to building supplies I can't use!

The fact that everything takes longer to get/produce over and over, and having to spend ingots to speed up the process is a bit stupid tbh. What's the point? Also, having to wait almost 2 days now for things to get built is just annoying and not really worth it. I was happy to build my city, it reminded me of Simcity. But it just takes forever to see some progress. Without this issue, the game would be a lot of fun.

I appreciate the different story-based games to continue to try to get coins and points to further build while waiting for supplies, land expansion, etc. but after having this game downloaded for two weeks, I've uninstalled it. I hit level 50 in the color match and couldn't proceed without boosters. I cannot justify continuing to dump money into the game just to finish builds or speed up supply runs, much less pass mini games. total money grab in my opinion. shame.

This game used to be a lot of fun a few months ago. The town aspect and the players helping each other aspect were both a lot of fun, but lately the developers have been really pushing a mini game that's a lot like candy crush. They are making it basically impossible to earn rewards anymore from just playing in the town, you have to play the mini game to earn anything worthwhile. That's just not what I signed up for. hope they fix this one day, but I'm uninstalling

New update is so laggy and unresponsive. Also, thanks for the new puzzle game. Absolutely love it. My favourite bits are getting stuck on a level for 4 days, with absolutely minimal moves. Or how you get so little points when you eventually pass said levels. Brilliant way of trying to screw a broke population, with wars, food shortages, no wage increases etc. Thanks again. Greedy greedy greedy!!

This used to be a great game. I've played for almost 10 years,and they have completely ruined it. It is basically another match 3, prizes and most of the tasks are linked to it instead of focusing on the original game. I got this game because it was not a match 3. There used to be fun side games and a variety of different ones, now it's only match 3 which are frustrating, boring, and repetitive. They refuse to listen to their players, my co-op is wanting to quit because of how bad it is now.

This game is just straight up weird.. first of all, it's not as advertised from what I've seen. The stuff they show in the ads is HARDLY a part of it. It might be petty, but that's already 1 star territory for me. Then, there are 3 aspects to the main game and none of them are done particularly well. The whole thing is heavily punctuated, play, wait, repeat, not my favorite. The matching part is stupidly hard sometimes too, so there is often times literally nothing to do. Waste of phone storage

This is the best game ever. It's so fun and entertaining when you have free time. I just have two small problems l hate that you have to pay to get the money bank because some people can't pay for it and l hate that some builds take so much time to finish like 2 hours! I really hope you fix them because without them the game would be much funner. Edit:l also hate that you either have to pay money or the train to get the resources for some builds maybe you could put more ways. Thank you

Really getting so tired of this game. Spent thousands over the 3 years I've been playing it because you CAN'T keep playing without spending and advance. Took 3 months away from it after support was an absolute joke about me getting zero rewards for spending $100 in a mini game. Same mini game popped up just now and it wanted me to pay SEVENTEEN levels in it. Time to delete again.

If you want to thorough review of how ridiculous this latest update is, I would go to the Reddit thread. Otherwise, for those of you who don't use Reddit, don't bother downloading this game unless you want to be constantly frustrated by obvious attempts to make you spend money in order to get anywhere, cleverly disguised as an update to make things fair. Instead, it's now nearly impossible to play. I'll be finishing out what I have and then deleting the game.

Lastest change to the township cash is complete BS!! I have 100 in township cash which was enough for 10 different level if I needed extra moves. Now it's 900!! I got 2,000 which is enough for two different levels. Why change the township cash!! There was nothing wrong with the amounts it was already at! You guys keep doing all these changes instead of fixing what used to make this app fun. Going on another year with 1 star from me.

Playrix, please look into this! The golden pass is a scam! It gives double gold rewards in theory, but it is just the same price you would be given if you hadn't bought a golden pass. The same items I would deliver that would yield me 1,500 are the same rewards after i get a golden pass (that's supposed to double it). The only difference is that the font colour changes, and that is simply running a scam. The issue goes with the market!!

Good game, keeps you engaged. That is until your only option is to wait. Then one loses interest quickly. The time it takes to produce materials & products. Should it take 4 hrs for wool? That's a bit extreme. Not only the wool. A few others too. There are plenty of ways to earn coins, but not money. Shorten production times, ways to earn more $ & you'll keep more players.

The new economy update is a blatant money grab from Township and nothing else. The game has always tried to force players to buy items but this is ridiculously greedy. I will still probably play intermittently but the $300÷ a month I was spending won't be spent on this game now.

I've been playing this game a long time and even spend real money in this game... however, with each update I lower my rating. The mini games have become pointless to play since now it's don't earn prizes from them. I'm unmotivated with match 3 because you changed all the helps and I lost all the helicopters I had accumulated. the only way to earn prizes is with match 3 and keys; but you also have no way to know how many keys you need to earn to gain the next level prize. please go back!

Great game to pass the time. One issue, the barn. Can building materials and metal bars have their own storage? Next issue: the impossible to win grab and go event. To move from 9500 which takes time since people are not playing this whole day to 39500 for the cash reward of 70 is insane. I wonder what obscene number it will take to get the 500 cash. Just remove the cash rewards if you don't want to give them or make it smaller. The reality is that people don't spend so much time in the game.

The mobile game ads are not lies, just misleading. The segments exist but they are short, and not engaging. Other than that it's a pretty good city builder with a bunch of parallel systems though it also has all of the standard mobile game stuff like competitions with other players, perpetual deals, and prods to get you to spend cash. It's also a city building game so it uses timers egregiously.

lost complete interest in this game due to the ridiculous match 3 game. it's like as soon as get the rainbow ball activated I get a level that requires 4-5 power ups just to beat the level. if I don't have the power ups to use then there goes my rainbow ball. I'll find myself playing a blue or red level 40+ times to beat it without any power ups. that's stupid and not fun at all. pay to win

June 2025 update is drastically slower & updated graphics are distracting. Livestock, factories, & fields, etc. are slower & uglier. To get ppl to spend $ they should make it faster & more engaging... not slower, more boring & repetitive & less visually appealing. Played for 5+ years & there used to be a variety of unique & creative side quests and regatta tasks. Now it's just the same few regatta tasks & constant mind-numbing "Adventure" side games with match 3 levels & SLOW.

Overall, I liked the game, but I had to give it a 3 star rating because it's nothing like that and also I had to reset it twice because it just wanted me to use my money during the territorial so I didn't have it whenever I need it and also it wants you to spend your own real life money on the game to get your money in the game. So I would only recommend the scheme if you like the simulator games and if you have the money to spend on it! (I hope this made sense)

OMG! This game!! It's hella good!!! It's not only about harvesting stuff and building homes n all.. It's something more, there's a lot more interesting elements to it..Lovely graphics.. No bugs at all..Like literally you can't find anything wrong.. You don't get bored at all..Go for it..Install it..Only thing wrong tho is that some products take a lot of time to produce and that makes u glued to the screen..Hoping they can resolve that.

I took away 4 stars because of the app/game crashing. I'm surprised I haven't uninstalled it yet. But I will get uninstalled if I have to keep clearing my cache and turning off my phone. Please fix this problem. I enjoy playing the game. Oh and another thing I received the rainbow globe before playing evel 809 or 810 and never received the rainbow globe once I lost on the level I had to start all over from scratch with the rainbow globe.

I used to like this game a lot. I loved when they had the various in-play games. They were each different and all fun like the gumball game. But now they host the same boring in-play game. They also have reduced the holiday decor. Each year it was fun to see Christmas lights on the town buildings and decor across town now they throw some snow in the sky and on some of the buildings and that's it. It's not the same.

Eh, starting to lose interest around level 25. I also reached matching lv 50 and it's impassable so I can't progress there anymore either which ended a portion of my gameplay and it won't change even after waiting a few weeks so it's a permanent end. I used to love this game. I played it all the time & eagerly checked in several times a day. The fun part, though, was building up the town, farming, and producing goods. Now, however, it takes forever to get enough coins to build new factories & community buildings. The monthly pass doesn't even reward you for town tasks anymore. It is exclusively geared towards the match-3 side game. There are tons of match-3 games out there to play that are no where near as monotonous as theirs.

Kind of fun at first, but gets tedious. It intentionally slows your progress so you have to either wait a a long time between doing anything interesting or pay ridiculous amounts of money. (I hate this trend. Let me pay once for games!) The minigame I saw in the ad was one two-minute thing within the first day or two, then never again, as far as I saw. I uninstalled after being nagged to turn on notifications several times in one day, with no "stop asking" option.

I'm totally addicted to this game. Love it! My original review was in 2018. The past year or so this game has been less fun to play- the mini games get hard too fast and even when a new challenge that uses the same mini game starts you start back at the same place you were before. The only way to get ahead is to spend real money. It's become a money grab game. So disappointing.

The base game is fun enough. I enjoy the quick jump in and out a few times a day to knock out productions and whatnot. However, the number of disruptions to play are rediculous. I don't have space to explain all the instances, but it is a constant disruption to the game and ruins the immersion a lot of times. There are also multiple events that run simultaneously, but on different timelines, and new events are put out immediately after one so it reaches a point where you stop caring about them.

Love the game, but bucks make it hard. The concept it fun, but the only way to advance is with bucks, really. Coins get you only so far because they are for simple decorations and farms. And the bucks are priced too high for what you get, and you really need them to advance. The puzzles on hard levels are ridiculously difficult. It shouldn't take an entire number of days for the game to finally let you win and go onto the next one. Unless you again spend more money on the game.

I am changing my review now after a few weeks. Things that have made me disinterested in the game are it deliberately limits certain resources in a way to force you to make real money purchases. For me the game is withholding slate. I have an abundance of other resources. Another thing you'll notice is the value of things increases an incredible amount the longer you play. You buy a cow feed for cheap then later it'll appear as an option to buy again and the price has increased 1000%. Same for land. You need additional resources. It's all part of making you spend real money. The true crime of it is we are all spending something more valuable...our time. Uninstalling.

Building the town is fun and, at times, a little overwhelming. I like the adventure game, but it is too much energy for removing obstacles.Youu can either just follow the clues and avoid all the other items and maybe finish the hunt, or collect all items, and never finish the hunt. Personally I think the color tile games are way too difficult! I hate them! It ruins all the fun. Maybe set a limit on how many times you have to play the games, say 5 lives, then move on.

I am starting to not enjoy this game. The mini games are terrible. I get more hard and super hard levels then the easy ones. I don't get the one power up. It just flies off the board. And with having so many hard and super hard levels it takes days to complete one level. Hard to send trains and planes when they request the same thing. And the race that doesn't even work. I am supposed to collect blue and reds pieces, now you can't even go your own way in the mini game. It tells you what to 2.

I loved this game! Play it religiously. But this latest upgrade is really sucking the enjoyment out of it. No interest in participating in the regatta with the new changes. The decoration prizes were so much better than what we get now. The mini adventure takes entirely too many energy points for one obstacle. Really dislike how expensive the new buildings are and having to trade so many materials for tools. Can we please have it back the way it was??? I don't want to uninstall this game too

My first review called this game "delightful". Just downloaded again and boy, have things changed. All the images, pop ups and details of the game are right in the centre of the screen. It's unavoidable and very, VERY annoying. Difficult to negotiate. It has it's moments, all ruined by the new device for a cash grab where a player can't get away from that which ruins the game for me. I deleted again, and do not recommend this game.

Very addicting! The only problem with the game is that it takes too long to get the building materials you need. That prevents a problem if you want your town to grow steadily. They really should make it easier to obtain building materials. Other than that, great game!! I am changing my review because the game play now requires way too much Township cash. I like playing the game, but I won't be playing in any more events they have. They make it too expensive! How greedy can you get with money?! These guys take it a little too far!

I've been playing for a long long time, and I really enjoy the game. So I was really upset when the new update would not appear in the store and as such I continued to play with the last version however that deleted all my progress. As in, 4 squares of land as opposed to the more than 50 that I had already accumulated. These glitches and crashes happens often that even though I enjoy the game, it's not plausible to keep on playing.

I have never played an online game for as long as I have this game. I have also never spent as much on a game either. However, I am finding much less reasons to spend or even wanting to stay. The mini games offered a fun side break from normal game play but no longer change. It's the same repetitive puzzle games on repeat. After reaching a certain level, you are left with few things to do. It's rare to get new buildings, factories, or attractions. The updates are too rare now and losea it's fun

I enjoy the game, but the constant updates cause problems with gameplay. To me, the game is getting frustrating because of slow gameplay and crashes due to updates. They address the problems, but I wish they would hold off on the updates. I would rate the game higher but for the glitches. Why all the updates!!! Leave it alone! Now they keep repeating the same minigames over and over, it's getting boring.

UPDATE! IT'S GOTTEN WORSE! Cannot chat w/ teammates or friends because the white text box doesn't stay on. It keeps disappearing. ALSO when I try to complete a task that involves the Mini-Game the points do not add and you just keep having to do the same task. I've tried to report this three times already and you people don't get it! The task never gets completed.

The changes have been terrible over the years. This used to be such a fun game. There were plenty of DIFFERENT minigames, reasonable regatta expectations and the ability to choose how you wanted to play. Bit by bit you've taken most of the fun part out of the game, to force players to spend more money. Now, there's two minigames, over and over, none of the fun ones like the bubblegum machine, fishing, roller coaster, etc. There's no option to not be involved in the regatta anymore. It's bad!

I love this game a lot and have spent an embarrassing amount of time and money on it. I love it but wish that there was an option to cancel something in the factory queues, and also be able to re-order it. It would make my life so much easier!! Edit 6/01: I HATE the update that moves the camera when I'm trying to harvest!! It makes it so much harder for me to harvest 😡

I've been playing this game for over 5 years used to have between a 4 and a 5 star rating now dropping down to 1. I don't know what is going on with the developers, but if you can say rinse lather repeat. That's what this game is turning into. It's the same monthly experiments over and over again, which is getting Beyond stressful. There is no more variety, a lot of the mini games we used to love playing throughout the month are missing in action. It's turning into a money grubbing game.

The game is good, really easy to play and a lot of ways to interact with people. My biggest "complaint", for lack of a better word, is that when several different things complete at the same time you get a notification for each item. During the day it's not a big problem but after you've had a long night with a sick child having nine or more notifications go off is a bit annoying. It would be better if at least the morning notification was just one over encompassing note.

The game was OK. It's like SIMs, a bit more clean, with better graphics. BUT, I got tired of being required to continuously do the side quests in the beach world or the mountain climbing world, for money, or dynamite, or a hammer, or other things. The blue energy bank is depleted too soon & the required energy points to smack a bush are too high. The puzzle game makes you spend money for additional moves to solve them. The train does not come back fast enough. So many things, I grew tired of it

Like the routine chores, love race of champions and helping my co-op in regatta. As far as the golden pass, I don't think I will buy anymore. Cannot tolerate the repetitive mini games, or building a room, both of which are impossible to complete unless you live on your device. So gold pass is a waste of time and money . Play games to have fun and relax, not stress.

This used to be a fun town building game. It had a variety of mini games where you could win little shops, kiosks, and restaurants to add to the town. Slowly, they kept changing the game and have now taken away all the fun little games. And the rewards that helped make your town unique. It's now stuck on a color match puzzle game and the rewards are things you have to have to win that puzzle game. The focus is not on the town. Apparently, the creative game designers were moved to something else

I've been playing this game for five years. I've spent money on several occasions. My beef is this: the game has become far too greedy now. It used to be easier to earn great stuff. For example: the aerial event has really gone downhill. The wheel spins don't earn the nice decorations now when you could earn them all before. Also, I've leveled my plane fully up. All i want now is to place well and earn a prize for all my money and hard work but haven't had one flight containing battery boosters.

While a good strategy game, the advertising for this game is often misleading. Progress is slow. While it offers many options to unlock land, it is limited to one or two parcels a level (your choice). Game play in interactive ads does not reflect actual game play and I probably would be more inclined to keep it if it matched the ads. As it is, will not be keeping. Nor will I be interested in reinstalling.

the game has really turned into making it very difficult for anyone to beat levels. It seems all they want is to try to get you to spend money. They have even stooped so low as to destroy the Ruler of the Mine. The concept of the whole game should be for us, the players to have fun and maybe only spend real $$ when we choose. Their concept is to make it almost impossible to play without spending real $$.

Games great, I love it, only issue is lately whenever i try to check out the regattas, it freezes on it, I can't get past it, and have to restart the game. I'd like to be able to participate again but I can't. I also wish it was easier to get more than just a dollar of township cash, and that everything didn't take so much of it. There also needs to be seperate materials for the town and the zoo. It takes so long to get what you need. I also want my piggy cash! I earned that. 😡

This is a fun game but takes FOREVER to make progress unless you want to spend a ridiculous amount of money or just wait it out. The video ad has nothing to do with actual game play so don't bother paying attention to that. There's a lot to build on but you can really only focus on one or two projects at a time because they eat up so many resources and take too long to obtain. There's also overlapping events, which again, take up all the resources so you have to choose between partaking in the events, or developing your town. It is an enjoyable game and if you don't mind ignoring some tasks for others, then you'll like this farmville type city game. If you're a completionist, don't waste your time unless you're willing to pay for it.

It's an alright game. I haven't tried one of these before, but it's pretty easy to get hooked for a few days or weeks, depending on how much you play it. If you have a couple of friends to play with it helps. If you refuse to spend real money on the game cash and coins, it is much slower progress in the game, so make sure to save the initial game cash early on. If you refuse to spend real money on the game, then by level 20 and up it gets really tedious and the game progress slows way down.

I loved this game for years, but it has failed to grow at a rate that keeps pace with it's players over time. There is no room to expand, no new animals at the zoo, and the regattas have almost no variety in the tasks they offer so I often have to wait hours for a task. I usually end up doing trains and crates over and over again. There is rarely a 135 point House of Luck or earn a certain amount of coins anymore. Just the same stuff over and over. Boring!!!

Few years ago, I gave this 5/5. It used to be fun. Now I know better. Glitches everywhere, customer support is a bot that dismisses your complaint without anyone ever checking in to it. Rewards for challenges & mini games are not given when earned...or ever. Went from a fun game to several overlapping mini games / challenges. In order to get anywhere in the (now back to back) 30 day events, spending hours on minigames to earn points for rewards. More a chore than a game now.

Loved this game until I took a brief break from it; the difficulty spike & time required to make progress was too much. I then got a targeted ad for Township while playing a different game. It showed a crying and shivering cartoon kitten (that looked a lot like my own cat) with the words "Please come back." Uninstalled Township and some of the other games the developer made too. That level of emotional manipulation is not cool, especially when I'm trying to relax. You just lost a paying player.

Not to whine about a FTP game, but it does need work in some areas. Right off the top of my head would be how items on queue can't be cancelled, even at the cost of a portion or even all of the resources used. That way if for any reason you don't need something anymore or need something else produced more urgently, you have a choice instead if being stuck with what you don't want for lack of foresight (on your part or otherwise) and still pay a price Other games do this, so it shouldn't be that big of a deal. Mire to come as I remember or discover stuff, all in the spirit if contribution.

I still enjoy this game, but once you got a certain level, and have built all the factories, houses, built the zoo and opened up all the land. they don't make provision for more advanced players. You keep getting all this building material on the trains, you can't use. The mini games are rotated, but are all the same and really bored now. You have to play them with the gold pass. Some of the prizes are of no use, if you are an advanced player. Guys change your mini games, PLEASE. At level 150

I really like this game it's takes my mind off all else when I play. It's challenging, it's creative. When I first started, I thought it was going to be a lame game, but turns out I love it. The only negative issue I have is the games are out there. Some so difficult. And I find myself frustrated. And also now when you make money it goes in a piggy bank that you have to buy, which really sucks. Please lower the difficulty's in some of the games. And either make the piggy bank free or $1.00

Works fine at first, good tutorial and excellent explanation. But the loong wait and side quest of side quest just prolongs the game, you can't play offline you get little to no resources even with a full farm you have limited storage. They are also begging you to "pay to win" On the side note.. Ive seen ads representing the game and it's nothing like the ads just plain false advertising. The start is good, but the more you play the more you realize the game is prolongs the game play.

Fun game. I wish they would lower some of the times the products take to make (including the time some crops take to grow). Also there should be away to cancel the production of a something. Sometimes I realize I really dont need something but already started it being made, but I really need something else. Otherwise I do enjoy the game.

Was a great game, could play a variety of mini games and build up the town and zoo. It's been getting more restrictive, mini games are down to two over the few years. The latest update has practically destroyed the game. I'm now racing against co-ops that have 3 to 5 active players (compared to my single player). They have taken over the top 5 spots, no way can I hope to beat them and move up to the gold league. No decorations in the regatta store, so no real incentive to play.

Incredibly frustrating to advance in. I was excited to find a game I thought was similar to old city building games. However, you can only place a certain number of buildings at a time, but you're required to have buildings to grow the population, so you're forced to build companies, but can only build a limited number at a time, making progress very slow. The match game is very hard, some levels need to be played 15+ times if you aren't purchasing boosters, making gained boosters useless.

The game use to be fun. Now, one of the nice challenges, the professor's experiments with nice prizes I liked, was well put together. Last time it was active, the barn upgrades, one it took my parts, never gave me upgrade. Second one they give at the end, again said i received it,but did not. Now this time, and for a long-time now, I don't get nails at all, REALLY, how unfair is that,please FIX THE GAME.

I always wanted to try out this game because of how popular it is. But I was sorely disappointed. The graphics are mediocre. The puzzles are too difficult and annoying (and I've played many puzzle games before). It takes forever to collect the food. It's difficult to accumulate dollars, which are needed for almost everything. You play the game for 5 minutes at most and have to check back every few hours to collect goods. Really annoying and overrated. There are millions of better farming games.

I've been playing since the second year that this game was available. My first review was a 5⭐ raving about how fabulous it was. Five years in I added an update to my review because the game still had me hooked. Now, not so much. I still play almost daily but only because of the global friends I've met. The game is really pushing spending 💰 now. Used to be ways to earn cool stuff just from playing hard. Now not so much. The best stuff is only for paying folks. I'm still holding out though!

Everything is so beautiful !!! Building materials are getting rare... Please make something for exchange or availability. I'd appreciate if you allow materials to be purchased with game coins as well. EDIT: After I returned back, I couldn't see my co-op info, nor could i change it, my friends are all gone, not getting events rewards as well, feel isolated.

If I wanted to play candy crush game, I wouldn't have installed this one. Why would you add an extra game and then make ppl play it, if they want to go through the levels?? I don't want to play them, but I can't exchange the points in the planes, so now I can basically forget about sending a plane, ever. Thank you so much, you've ruined the game for me.

NOTHING like the ad. The game really is just a money grab. Nothing really to do but try to build up a town & they have the timer set soooooo long to actually make any progress. The mini-games inside are also money grabs. You cant get past certain parts without paying. Unnecessary difficult. I do not recommend this game at all. It is a serious waste of time.

It's a fun enough game to pass time however, I deleted it as every so often a "season" of mini internal game ends and forces you to go through the new "season" information which is nearly the same exact and identical format and look as the last one. I realized when pulling this up to review, it does NOT look like the games in the pictures. I actually went through my settings to find the app as when I clicked on it from search, I thought it was the wrong game.

This game is addictive and fun. Earning rewards is fun and easy. Love the regatta.. that was 4 years ago. 4 years later they can't seem to find my town due to their system. Now I have to start over. That's not happening. I'm very disappointed. All the help they want to give is a automated system. No answers.... just more suggestions

Not the worst game, but not like the ads and relies a lot on match 3. So I'm sure we're all been bombarded by the ads for this game. A lady running around managing a farm by upgrading and buying new units. It seems fun, but ads are never like the real thing. It's a meme, but I still tried out the game. They do that thing where the game they advertise is a short, unrepeatable level. The real game does have a lil resource management since the barn gets full fast, but it's a fancy match 3 game.

Wow. I loved this game and have regularly purchased packs as I believe in supporting games. But now, they have completely screwed us. Tool exchange is a huge rip off! It used to take a long time to save up 100+ building materials to build one community lot, but now with it can take 10-20 materials to get just one tool. Then the com. lot needs 10-20 tools, plus supplies- it takes 3-4 times as many materials- just to make you break down and spend $. I'm quitting the game till the exchange is gone.

Pretty generic timer based game that tries to get you to pay to speed things up. On the plus side, the graphics are nice and it plays a little like SimCity. The worst part is the trains. They are supposed to bring you essential materials to build your town with, but it takes forever and you can't choose what you get. I've been trying to upgrade my barn for days but it just never brings me what I need. And the one time it did, the game crashed.

There are a few things that could be improved. co ops are great, you can actually make real life friends! But the game has glitches often. The help center is worthless and never actually helps. The game freezes and kicks you off. You can't always access your zoo. And they have made it so you basically have to live in the game if you want to win anything. It used to be way less demanding and a lot more fun. The last few updates have really taken away from the relaxation and joy of the game.

I enjoyed playing this for a while, then I got increasingly obsessed with gaining levels to complete my town, which lead me to spend more and more money. But then the game started "glitching", by erasing progress I've made hours before, including progress I had spent my precious coins and greenbacks on, both in the sidequests and on my town. In trying an uninstall and reinstall, which had done successfully before, getting to keep my progress and such, instead the app erased everything. No more.

The professor experiment benefits are wack. You keep giving construction materials as gifts and prizes... FOR WHAT!!! There hasn't been a new building in like a year. I don't bother playing the mini games because you make it hard on purpose to make people lose and try to make them spend township cash to keep going. Then if you do win and get a prize, it's bricks and plastic, so it's pointless. You guys need to get it together.

I loved this game until I reached level 100. In the beginning there were a ton of factories, buildings and decorations to earn. Tons of variety and land to expand the town. Once I hit the higher levels, it became hard to progress due to amount of materials needed to expand. It got to the point where the only way to progress is to purchase game money. The mini games also became too difficult to beat, unless you wanted to buy power ups. I refuse to be forced to spend money, so I simply gave up.

I love this game...however, I was in need of a new phone. I was told that all I had to do was reinstall and sign in on my new device. I had been on level 89 and it made me start all over again 😡 so now, I'm at level 5 because once again, I was told to play through level 4 and then it'd give me the option to switch accounts 😡 I wouldn't be so upset, except I got so into this game that I actually & very stupidly made several purchases throughout the course of a year. Uninstalling. This sucks!

After the last update, the game became too laggy. Everything was fine beforehand. Now every bit of the game lags. Too much lagging. Doesn't load properly, I collected some material and exit the game. When I re-enter, the materials were not collected. Other players town loads toooo slow. Price hiked. Boxes from 20 to 30 Tcash. You left no choice but UNINSTALL the game... At level 76 🤬🤬

Fun game to play. If you don't want to spend real money you don't need to. It just takes longer to progress in the levels. Game would be more enjoyable if they let you earn township cash more often instead of making you buy it in the piggy bank. After playing this game for almost two years I uninstalled it. Made it to level 80. Having to save or buy materials that fill the barn, in order to complete a construction project was getting a bit much. It was taking me a month to complete.

The new regatta update of not being able to reserve a task STINKS! Also, tasks not counting unless you pass a level is super frustrating. That was a terrible idea. I can be stuck on levels for DAYS sometimes, and now my task won't count unless I pass a level? That's annoying. I used to love this game. A big thing that I think would help is if the market would tell us the amount we have in the barn under the item that's for sale.

Without spending s tons of money, you need to waste about 7 hours a day on the game to get anywhere. (Unless you WANT to spend years doing it little by little.) No one has that kind of time. I get that its like that with most games, but Township makes it so blatantly obvious that they're milking you for money. Anything worth getting, or making any progress building in the game, costs loads of money. Stingy beyond belief, and everything designed to make you spend.

So addicted!!!! July 2019 Update: yes the building costs are down but the zoo takes up all your materials, or the buildings do. Update: As I level up the buildings get too expensive but I'm still an addict. Gameplay just needs to be more entertaining instead of stressful over how you'll pay for things. Update: The zoo and other changes have ruined the game for me. Doubt I'll be playing much longer. Things are even more expensive than they were already. Pretty much over my addiction.

Meh! It starts out fun, but by the time you reach lvl20 the time required for completion gets reeeally long. It's also incredibly annoying that each time you cancel an order (because you don't have the factory to make a product) the refresh time increases! (So you have only 2-3 orders remaining that you can possibly fill, but the numbers of required items are staggering) And why do I need so many concrete slabs for each new building? I am lucky to receive 1 or 2 every 3rd or 4th train! Uninstall

I've been playing this game for years and I have really enjoyed it. However, a new update was done yesterday and I can't do any of the regatta tasks involving the mini game. I do them and it doesn't give me any credit for it. It's making it far too difficult for me to compete in the regatta. Also, it takes way too long to accumulator enough Township bucks to increase barn storage, which is full of tools because it's also way too slow with having anything to use the tools for.

so far so good. Price to increase land and build materials could be cheaper. And the price to buy game money and coins are crazy. would give a 5 stars but I can't with these prices. $99.99 for what $1400 game dollars. Itshould be at least $3500 to $4000 for a $100. when I sheet of glass to build a build is what $24 for one and it takes what 12 sheets. Beside that it looks good and play well. oh and everything takes to long and the event are the same a little change would be nice.

The game itself is interesting (options, graphics). But everytime I download it at certain level it stops loading. So I delete it and start over again... also, too much time is needed for waiting as if they want you to get addicted to it.. I wish waiting time for Product was shorter and more ways to make money in the game. Otherwise all good.

I really like this game. Have played for years. However, they've made it near impossible to upgrade or expand( i.e., buy buildings, houses, etc) WITHOUT spending a ton of money!!! You used to be able to expand just by playing, being patient etc. Now, unless you have deep pockets, it takes FOREVER! I have given up on the zoo. I have 3 enclosures I cant complete and 5 entire animal groups i cant begin to build enclosures for!

This was fun when it was about town design with a little of other smaller games on the side. Now it's about regattas, and the design is slooooow and almost impossible, especially the more advanced you get. The Golden ticket promotes the regattas, and has nothing to do with town design. So, don't download it for the design, coz that's gonna get frustrating.

After playing Township for 7 plus years, I am finding it quite unenjoyable. I'm basically just putting in time for my teammates sake. The mini games have become ridiculously hard. They cannot be done with the number of moves given, not even, with tools. It sometimes takes me days to get past them. Now with the changes you recently made, it just makes things even harder. This game used to be my favorite. I played it for hours. Too bad.

New updates equals less fun. I won't be spending any more money on this one. Items earned in the regatta are no longer cool additions to the farm, can only get power ups, bricks, etc. 2nd problem, levels of mini games must be completed in order to get credit for the tasks. Terrible idea: some of those levels are extremely hard to pass until the game "lets" you win after several losses. This means you will fail at the tasks because they won't be done in time. 3rd: bad regatta graphics, jerky.

I started playing this before the pandemic started. It was very interesting, and there were so many different types of mini games. Even those who didn't buy into any extras could still win cool little prizes that could be used within the game. Now it looks like everything is about the regatta and about story adventure journeys. On top of that, it seems as if the creators are bulking up their prices for those who buy extras in the game. I loved the pinball thing, if that was back, I may come back

The newest update is terrible, rewards were once cool additions for your town. Now they are just lame rewards to play mini games. They want you to spend money in order to get ahead. They had cool mini games, and now it's just match 3. Competition in the regatta is tough unless you spend money. In the mini game, if you hit an object twice with a rocket or something, it only counts as one hit. I do not recommend starting this game now unless they go back to better rewards and fairer play.

OLD REVIEW: I love this game. I play it several times every day. My Co-op is the Best! It is what keeps me coming back... We are a team. UPDATE 7/9/24. I'm seriously thinking of leaving after 7 years. The game isn't fun anymore. It's the same old tasks and over and over. No creativity or variety. I don't feel challenged. I mean how many cutie stickers does a person need? I loved the game when there were choices of mini games, like farming, fishing, smoothie bar, etc. It is just a $ grab. Sorry.

I have been playing for 5 years now. Started off great but now they have gotten greedy and everything cost so much. The Golden ticket games are a scam for you to spend extra dollars and so boring now. It's the same thing over and over again. They need to bring back the fishing, airplane, fruit, and cooking mini games back. Very disappointing for a game that so entertaining to start.

I've been playing for several yrs & I've loved it until recently. In the last few months everything from mini games, the rms & the long events, like the professor challenge, has been made harder from the very beginning. So I can't complete them. Not that I expect to finish all but it has become every one of them making me feel like what's the point of playing this game anymore. Since u have made it too difficult. Everyone in my co-op has discussed this & has the same issue with the game now.

I've been playing Township for 5+ years. It used to be great, but for the past year or two, Playrix has been taking away everything that made the game fun. All the side games are are gone, replaced with two repetitive games geared toward getting players to purchase tools and things to successfully complete tasks. They've taken away the themed decorations for our towns, squashing any fun and creative ways to design. Greed is driving these changes, and the game isn't fun anymore.

Initially fun enough for a mindless time killer and basic city builder but lost its appeal around level 20 when it became an all out grind towards the next population threshold. That is, unless you're willing to dish out money for in-game cash and coins. I would consider spending if there was added complexity to the city builder aspect of the game, but building/rearranging buildings for the sake of aesthetics only is boring. Not a bad time sink for a few days but no more for me.

edit to my review... I've been playing over a year. everytime they update they make everything cost more and harder to get (building material for one). mini game events make you start all over or pay cash. interseasonal rewards were changed, and they made it harder to switch coops to stop hopping. I've met so many people from around the world and it's sad I may stop playing This game is a fun way to pass the time, and if you join a co op it's a great way to meet awesome people.

After all it's a nice and relaxing game, but the problem is that - because it's so relaxing in some way - it's even impossible and boring in others. I would suggest to make the game a bit more involving. I open the game everyday and my only purpose it's to claim the rewards, feed the animals, make the businesses go on and that's it. Theres no new thing, its always the same thing, that's why I only open it for 10 minutes or less. And besides, most of the challenges are impossible.

If you want to play a game that you can progress in without spending tons of $, this isn't it. I've played 7+ yrs, and I don't mind spending $ as long as I don't have to spend 100's a month. I have no prob spending $4.99 for the event pass to get better rewards/decor. Then they started making the games you had to play/win to collect the rewards/decor, extremely hard to win without spending lots of $. I just added it all up. In 2020, I spent $326.72 a yr. Now I spend that much or more a month🤬

Clever game, HOWEVER, it's like playing with a kid: once you figure out a strategy for winning, they'll change the rules in the middle of the game so you can't win anymore; if you figure out how to get a great reward, they change the reward in the future to make it smaller. After about level 46, the game slows WAY down. The developers are definitely good at finding new ways to make you spend money on in-app purchases. Like the county fair, the games are rigged for you to lose!

Only game I have played for this long, but, my review comes now because after you reach higher levels it's takes SO many coins to purchase factories, community buildings and houses, that I spends WEEKS trying to collect enough. I leveled up twice just trying to collect coins to purchase one factory, and now I need another one, at 520,000, I do the Regattas, trains, planes, factories and the Zoo. I have also needed topaz, which it never gives me in "my rewards" for sending full planes and selling goods at the Zoo. You have to work months to upgrade your barn. It was much more fun in the beginning. Honestly ready to delete and find a new game! Coming from level 78!

It was a great game. Played 6+ years. Now it has an update that won't update. So I can't play the game. Some things are time sensitive. Also more and more of there side games lean more towards getting you to spend real money. You "don't need to" but you don't have a good chance at any of the good rewards. Also you can no longer get what you need to build or expand your town. Been collecting materials for 3 years for zoo enclosures and 1 year for the pool hall. Invested hundred $.

I like playing. Play all day and night. But no review here is lying. The trains bring in very little building supplies. Or tools to expand. If you want to speed anything up, your pretty much forced into buying town cash. Or buying coins. It makes no sense to buy things from the market because you end up loosing money on helicopter orders. And ever since this update came along, you can't even visit people's towns now. Many things need to be adjusted.

After 9 years of play, they started offering the play pass for sale, and things were never the same. Fun events like the race were discontinued, and things that used to be free suddenly you had to buy the pass to get. The puzzles and the long winded stories that went with them were boring. A 5 star game turned useless by greed. I deleted and moved on.

Animals are fun to feed, Game is addicting, I wish when you get to a challenging level you could choose to stay at that level, instead it gets too hard and your barn can't hold enough for u to make everything you need to make. I uninstalled the game and deleted the data and deleted my game in Google Play but when I reinstalled it, I'm still at the super high level, I emailed the company but never heard back from them

I have played this game for nearly three years, Level 90. This is NOT a 4-5 start game. It could be, but the game is very buggy. There have been numerous times -just this month alone- when spending over 20-30 minutes setting up tasks then going to bed, only to come back in the morning and have to start all over again. I have lost racing tasks with my coop mates, in game tasks, entire zoos built disappear, game resets to a point 3-4 hours before...VERY frustrating. Game Devs do nothing, waste of time even mentioning it, deaf ears. There are many games in a game going on at the same time, but, they are the same thing over and over. This game is built around pushing you to spending your township CASH as much as possible. Can you play without it? Maybe, but not to the full extent of the game -not even close, I have tried. It is difficult to walk away from something you have built for 3 years, but I have to go, its no longer worth my time, and it is trying to suck cash out of my pocket.

Hit a pay wall after having so many different mechanics (requiring different "premium" items) in the game, and never went back. Try upgrading storage or even completing events on time without spending money. I got my wife and I a reasonable purchase, about equal how much one might pay for a full game (as a kudos to developers), and it didn't help my progress whatsoever. Unless you're content with astronomical wait times to acquire items, invest in a more rewarding gaming experience elsewhere.

Make your advertisements able to close. I'm trying to use a dictionary and of course the "install now" works, as do the interactions with the advertisement but after "5 seconds" the advertisement refuses to close. I have to close what I'm using and look up what I've been searching all over again everytime your deceptive and time wasting advertisement pops up. So thanks for wasting my time for more than the 5 seconds you're supposed to be allowed.

Can be fun most of the time but there are a few things to note: 1. Having to spend money to unlock the golden ticket in every single season chapter is ridiculous. It should be a one time expense. They randomly generate customer orders in the game you have to wait forever to fulfill b/c the items being requested are several city levels in the future. Being a level 45 and being asked for items you can't create/grow/ make until Level 50+ isn't helpful at all. Definitely a money racket game too.

This app has a lot of issues. I went to bed with over 87000 coins and woke up with 27000 coins. Can u help? Stleast fix. Also, when playing the colored squares game it didn't up my points, many times, after a game was done. For example example I had 187 points then won with 64 points and nothing was added. I've spent money on this game so I think I'm about done. Keldpat at Homeland Happiness

The zoo looks like a mess now that there are little thought bubbles everywhere. Can't enjoy the look of the zoo anymore. Makes me not want to go in there. Sometimes you don't get a reward for watching a video. It takes longer and longer to build because they require more building materials as time goes on. It shouldn't take so long to finish a building. I'd pay for this game if these things were changed. The wait times don't make me want to make in-game purchases, they just cause frustration.

New "upgrades" make it nearly impossible to build new buildings. The amount of building supplies needed to buy tools, when you still need those supplies to build those buildings is unreasonable. I'm done with this game. I used to spend real cash occasionally, but no more. It's no longer fun if there's no reasonable length of time to get things done.

my first review of this game is from 2018, I used to have it 5 starred. but it is so irritating when I get on and any editing I did, orders I may have shipped off, items put in to be made; disappear like i never put it in. I've stopped playing the game again bc im not about to redo all of my work I already did. And, the mini games with extremely hard, unskipable levels that you just can't pass even with all the power-ups also make me not play that game. I loove matchy patchy, don't get me wrong

I have been playing for 3 years now. This game has changed so much and not for the better. The ONLY reason I am still playing is because of the friends I have created. The developers have mailed it in and keep recycling the same old boring side games. It used to be a variety of things to go along with running your town. Now it is a puzzle game, a truck game and so roller coaster game. Yawn emoji here. 😴 I hope the developers will see that I've changed my 5 star review to a 1 star, not likely.

I've been playing this game for years. I love the overall game. However, the large event being tied into the mini games is extremely frustrating. Please go back to the previous way. Some of the mini games are so difficult and annoying that I actually avoid them although. Which then means I don't advance in the larger event. Please go back to the old way.

This game has gone downhill to the point it's barely playable. 3-year veteran here, the mini games have been reduced to three different ones. They used to introduce new mini games all the time it kept it so new and fresh. The airplane game was super fun, the matching blocks, and every holiday there were special recipes. There was a fishing game and all kinds of fun games that were just little spice. Now it's this monotonous gumball drop and road slap. I don't think they care anymore.

Everything takes waaaayyyyyyyy too long to make and you can't earn town money fast enough to actually enjoy playing the game for a while... Wish there was a way to trade in cash earned for town money. Or better yet they were one in the same. Would love the game so much more if I was able to produce that things that were asked for in the time allotted. They ask me for plastic products you can only have a plastic company at level 46 but I'm only at level 32 they set me up to fail.... Not happy

Developers are getting greedy. I've played for 6 yrs & it was once upon a time about building a town & now it is about anything, but. The mini-games are fun, but these experiments & golden ticket events are getting out of hand. The race of champions? Each time get progressively more & more time consuming. No one wants to play a game they feel obligated to be on all day or lose a lot of effort. Haven't had a new factory or building in ages. No zoo enclosures either. Might Remember what it's about
