I loved this game at first. but the piggy bank won't give the money unless I use REAL money. everything takes up too long to make and I get frustrated. then the materials for the buildings takes way too long plus it's really hard to get the money for some reason it's way easier to get the coins. terrible game, I'm trying to download the new version but it's taking too long. I'm going to get rid of it.

It is basically set up to where you have to buy farm money with real money. I don't mind watching the occasional ad for game perks in return as needed. A little flexibility for the low budget gamer would be a great addition. I deleted it simply due to the fact I have no budget to spend on this game in order to keep up. I'll check in later to see if this has improved.

I downloaded the game for the part that was in the adds, walking around and upgrading things so they automated as I earned more money. Turns out that's just a tiny part of the game that you only get to do once in a while. It's actually a city builder, and not a very good one at that. It's extremely tedious and with very weird time gateing to slow you down to a crawl.

Stopped playing for.an extended time due to having a failing device. When I upgraded phones and log into the same Google play account I cannot recover my town. Automated support is useless to try to remedy this. At least $30 lost, probably more. And that not including the countless hours of play and progress. Unfortunately restarting from nothing when I was north of level 50 and had so much money already into the game is just not something I'm willing to do. As such I had to change my rating.

Not like the ads at all. I think the ads look fun and really simple to make. Why not just program a simple game like the ones in the ads, than a more complex one you don't even advertise because you know it looks too bad? Developers seem to have no confidence. Obviously just a cash cow. The false advertisement is weird though, because the fake game isn't even like, technologically advanced... it's really simple and it seems they already have the assets... game seems to be build poorly anyways...

Game started off fine and enjoyable. But there are no breaks between events which starts off fun quickly wears thin as it makes it difficult to play the core game. Alao some minigames require purchases. The biggest problem is scale. As you go into the mid game you don't get enough storage. The barn size has a linear increase in capacity, but each level costs more. Which means eventually you need more resources than the barn can support. Maybe have a separate storage for tools that can scale

Building the town and all the features having to do with that are fun and cute, but the candy crush type game feature, which is necessary to progress in the game, is coded so poorly. I've played many of those candy crush type 'matching gems' games, and I'm good at them. In this game, however, the mechanics are so messed up that I get stuck on many levels for hours. Many of them are virtually unwinnable, if not for a random lucky powerup being made. Very frustrating!

I enjoy playing the game, for the most part. It is fun and challenging. What I DON'T enjoy about the game is the frequency of "timing out" of regatta tasks hours before they are due to expire; the length of time it takes to amass construction materials to build community buildings and zoo enclosures; and constantly running out of space in the barn to store products because so much of it is taken up with huge amounts of construction materials. We need a separate storage place for them!

A very simple and relaxing game that still pays attention to small details! The only reason it doesn't have 5 stars is because there is no way (that I've found at least) to cancel the orders at the factories. However, it may be the only game where you are not required to spend real cash to progress! The in-game currency is provided slowly but steadily through the level-up and the achievements/tasks, so even if you are a bit behind, you'll catch up soon! Awesome game!

Another pay to play game. Starts off great, but as you progress, especially in the secondary quests and Regatta, you have to beat "candy crush" levels to get more energy and to complete tasks. The higher you get, the less moves and more obstacles to remove. In order to get more moves, you have to pay 10 in game dollars for 5 extra moves. You end up have to pay to compete.

I only enjoy this game because of the detail gaphics. other than that, if you have nothing to do in your life, and retired, then you can soend all day on it. The worse part is waiting for over an hour to develop a crop, or feeding animals, and the train to deliver goods, ir building a store. The whole time takes way too long, its waste of time. If your retired and have nothing to do, great, but not a game for professional career people. But graphics are great.

Overall a pretty fun game. I like how well the game progresses and the many different ways you earn money while building first your farm and then your city. However the issue I have run into is that eventually you have to spend your real money to progress through the game. You can't get any further then level 13 before township money just doesn't cut it and you need to use actual money to get ahead. It's a very cute game and very enjoyable up until level 13.

the game is addicting, but the trains need to bring more slabs to build. I'm at a point where I have 5 buildings not completed because they need 10+ slabs, but it takes me a week to get them all. so I'm just going in circles filling orders and not able to build my town. I'm about ready to move on to another game since there's no way to move forward quickly. I could understand a day, but the further along I get, the more material a building needs and it's just not coming fast enough to build

I've been playing this game for 5 years. It used to be very fun. The mini games were awesome. There was a cooking game, a roller coaster game, a gumball machine game, etc. Now all there is is the adventure game and merge game with a boring block game to get energy. The regatta is another example. The tasks can no longer be deleted for new without penalty and are mostly just plane, train and mining. You can't do mini game tasks without finishing the level. You have to spend $ to succeed now.

Another beautiful game with what seems like a lot of content at first that very quickly descends into a money grab. Like a classic arcade machine game, you'll have to keep putting in money to progress at a reasonable rate. Everything is designed to suck more and more resources from you to force you to buy the ones you need. And if you overproduce resources thinking you can sell them to get ahead, nope, they aren't worth anything. Rewards for completing progression tasks are randomized.

I only downloaded the game based on the advertising of the cafe part of the game. I have played it for months now and only able to play the cafe part ONCE. They make it too hard to progress without spending actual dollars. To progress in the treasure map part of the game is also too hard, costing 50 energy plus to remove an object so remove two and you're out of energy. There's also too much going on, too many 'attractions' to build and not enough space.

I would like it but to difficult to get anywhere hardly. Cant buy the really neat things for Halloween because one, hard to earn cash bucks in the game so I can't decorate my town for Halloween. Disappointed on that one. Don't like how it takes so long to get anything done. Still trying to play the game. It seems like a great game but I don't know yet. The Halloween theme looks really cute.

I really love this game. I have been playing for almost 5yrs now and it's a great time killer. I hate the way they changed the zoo, and the fact that you only get animal cards as rewards. I have ALOT of animals without enclosures because that's ALL you really get anymore.every prize has a few cards with it. Can we get some decorations for our town? At the very least with the side games like we used to? Overall I think it's a really great game 😁 work in progress 👍 Empire City 😎

It's a fun game at first then the mini game gets ridiculously hard at times to where you have to play the same level 100 times or more (no exaggeration), there becomes a constant battle with the barn over being too full to the point of utter frustration, and then of course there are glitches in the game but don't bother to contact support, once you finally get past all the prompted answers that aren't your issue at all but you must pick one to advance, they're no help at all, but hey no ads.

I play this game all the time and it runs well. so why 3 stars? the developers want you to build your city and you can't reach certain levels without certain requirements. you purchase buildings for example. but you need lots glass to complete. how do you get glass? sending trains. but oh no not that easy...you rarely get glass and there are other things that require glass. they want you to play but they don't want you to succeed without spending hundreds of dollars.

Filled with too many mini games (candy crush style) and ultimately trying to do too much. Don't get sucked in with the ads for the tractor or corn collecting, you get to play that once or twice and then almost never see it again. Could be a much better game simplifying it to a little township that you can expand but ultimately winds up trying to do everything and goes down too many different avenues to suck your time and money.

This game is all about money. All side games used to be fun. The aerial, snowboarding, fishing, and others I've forgotten. Now replaced with impossible games made that can't be passed without helps, which are hard to get, or TCASH, which cost money to buy. Why are you so money hungry? It is hard to get money to pay for speed passes, then be frustrated not to be able to pass levels due to the greed of game makers with impossible to pass side games without spending money. Don't play this game!

In the beginning it was time consuming and slow to advance. Now at level 56 it's too complicated to play and it is more time consuming. You are limited from the beginning on how many items you can have which makes it harder to play. As I said, it is too much time consuming but it is adictive game. I spent a lot of money trying to advance on those 2-3 $ purchases. I probably spent more than $150 for which I could have bought 2 PC games.

Not as advertised. Shows puzzles in ads, but you spend almost all of your time building / maintaining a farm community. For about 4 hours on the app, you may get 1 time to play the puzzle. I thought if I played more, or leveled up, it would offer more puzzles as per the ads; it did not. Also, you are eventually put into a place of where you have to spend real world money, or not play due to timers.

Used to be a great game. Then, they got greedy and absolutely RUINED THE GAME. I've played this game for years, spending more money on it than Icare to admit. But, I didn't mind because the game seemed fair. You could make progress in the regatta without having to constantly pass levels. Then, the "brain trust" in charge decided to COMPLETELY CHANGE THE BASICS OF THE REGATTA, engaging most of their long-time customers. WAY TO GO! I won't spend another dime until it's changed back.

There's a setting for verifying that you want to spend cash (in game currency) but it doesn't apply to everything. For instance, the puzzle matching is a part of the game you'll be participating in a lot... Run out of moves and a pop up comes up that is easy to miss hit and it'll spend your currency when you didn't want to! It's deceptive to have such a setting but not apply it to everything in the game. Updated after the developer reply. What a pathetic answer. Its deceptive!

This is a good game that you can play and come back to you don't have to sit there the whole time. I only give the game three stars I think it needs some improvements. I would have two Barnes, 1 for product 1 for produce. The player could then upgrade whichever one was needed separately In the Regatta the point spread are too close need some with higher value. Honestly The cost compared to what you get is just higher than any other game I've ever played. Upgreads are for them$$$$.

In one of the side games, the helicopter special tool whirlygig thing only works if made during game play. If gifted, won, or purchased, they just fly away without any effect at the beginning of the round. This is my second time playing this game on a new account... neither account had them working at the beginning of a round. So... I'm a little surprised it has not been noticed or fixed... Still broken... some people pay money in this game. You need to fix the helicopters in the side game.

Edit (02-17-21): I used to love this game but after playing for a few years, ive noticed it is starting to get more and more greedy! In order to get anywhere in the internal events now you have to get your wallet out ALOT. If I spend a ton of money renovating a room I should atleast be able to keep my progress at the end even if I didnt finish! This game is so much less enjoyable than it used to be! Boooooo

This game is great, with a few minor setbacks, I have been playing this game for a while, but every time I've gotten close to achieving the harvest 400 fields in 10min. It won't let me! It keeps saying I'm not close when I got the lab boost ×2 harvests, and I don't like that I have collected over 600 wheat w/ the ×2 boost. Not the 1st time either! Please fix that. Thanks.

I've been playing for years now and finally getting over this game for a number of reasons. 1.) There use to be a way you could exchange certain things for cash but now it's all about spending money on all sorts of challenges. 2.) This game should give out free cash depending on your playing status. 3.) The Race of Champions is a BIG waste of time 4.) What ever happen to the crop and items challenge

I was about to download the game to check if like the others, it is false advertisement, but, while reading the reviews I've decided to skip that part and cancel the installment. I believe if these developers have the knowledge to create the environment they advertise as a game, they should since puzzles is much more interesting then "building your own town." I have animal crossing for that.

After a while it becomes difficult to fulfill orders as there are so many items you can craft, but 1. There isn't enough space in the barn to hold one of everything, or even half that 2. Production times can take up to an hour for certain items. If you want to even complete a task in the regatta, let alone place, you can't play casually.

I like playing this game but the only complaints that I have are is space for the barn. You have to share the space for the suppiles and resources. If the supplies had it's own seperate space it would be easier to upgrade and build your town. Also my second suggestion is that players should be able to join a co-op at level 5 or even level 10, instead of having to wait till level 19 to be able to join one.

nice game but it is taking very long time to develop the city. The museum seems useless since you will never get the township money even after collecting piece after piece. And the zoo has no chance to get developed as well since the last update (very disappointing, it was easier before). You struggle to collect animal cards and they are never enough to get a new animal. You basically struggle a lot in this game and it doesnt feel like making progresses

I'm changing my review to 1 star from 5 stars. I've been playing this game for almost 5 years now. When I first started it was great, but as time has progressed this game has become not so great. It's costing way too much money (personal money) to play these games, events, and mini games. They've also connected the mini games to events (like the professor event) so you have to pay even more money to win prizes or finish the games. (Like having to remodel) Also, there are way too many updates.

Very slow progress. Waiting time is too high to build. Keep you away from the game. Waiting time should be not more than 30 min for any items. Cash and Coins should have been bit easy to get so we can keep playing game for long time. Graphics are really good. But map and buildings placement needs to be 360° movement. Hopefully improvement is in next update.

It's a great game, if you like games where the option is wait or spend real-llfe $$ to speed things up. It's awfully pretty; the graphics are great, and the events are engaging. But remember, the entire game is built on timers. Want to get stuff created faster? $$ Want stuff to arrive faster? $$ Want to make reasonable event progress? $$ When I got to level 60 and started building the planetarium - only to be told I needed the tool exchange (4 bricks for 1 electric saw per hour)! No. Just no.

If you don't mind the time it takes to gather supplies to build things if you are a f2p than it is an alright game. Sadly, buying township cash (in game currency) is one of those not worth the amount things where buying a 'lot' for a high price can maybe get you 2 buildings if you have enough supplies already. And it gets boring pretty quickly with repetitive events and rewards.

Overall the game itself is fun. I've been playing for 4 years. More land expansions & new animals & enclosures for the zoo would be nice for those of us who have been loyal gamers. The In-Games are fun, but, they seem to all be set up so that if you fail you have to spend money to continue on. I've decided to stop all the In-Games. If you want to keep up, you absolutely have to spend money regardless of what newbies say. The higher level you get, the more you find yourself spending.

This game used to be fun, but now it's boring and repetitive. Expanding the main game takes too long to gather the necessary resources. The side quests WERE good, but now you need to spend real money to complete them because the allotted time is too short, and every 2nd or 3rd match-3 level is hard or very hard. The merge mini-games are a pain in the arse to play; they're frustrating because it's all pseudo-random luck to get the needed items to advance rather than skill. Don't waste your money!

The in game mini game glitched, after paying for the golden ticket. I can't get anyone from the "contact us" to answer any concerns I have. Besides waiting all day for no one to respond, the mini games use real money and no one wants to be accountable for any system failures. I've been playing for over 2 years, and this game has really gone downhill! I used to enjoy the game and do enjoy the seasonal events (not every month)...but this game is turning into another waste of money. 😠

This game is great fun but be aware if you spend money, they find ways to take it. This Hammer side game tells you if you finish the challenge it will give you a prize. Many people did not receive the prize and they completed the challenge. There are also multiple issues with the downloads, whether you on a mobile device, PC or laptop and moving from one to another. Don't expect to be able to do it. It tells you to save your game with a connection to FaceBook. I believe thayt is a way to collect your data and money. The website shows the are out of Ireland but the FB pages have a high number of Russian members.

I have been playing this game for over 3 years now. It needs to have more ways to expand. All of my stuff is in a very small area bc it is difficult to expand and expensive. The higher the levels get the more you have to pay to build. It makes it not fun anymore. And a side note, the explosive puzzles sometimes are really hard to beat. I like playing the game but I wish it had more ways to earn dollars so you can build more. And more expansion cards, they should more available to get.

It's a decent game. had fun for the first 20 levels I played. It is NOT what was advertised, though, in the ads I watched. I want that game... The one where the person is running around and grabbing the eggs to sell to the customers then they grab the money to buy tomatoes to expand their produce line. I played one like that once (my mart or something like that with a little blue humanoid) This game is more about building a city and playing mini games to pass the time as your crops grow.

Was a great game up until a year or so ago. Too many glitches. I can never collect my regatta prizes without being kicked out of the entirely and have to Uninstall/reinstall several times. Greed has taken its ugly toll as well. Side games, now connected to the regatta are expensive. Nothing for long time players to do either. Has gotten extremely boring and expensive. It makes me sad.

Worst company to download from! Waste of time! I'd give 0 stars but they won't let me post until I give them at least one. I press play on the game where you slide the bars to accomplish tasks. I download. I open. I am tricked into downloading a game that makes me run a farm. It won't let me click on anything other than the tutorial it's forcing me to go through or the exit. This is the second time I have downloaded a game from this company & was tricked into running a farm. I am uninstalling.

I have loved this game for 2yrs! However, this last two weeks have been a nightmare. Everytime I try to go into the Regatta I get kicked out of the entire game and loose progress. I have uninstalled, reinstalled, restarted my phone and tablet, cleared cache and made sure my devices had the enquired setting for the game as tech support advised. Still, that has not worked. This has happened in the past and tech support has fixed it before but now they said it's my device. So disappointed 😞

It's a good game and very fun. Good that devs are updating with new activities. ONe thing missing for users convenience is, the factories and farms should have an option to move from one from another. Such as, having arrow buttons left and right side. So the players won't waste much time looking for each factories And farms which also is annoying. This kind of feature have in several other farm games. Township should really look into this.

Still agree but it is fun. I just don't worry about the Zoo. The habitats cost too much! I don't like the new Zoo!!!! It is harder to get the animals and habitats. The trading for building materials is the dumbest upgrade ever. I'd rather have the mint!!! I can tell you are trying to get players to spend money. I WILL NOT SPEND MONEY ON THIS GAME. PLEASE MAKE THE BUILDINGS CHEAPER AND EASIER TO COMPLETE.

Changed my review down because of the repetitive games. Problems with mini-games not playing correctly and then losing your progress. Needing to buy a lot of t-cash if you want to move up. Issues with new updates causing problems with game playing correctly. They say every time that they know about the problem and they're "working on it". Hasn't been fixed for several months.

Listen the game is fun, there's lot to do and no ads. But some of these puzzle levels are stupid hard for no reason. I understand wanting a challenge but good god it shouldn't take a week or more to beat one of the "super hard" levels. I'm convinced the only way to beat these are to spend money on powers ups and I'm not about to drop a bunch of money. I've been stuck on level 370 and it's making progression in the event impossible, and it turn making the game not fun. Please fix this.

Ive been playing this game for over 2 years now and I like it but some things need to change. It takes forever to build in the zoo because you need a lot of building material and you dont receive that much from the train. It also shouldnt cost building material to get the tools from that one. On the plane at times it ask for a lot of one item when it takes nearly all day just to make that item and if you need a certain crop then that takes forever too.

I have been a loyal player for 6 years. PLEASE do a different mini game! I truly miss the merging one, the ski & fish & even the goofy makeup game. I can't express how many of my team members feel this way too. Also, $10 for the golden ticket is pricey! I've spent hundreds on this game and didn't mind paying the $5 but $10 is too much, especially when you started out with 30 days and now it's down to only 19 days. PLEASE PLEASE figure out a different mini game! I will bring back to 5 stars...

Fantastic game, always something to do in the town. Regatta is always a great way to earn extras. I wish there was a way to commit building supplies to the community buildings though. Instead of waiting until you have all the bricks, glass, power tools and such, it would be awesome if you were able to "deposit" them once you hit the single item's limit instead of having to wait to have the total for the whole building. That's my only complaint though. It's a genuine joy to play.

Used to be a great game, FUN to play with lots of different mini-games and weekly events. NO LONGER!! Though not easy, you could progress and win the mini-games with time. So I used to spend a small amount of REAL money to support the game. But they have now made most aspects of the game so difficult it forces players to spend real money to progress and win. Since it's become very apparent that all the developers care about is making money, I will be deleting this game very soon!!

I Played this game till I reached level 76. Was a leader of a golden league co-op. All I can say is that this game requires you to invest a lot of time if u want to advance. Rewards are decreasing and mini games are impossible to pass without spending a lot of T cash, which means purchasing T cash with real money. The mini game series are repetitive and have become boring. Most of all when you reach out to support for help, they take days to get back to you and don't even solve the complaint.

Absolutely love this game. It has actually been the one and only game that I have actually kept up with for an amount of time. I think it is a five star rating but i put four stars because you should be able to get or attain Township bucks more often. You get to a point you are stuck and witjout cash you cant upgrade your barn and stuff. This makes it where ppl have to spend an amount of money over and over. But i keep spending.. Lol...

Too many game crashes when trying to do special events. I did all suggested troubleshoots, in game & email support. Nothing. Other players in Co op group say the same problem. Game itself is fun but if you want to do the extra stuff in Co op be aware it's a shot in the dark if you're going to be one that can access it. I spend alot of money in this game (my choice not a game must) it sucks that I'll most likely just delete it because of this.

After the updated version the game lost some appealing option play. The ingots were usable in creative ways like making more money but then they took the bank away. Then you were able to use them to create special decorations if you dig enough through the mines and create bars through the foundry. But they also took that feature away and now you have to use gems to build and you rarely get those by plane or mine. The ingots are now useless and only for upgrading trains, restaurants and farm which is not even noticeable. At level 5 my train still takes 4 hours to return. I don't think people would mind spending a little but by taking all these features away it makes you lose interest after awhile.

This game is SO fun, & it always keeps me busy! At level 19 you can create your own co-op/join a co-op, u can compete in regattas, have friends, there's so much to do!! I gave this game 4 stars bc there's one thing that bothers me...CONSTANT UPDATES! I know it has to change for certain reasons, but it updates about every 2-3 months and it gets so annoying bc half the time I don't have the space, & the app store won't let me update it. Other than that, it definitely keeps u entertained!! :D

Love the game other than you have to basically spend money if you want to get the quests done on time. The cash should be cheaper and the piggy bank seems to go away and then come back randomly. I like the piggy bank, but the prices for fake cash is crazy. And the amount of cash things cost is also a bit much. I get that the game needs to make $, but there should be more sales and it should be cheaper. Other than that, it's cute and is like a mix of farm town, the sims, and garden scapes.

I quit the game, at least temporarily. The regattas are enjoyable, but became a constant mini game. There used to be a break in between. Now, not so much. Whatever happened to the other mini games? There where so many. What happened to the co-op mayoral champion race ?(forgot the name). So for me it became monotonous. I used to buy the golden ticket all the time plus purchase some township cash. No more. Maybe I'll save money.

Another false advertisement!!! I seen an ad where a guy is escaping prison and you can choose a tool or whatever to help him along the way. That WOULD HAVE BEEN FUN. I installed this game, thought I even had the wrong game because it's NOTHING like the ad. It's a stupid farming game, nothing like in the ad. I even still have it a chance but it's too boring and slow. Make a game like in the ad. That would be fun.

I enjoy playing Township very much. I like the challenge of planning and coordinating all the different elements in order to fill an "order." I don't like my in game money locked up behind a paywall. Please fix this. 12/8/21 I have decided to go ahead and play anyway even though there are some elements that I do not enjoy. Gumball/apple game is fun, but way too many red sticky wedges. They are discouraging. Also, please don't require the same raw materials for two finished products.

I've been playing this game for almost 4 years now. I love the professor challenge. But... I think it's absolutely ridiculous that you give us such a hard challenge at the very end! Collecting paint cans?? Wow really?!! We have absolutely no control over how many paint cans the game gives.. So this makes it impossible to finish and open the safe, unless you spend more money!!!! After already paying for the gold pass.. I SHOULD NOT HAVE TO SPEND MORE MONEY!!!

I loved this game for a long time. It's getting harder to keep up the factories and other buildings now. I never have enough coins for more than one every couple months. I can't grow my town without these buildings. We need cheaper buildings, or more coins. Also the tool exchange is sorta dumb. Send more variety of supplies on the trains and make them exchangeable between co-op members. I would return to the game if it was easier to keep up and less of a headache to build things.

The game is something to pass time with. I like playing it, except it's a huge money trap. It takes hours for some crops grow and materials to load. It may take you a day to complete one order unless you spend money for upgrades. I went down to 3 stars. Call y'all make the waiting time for crops and stuff a little lower? 5 hours for something to grow is crazy! You spend $4.99 on a gold pass just to have the benefits for like less than a month. Idk just wish that would fix this.

I've been playing it for nearly 7 yrs now. Used to be my favorite, with various mini-games (not all great but you could always look forward to the good ones in the future). Now it is all about leading players to spend money! The only mini-games are related to the map adventures (so boring), the new regatta ìs stupid... I've devoted a lot of time and money to this game and that is the only reason I don't give up on it. So sad! Gave one star because I can't give ZERO.

Needs to have a separate place for building materials. The game is fun but if you can't store you crops and food that you need then it becomes more work then fun to play. The game allows you to help friends but only with crops or food. You can not exchange build materials or other needed items. The zoo takes to long to build with the exhibits and animals.

Normally I absolutely adore this game, but it's very pricey and takes forever to install things. Not to mention with the new event, the level I'm currently on is literally impossible without spending money I don't have on it. It's 25 moves to clear 30- some boxes and get 20- some photos, something I've spent tireless hours on. Please make your game good again.

As seems to be the case these days, the game is nothing like the ad. No, the devs have not made a 3rd person isometric farming sim, they've made a glacially paced city building game, and then marketed it as both the above and some sort of idle business tycoon game because those seem popular at the moment. And whilst there are no ads, unless you can spend 10 mins every hour or so throughout the day, to make any meaningful progress, you're going to have to buy in game currency constantly.

This used to be a fun game. I have been playing for nearly 3 years now but for the last 3 months or so everytime a regatta is over my game crashes and I have to clear my cache,uninstall, and reinstall my game in order for it to work. They continue to charge for a golden ticket @ 4.99 but they cannot fix this problem. Also after a certain level you just do the same thing over and over again. You can't expand your town anymore... what a waste.

This game started out really good but now I am seeing the packages for money change. The sale special during an event has increased from 15 or 10 a pack to 20, 25, and 31 dollars. It also seems now that every other week there is a special event going on that requires you to spend money. I am considering stop playing this game. I've also reached the level where I can't add anymore to the town itself.

This game used to have a large variety of minigames to play which made it very fun, but a year ago, they stopped every 1 except match 3. That's when it got boring, especially cuz their match 3 game is broken in too many ways to list, and they've gotten harder so that now there's no difference between easy and super hard. Now its just frustrating and boring. Every change in the last year was made to turn this game into a money grab. If you like match3, I recommend candy crush or royal match.

I played this years ago and like all my games, I stopped randomly and then came back. 1, the previous game did not sync or stay available for me to jump right back where I left off. I had to start all over again. 2, this is a pay-to-progress game. Yes, you can get away with not spending real $, but you will be stuck on some aspects of the game for weeks while waiting to have enough resources to progress.

Fun, addictive game. but this game becomes very expensive once you play at higher levels . And the game cheats as you do more expensive purchasing. For example, even though you get new building supplies with shipments that you send out on your train, you never really have enough to complete improvements to allow you to have higher populations, you wind up buying more game cash with real money. and there is no game support from within the game. Users are ignored by the support.

Horrible game. Nothing like the ad that I was forced to watch a thousand times during another game. After completing a number of levels, you are forced to buy township dollars to be able to continue at any pace. Update 18 months after 1st review. Still playing, hate that it costs me money or I would be getting nowhere. Join a co-op and play the regattas, its fun. 3 is because of cost of the game to make it playable.

Pretty great, if u like these types of games. Love that getting the premium in-game currency isn't a job and a half of its own, like most other apps. If you're not a fast spender, it's almost natural to build up cash. Being able to join co-ops makes it even better, because you can help each other out, which is fun. Caution: due to the unique feature of being able to choose what notifications you receive, if you check off all of them, it spams ur phone lol

I use to love playing this game. Now it's hard to want to keep playing. I know the levels are supposed to be harder as you go but it's near impossible to beat these levels without needing to spend money. I've been stuck on most of these hard/super hard levels for DAYS!! playing multiple times per day. I'm on 2825 & have been stuck 3 days now. I've used multiple power-ups & 5 T cash 3 times. Also the latest boat race I can't collect xolor pieces or power-ups to finish task unless I beat the level

A lot of fun, but there's one big problem. The barn. It is really bothersome when you are trying to collect crops or animal products and you simply can't. It interrupts everything and makes it frustrating to play. I would sell my goods to free up some room, but I've realized that that method is not very profitable. Maybe you could make the beginning storage 100 instead of 50. That would definitely help. Other than that, it's a fun city builder (although not super realistic).

It sucks!! After reaching a high level, which took forever, I was blocked from playing the game and got a notification on the screen that I was "cheating" in the game or some mess like that!! How can you cheat in a game?! Then when I was given access back to the game, it was reset to level 1 and yes I linked my fb account and it still did the same thing. Customer service was of no help!! STAY AWAY FROM THIS GAME!!

this game is fun and the co ops are great! BUT buildings are too expensive. the zoo is taking forever to build because not only do you have to buy them but then you have to build them!! the land expansions are super hard to get as well.... the trains and air planes take forever to come back so do the boats and the dealer takes an hr break after each request so when you pay to get him for a day you technically get him for 12 hrs it would not be so bad if the cost was not as much

This is a TERRIBLE game. It's nothing like the ads! Plus it's a bunch of RNG to get what you need to upgrade your barn to store thing. I've sent off over 20 trains to try to get what I need and I'm still almost 20 items away (trains bring 3-5 items you may need to build buildings). It's a time sink but a terribly designed one. Don't spend any money to support this garbage.

I was sooooooo hooked on this game in the beginning. Now that I am on forty something level, I realize it takes waaaay to long to obtain construction materials; which delays expansion. Yes, there are plenty of opportunities to receive them, but majority of them require town cash (your money).I don't want to spend tons of money just to enjoy the game at a normal speed. This will be another game I lose interest in and eventually delete.

Good concept, poor execution. Fun graphics & tasks but in-game cash is ridiculously expensive & doesn't last long if you do buy it. The point is to make players keep spending their real money but it won't help you level up much faster. Also the system seems to know what tools/products you are most in need of & specifically makes them more rare to acquire until after prolonged periods of time. This again is done to lure you into constantly buying in-game dollars just to advance to the next level.

This game was pretty addicting at first, but with their latest update, they've completely ruined the main co-op feature (the regatta). They've taken away all of the themed decorations, offering more paltry consumables at exorbitant prices instead, and requiring you to fully beat a mini-game level for anything you did to count. (And those levels get hard FAST!) Plus they dramatically increased the energy costs in the event. Honestly, I'm considering uninstalling. It's just not what it used to be.

Came to this from a cool playable ad...but the ad is false advertisement, as the actual game is NOTHING like the ad!! Companies need to stop with that bait and switch level of foolishness...if I see something advertised and I decide to install it and try it, it'd damn well better be the product they're advertising!! (Ex.: it took them a few years, but the developers of Hero Wars have FINALLY added in the math-like gameplay - to some extent - that you see in the ads all the time)

I have played the game for years. At first it was really fun and I gave it 5. Now I am maxed out on town expansions and zoo expansions. I can't give town expansion materials to co-op members. Now you have to pay 4.99 every 2 weeks get better task rewards. The thing that annoys me the most is the mini-games that are required to progress. I have been stuck at the same level for at least 12+ times trying. The game should cycle and give another mini game challenge after so many times of trying.

This main game is decent and pretty well polished. A few things that make me never want to open the app again. 1) there are sooo many pop ups that can't be avoided. Been away for a few days, it's going to take a full minute before you can even do anything. 2) it forces you to open up the real money store to buy a ticket for whatever boring "seasonal" content is going on. 3) it forces you to open up the other boring side game and click out before you can skip. 4) annoying pay to win mechanics.

2nd review. After playing this game for several years I find that it is still fun to play. I'm not progressing very fast - I'm only at level 81. It is entirely possible to play this game without purchasing a lot of InApp. Purchases. I only purchase the gold passes. There's several ways to get Township cash. I don't find much use for it except to upgrade factories. You don't need it for the mini games either. Just get better at playing the games - after all, they're repeated enough times.

I am one of those who got misled by the advertisement and end up playing the game. I have played games that has in-app purchases and its upto you to choose if you want to buy those additional items to progress the game faster. In this game, these guys actually have a concept of piggy bank, which saves (takes all the dollars) money that you earn from delivery (max is 135) and once it's full, then the only way to get your saved cash back is to pay $2.99. This is cheating! Zero star.

Very limited growth early on. I've learned they push you to use your money to progress by making things overly difficult and resources very limited. Even the mini games get extremely unrealistic without spending money for the perks. Could have a load of potential if they cared about the players and not the dollar sign. Sad to see this. You'd think they'd know the better the game, the better the profit, honestly. It's simple. Un-installed...

The game is great, developing your town and helping you co-op. But the ads are nothing like the real game. There is an event center where you can play a tile game, merge game, and adventure game, but there used to be a lot more stuff that was way more fun. Farther in the game, things get way too expensive. And like I said earlier, the ads are not the actual game, and the mini games them selves suck, they are way to easy and short. I completed one in 15 seconds and they don't come that much.

First of all, it's not like in the ads. Second, while yes, there are no ads in the gameplay, the way the game is designed is to really push you to use real money to keep the game engaging. For now I'm enjoying the game, but I just know this will end soon. Perhaps the developers can add a "watch ads for rewards" system, where you can CHOOSE to watch an ad to get a reward, instead of using real money.

I wasnt sure about this game at first, but its def great. the last 2 updates have been dumb. changing how to build up your town is stupid and takes forever. but the fact that you can easily get game cash and stuff is great. I also wasnt sure about this co-op thing, but I've found a great one. makes this game very enjoyable. tho, itd be nice if we had more than 24 hrs between regatta things.

The game is a good game, I really do like it. However, you spend more money on in game purchases than you actually get back from this game. I believe you can also implement some towncash rewards when you win a level in the side game attached to it. This way we will feel more motivated to play the side game Hope my suggestion can be taken into consideration. Also, the construction items like the tools are too hard to get that it takes a while before you can complete a Community building etc.

Something has gone wrong with the new update. I used to be able to start making items in one of the factories and get up in the morning or look back at it later and the products are there. Now, I start the items and go back and they aren't there but the supplies to used to create them are gone. It also requires more supplies now to acquire land. The supply list are becoming too long. Was slightly addicted, thanks for messing it up and making it less appealing.

I used to Love this game. I've been a player for over 3 yrs and recently I have started to not play the game anymore due to the regatta changing, the same puzzle games that are hard to pass unless you spend money. There are no more fun games, no decorations, and the land expansion is only during updates. The creators got greedy and ruin a great thing.

Updates SUCK!!! I played hell getting the last update installed. I cancelled and restarted it many more times than I even remember, ultimately I uninstalled and reinstalled the game and hated doing it for fear of losing progress because I have seen somewhere that is possible, I wasn't even sure that was going to work but it did FINALLY. It caused me huge panic attacks because of the events that had just started that i was losing time on completing tasks and such. Please fix it.

Not a bad game. I like that there are different parts of the game you can go to when waiting on something. But on the colored 'tile' game it drives me crazy how stupid the propellers are. There will be a rocket and a propeller going off with two squares needed, the rocket will clear one, and the propeller then goes to the same space thay was just cleared instead of the one remaining space needed or make other similarly bad decisions. Way worse than other, similar games in that respect.

The game starts out fun when you learn the mechanics but as the game gets progressively more difficult and there's more stations and buildings free to manage and different products to make with different assortments of produce, the game feels more like a job than a game to me... More a liability than fun...the game itself is really nothing wrong with it it's what it entails...but I play games to have fun not learn about item management.

I used to like this game, but I lost all respect for the developers after seeing their fake advertisements. False advertising to boost your downloads is just sketchy and disappointing. The ads have nothing to do with the actual game. Why not make a frogger-type game, or a choose-the-right-tool-to-fix-the-broken-thing game? Those would be easier to code than the actual game you made! Honestly, I'll never install another one of your games again. I hope others catch on too!

When I first started I really enjoyed this game and would have given a 5 star but the further I get the harder it is to save moneys to buy for the zoo and other buildings. Then this tool exchange came along at level 58 and I thought it might me good for my storage but "NOT"!!! I used the tools once and the last 2 buildings asked for all old supplies that were tied up in the new tools... I spend real money once a month but still doesn't help.

Update: Wow, how things change. I changed my review to 1 star, which pains me to do. I've played this game almost every day for 5 years, and just hit 900 days straight a few days ago. But it's clear the devs don't care as much as they used too. The last update I got was broken and made my game slower, and I didn't get any expansions. The only game I've played like this that I've played longer than a week. It's addicting and very fun to assemble your farm. Definitely worth getting!

Very addictive. If I have any down time I pull out my phone and pull up this game. I have a tough time putting it down. Recently, our co-op and team members are running into MAJOR GLITCHES in the game. Very frustrating. I contacted the developers website as well as the help/support offered in the game. Don't bother contacting technical support it's a waste of time. Another update - more glitches. Time to look for another game.

it is a fun game if your into basics. Progress is way too slow which forces you to buy in-app purchases. sometimes when you collect prizes they aren't accounted for or collecting materials grown or made. the worst part is when there is a technical error that takes basically all your money and then says they will not reimburse it. Unbelievable I would not recommend this game to anybody. I have been playing this game for 4 months straight spending real money, terrible service. Save your money!

Started playing because my wife was into it and it was a decent casual game at first. After a few levels you reach a point where it is nearly impossible to continue moving forward unless you spend real money, and it seems as if each update make it harder to play (aka make you want to actually spend real dinero)... Everything gets more expensive the more you level up but you get the same (if not less) money for your orders and less and less barn space for upgrades. Pretty bad game overall...

VERY DISAPPOINTED! This game was so much fun when it first came out in 2006 but has consistently gone down hill and fast. First, I hate that I have to update the game every season just to keep up with whatever holiday happens to be. Next, the freezing and glitching and too many other technical issues to list. Then, to be required to download an update that will not download, And finally, I hate that I can't get a refund for an in game purchase being that I can't get in the game to play.

Don't waste your time or money. The game had a glitch and after I spent money on the game to finish a mini game, they "fixed" the glitch by starting it over, taking the money I spent, in game purchases and never giving me the reward for finishing. They are thieves! This game is a ripoff! They make mini games impossible to complete without spending a lot of money. The game is not fun anymore! Beware!

This game is stupid. I downloaded it because I got to play a 1 minute sample as an ad on another app. In the ad game, you play a woman running around to collect corn, then eggs, you make money within seconds and hire people. It was fast-paced and simple. This game is nothing like that. It's like Sim City but farming. Slow-paced and WAY too many objectives and menus and tutorials. No thanks.

Update 2025-04-03. There was just another update and its gotten even worse. Playrix just wants money from you. If you want a game you can't progress in without spending lots of money, this is it!! Been playing for over 4 years. It's become a money grab and all based on a block game...all the variety and fun has left. Now it seems playrix is only interested in getting your money instead of supplying fun.

Really fun game. There's always something to keep up with, feeding the animals, planting and harvesting crops, and building things, expanding your town. That said, it's nothing like advertised, and that feels like false advertising. I would love to pay the game as advertised. If you can create the advertisement, can't you create the game just like it? I'd still play this game, too! I wanna run around with a load of cash and eggs strapped to my back, please and thanks!

This game used to be fun, seriously thinking about quitting it after almost three years of daily play. The regattas are all repeats, nothing new, no incentive to play. The professor game provided minimal incentives, with unrealistic tasks. All members of my co-op refuse to pay for the gold pass next time, just not worth it. Finally the number of tools (bricks, dry wall and windows) is a joke when I don't need them anymore. Time for a renewal of the game, maybe time to say goodbye.😞

I loved this game at first. But now I'm at level 37, each task takes so long to complete, that it just isn't fun any more. Who wants to wait 12 hours for plant to grow, 8 hours for a ship to come back, or 2 days for a building to be done? On top of that, the game is structured to create shortages. The developers want you to spend real money to buy Township cash to speed things up or buy items. And the bonuses you get are pathetically small. It's not playable w/out spending $$$. I'm done.

I've been playing this game for a couple of days now. Really enjoyed it at first, until now, where you are stuck waiting on constructions to be finished...and some buildings need supplies to finish them. Good luck with getting those supplies. You can either wait and hope they come in on the train or use your real money to buy the items. The game basically forces you to pay to win. The match 3 is fun until you spend all day on one level and you can't get past it. Do Not Recommend!

Been playing this game for 3 years I love it except the mini games are a lot harder now. It makes you not want to play them and it sucks when some of them are part of regatta tasks.im specifically talking about the bejeweled type game. I'll continue playing but I wish they would make them easier because it just becomes frustrating. I've told friends to join this game and they've spent money as have I, but if you spend money you don't get 'free cash' from the helicopters

Seems that Playrix has a theme of lying in their ads. You grow stuff, make stuff and fill orders. Then you expand to make more stuff. There is no choice based things that come up. No overturned truck that you have to help like they show in the images advertising for the game. I had uninstalled previously and reinstalled just to confirm and see if there was an update to include this. There's not. Good game to use up lots of time, but that's it. Really dull after you get to set up...

I played for years, stopped & then returned a bit ago. I wish they had left some things alone. The # tools & supplies needed for community buildings (police station, etc.) is now ridiculous! The amount of time u have to wait for things to be built is way too long. Unless u want to spend cash of course. Events are non-stop which keeps the game exciting but u never seem to have enough supplies. Unless u spend cash of course. I will update to 5* when certain aspects are more free play friendly.

Very fun. I enjoy it very much on the road. I like how you can design your own town and make money. There is hardly any waiting in building unlike most games but every thing else takes to long, I get tired of waiting. I wish it was offline. The graphics need to be better. I wanna see my people go in and out of buildings. I hate how hard it is to get supplies and the town money. I cant zoom out all the way and that bothers me very much, I wanna see my whole town at once. Hope this helped.

I love town building games and games that you can maintain / play over a long period of time. Everything about this game is great expect for how hard it is to get bucks. The game really wants you to buy them in order to get certain things done. I wish it was eaiser to come across them or basic tasks did not cost so much to use them. Other than that it is a cute little time waster which is exactly what I'm looking for.

Too much grinding is needed to get anywhere on higher levels when it comes to building things. Minigames are boring and repetitive. Nothing exciting or new has been added. You need coins to build, and they keep reducing ways to get coins in the game, other than having to pay money for them. As a result of the focus on the mini game, this game has lost its original intent and now is more like a downgrade of 'candy crush'. Game is not fun anymore, so I've uninstalled it.

I downloaded it for the game I saw on the ad, and the real game isn't like that at all. this game is all about waiting to make progress and having the right supplies. Even at very early stages, the game is hella impossible to make progress in (as a way to force you to spend real money to progress faster, I suppose). I can't even begin to imagine it at higher levels... uninstalled.

I love this game. However, I no longer play due to unfair play in puzzles! I spent 5 days on one level, allowing 15 moves. I received only 7 points after beating it! You don't give enough moves for the mini puzzles and not enough rewards after spending multiple days on a puzzle! When in a quest the chest, you have to spend green cash on, your prize is usually money! I feel it should be a prize you can use in the puzzle to help you further your game! It is very hard to accumulate green cash!

The graphics are cute and the game is overall a great idea and it could be really fun to play...... BUT the key word here is COULD be fun!! The problem with this game is that the game play is so slow that I get so bored I'd almost rather watch paint dry!! Buying anything to speed the game up and make it worth playing would cost a pretty penny. WAAAAAAAY TOO EXPENSIVE!!! It's sad too because it could have been a 5 star game if you could play without having to wait hours or spend a ton of money!

I played this for about a month, and it seemed like a promising game with a bit of variety. However my big problem is that twice I paid for a package that was supposed to include in game money and other bonuses, but I never got anything. I tired Google's suggestions, but it didn't work and they wouldn't refund me. While it was only $4 I lost, I like a game that actually gives me what I purchase... so I'm done with this game.

Great game for creativity and interaction with other players. I really love it but I walked away because huge demands for minor products meant I was going to have to dump many more valuable items that I spent more time and sometimes real money to acquire. (because all items must go thru the limited space given to you in your 'barn' (storage). I learned that sending unfilled planes caused a cascade of problems for building progress.)

Editing from 5 to 1. Overall been playing for 8 years. All was good up until the introduction of the golden pass. Free to play skins were quickly removed, decorations for events were removed and the game has become dull. The devs are leeching the in game currency (T-cash) with the only 3 remaining mini games that are made for you to play up to 40-50% completion, then become drastically hard in order to spend. Oh and dont bother with support, they never reply either on any of the above points.

Love the game. The side games are annoying though. If it could be just a farming game building a farm, growing food, factories, the mine, shipping product by train, plane, helicopter and keeping ships going to the islands and have to build a huge town/city just a small country town it would be so much better. I would give it 5 stars in that case.

Update: I have lowered my review to one star. Shame on the makers of this game!!! I've been playing this game for several years now. It's a nice, casual game to play. My biggest complaint and disappointment has been that the mini-games are no longer worth playing because unless you spend real money and have a ton of township cash to waste, they're too difficult. Very disappointed in the makers of this game. They're ruining it, especially for those of us that have played for a long time.

It's not a bad game to pass the time. But I don't like how much everything costs to expand and build. I'm having a hard time making any gold or cash because everything costs so much so I'm stuck. I've bought more gold and more cash from offers and packages and it was a waste. The real money cost to purchase more gold/cash is too much for the amount you get on the game. Games stop being fun if you have to make real money purchases to keep up.

Time to delete at level 41. I just wanted a farming game. I hate the match 3 and whatever the "adventure" game is.. it is repetitive, boring, and doesn't contribute to the farm production. I like the idea of a coop (for helping and competing together) but more than 1/2 the tasks are tied back to the match 3. If I wanted a match game I would have downloaded one. I downloaded this game based on an ad, and I do not even get the game advertised as a full mini game. Don't waste your time.

Addictive. Great game. I've been playing for 4 or 5 months and have not gotten tired of it yet. They make changes often. There are often mini games within and a regatta every week where you rely on others to race and help fill your orders. Building your town almost seems like it happens on its own as you play. Once you level up to 20 something you start building your zoo. That's almost like another game within the game. Just play it. You'll love it.

My rating WAS favorable until I played more and dove deeper in. This company is greedy as hell. They already made it hard to play the game without spending real money and now it's pretty much impossible. I actually bit the bullet and paid a few bucks here and there so I could play and figured, no big deal it's only a couple bucks, right? Yeah right until they upped the ante, so to speak. I'm really irritated with this game now and feel stupid for getting sucked in. I'm either going to delete it or only play the free portion until it gets boring (which will probably be quickly) and then delete it.

I've been playing for a few years now, and it really is fun, but the mini games NEED to be switched up and they SHOULD NOT be included in the regattas or "professor's experiments" (or whatever they're called now). Also, the amount of supplies it takes to complete community buildings and zoo exhibits is ridiculous. *CHANGE THIS PLEASE!* On the plus side, it really is ad-free (because "golden tickets" are pushed every month now for $5). 🙄 I'll give 5 stars when I see improvements.

The game is fun and addicting, but get ready to spend money on this game. This game never has cash specials, which you need cash to advance, and the rewards for earning cash are slim to none. I spend almost 20$ a day cause that's how fast you go through the game money. The cost for products in the factories is expensive, and the further you go in the game the more expensive everything is.

Fun game but you have to be careful because it IS addicting and can be a money-grabber. Borderline a scam. Before you know it, you've spent hundreds maybe even thousands of dollars on this game. Finally had to force myself to uninstall it so I could stop spending money on it. Time-consuming, but for a lot of the items, I just "set it and forget it" and just go to work or sleep etc for a few hrs, come back to it later. Takes the edge off and stops you from spending the $ to rush it.

Cheating & Swindling. I've never played a game that blatantly cheats to this level. They don't even try to hide it. Everything is aimed at getting you to make in-game purchases. Low on a material? It will be required in the next train or plane load. There is nothing random. The matching game is absurd... the blatant cheating. Have 130 game cash? They'll take that in 1-2 rounds. The prizes are just profile pics now. $9.99 every 20 days? Barn is impossibly small without upgrade. Class action?

I really enjoy playing this game, however items keep disappearing from my barn and it's become very frustrating. It takes time to make these things and when they all disappear, it makes me want to quit playing. Figured out that items in the barn get used in the zoo. I was making items there to upgrade my zoo and didn't know it to items from my barn.

I'd read about ALL the issues regarding this game, but I really liked it and continue to play..but the more I play the more I see what everyone is complaining about..the crashes that happen conveniently when they owe you coins or towncash.. contacting CS is a total waste of time, it's ALWAYS to late for them to resolve your problem, because by the time they get back to you the game is over!! I too have spent money on this game something I usually never do and most likely won't again. SMH

They've sucked all the fun out of this game. No more variety of mini-games: it's all-match-3, all-the-time now. No more decorations to buy with regatta points. No more small special decorations AT ALL, just a gigantic 3x4 that can be won by playing enough Match-3. (So if you don't like Match-3 A LOT, skip this as they've gutted the town for it.)

Wow.. I didnt know that i was going to love this game like this. I wish there was a way to get township dollars and expanding shovels without having to spend us dollars for them. Also there are glitches that wont even allow you to sign in or even play the game which is very inconveniencing. But other then that i really like the game. Its fun, interesting, and requires your imagination to be used. Good game:-)

It used to be a great game... Progressing now takes forever. Impossible to get a good stock of what is needed. Storage is small. Material needed is too high. Upgrades are Impossible since trains bring random materials and never what you need. Ways to earn coins and the amount earned in the few available ways is abysmal. Progressing should be a good challenge. Instead, developers have made it impossible without reaching in to my own pocket.

I've played for 9 years and I have always enjoyed the game. I buy the golden ticket, a piggy bank or two and a sale package if I like it and right now this update and changes of how you play the game are terrible. No one wants to play because of it, people aren't doing regatta because it's so frustrating the only good that came from it is the expanded store so that we can use our tokens. Please fix the game. PLEASE !!!!

I have LOVED this game for the past year UNTIL the recent changes started. I am finding I enjoy it less and less, each time a change is made. Goals are harder to achieve and the payout for achieving the goals is FAR LESS. It was great the way it was! I had expected to play this game for years to come and have not missed ONE day logging in that ENTIRE time! But now I have no interest in it at all. 🥺 I will not continue to play and spend money on this app UNTIL THEY REVERSE ALL THE CHANGES!

It was a fun and addicting game, but, unfortunately, it is too addicting plus too expensive. I had to pull the plug on myself. If you want a nice big community, you either have to wait weeks to get all the materials needed or spend too much money and thats just to open up the community one small square block at a time. Then, the people start complaining for things and they keep adding more stuff that will take even longer to get..... its just not worth it.

I used to play this game every single day! The graphics are great but when they took the "Special Themed" decorations from the regatta store, I quit playing as much. No fun now. Repetitive goals and the rewards you get from the regatta store are the some ones you can buy or earn anywhere else. I miss the decorations. And it is nearly impossible to advance in the leagues in the regatta because the goals are so high. Not fun at all anymore.

Been playing this game for 5 years, but it isn't as much fun so I can only give it one star. I only stay for my friendships in my awesome co op. The Professor Experiment was fun, feeding animals, growing crops, making products, helping others, but now it is all based on the side games, and the same games over and over. Some of the games are ridiculously difficult and if I wanted an explosive puzzle, I would download one of those type of games.

Recent update has ruined this game. Can't opt out of the regatta, changes to the pricing structure have made it impossible to get in-game rewards that most players depended on, and changes to the regatta mini-game task requirements to earn points means no one in my co-op will select mini game tasks. It is nearly impossible to complete those tasks without spending $$. I'm going to wait to see if Playrix makes changes quickly. Otherwise, in quiiting this game after two years of daily play.

Used to be fun, fair & engaging. The last 2 years or so, no more variety with mini games. The same type over & over. Also Playrix is getting very greedy. If you don't spend money, (the cost of some items recently doubling) it can be slow or near impossible to complete tasks on time unless you spend all your waking hours in-game. I've been a regular player for the last 10 years but it may be time for a change. So disappointed to see this happening. Look at Facebook posts. Players are grumbling!

I played this game for 15 months and have reached level 103. I play every day and ,obviously, for many hours. The object is to develop your town. At first there were many opportunities to get unique items for your town. All of that is gone now. Every change has made the game less fun. I finished my zoo and now I hear they are removing it. The minigames are hard, repeptitive and often require cash to finish. No cute decor from the regatta so coop stopped playing. Playrix has forgotten the goal!

10/2024: After 9 years, I quit. Unplayable at higher levels without spending $30+ monthly. 4/2024: super buggy updates and constant pay to play events! It's become much more expensive to play. From 2019: fun game, but you have to buy in-game cash to play in a co-op to compete in regattas. support sucks, response is slow and uncaring, but so long as everything is working and you don't mind spending a little money, you'll have a good time. cheaper to pay to play than many other games out there.

okay game, can be addictive. however i don't think it's fair to have everything stored in your barn when not everything falls into the category. for example, food shouldn't be stored with building materials and or gold, silver, bronze etc ingots. they should have their own separate barns or spaces for certain things. that's why i put a low star rating. and also the fact that items are pretty expensive to purchase in the Google game play store.

It's....okay. I've had this game for years and have been playing off and on. I reinstall it only to remember the reason I deleted it in the first place. I feel like I'm getting nowhere in the game. I'll spend hours with what feels like no progress. Everything takes to long and the new ads are misleading to what the game actually is. I used to be addicted but now I'm just bored. I feel like all I can even do is create and sell items and I'm only on like level 26. It's so frustrating.

Had to give 1 star, but would actually rate 0 stars. Rolled out an update that doesn't work. 3 days later, and no resolution. Cannot do any activities in the game without the game crashing. Glitchy, slow, then crashes losing all progress made in the game, causing continuous redo of tasks already completed. All in the middle of competition play. Of course, they want their money for things that don't work. Don't waste your time downloading, don't waste your money to play.

Great graphics,but a big disaster with the piggy bank account. your hard earned money goes to piggy bank and then you have to buy it to use it, else you lose the 75 earned cash. i bought it once,but it appears again. are the game developers expecting that we keep buying it again and again. if there has to be a purchase it should be from the store option provided in the game. Really disappointed. Appreciate if you fix this.

Just awful greedy game. Every little thing you can do is designed to take money from you. Plant crops? Game wants money to speed it up. Build stuff? Game doesn't let you complete the building because arbitrary RNG items that you can buy with cash or keep loading the trains for a chance at the material. Loading trains? Game wants cash to speed it up. Events? Game lets you have a small taste then asks for cash to keep playing. Waste your time playing something else that actually values your time

Is anyone else having problems with the game?Everytime I try to open the regatta it crashes, this is now happening with the trains. It is getting very frusterating. Been playing for about 3 years used to enjoy but not so much anymore. The glitches with the golden ticket, not connecting to play on multiple devices and now the regatta need to be FIXED!!!!!. I have spent a lot of hours and money playing to just stop playing.

Township starts off fun, but then kicks in as nothing more than a cash grab as the game progresses. The side games that once gave you tools to help build the town simply give tokens to keep playing the game. The side games themselves are turning inro only versions of match three games that are rigged to try and make you pay to win. Their "Golden Ticket" events seem lackluster compared to those offered in the past. All in all, not the game it once was.

I love this game and have been playing for years, but please bring back the old button layout! I use the airplane and train buttons at the bottom to prioritize filling those boxes first. I also miss having the regatta progress on the right-hand side. Now you have to go into the regatta tab just to see how far you are on the task. I also find the button design too big. Simple is better in my opinion. My barn is also always too full and it takes too long to get the materials to upgrade it.

I really like this game, an actual freemium game. You don't have to spend any money if you don't want to. In fact I think it's a bit unfair balanced if I look at what I can achieve within an hour bars work v.s. spending €5. The amount of coins you receive for paid content should be more. Update: I bought one coin pack and I seem to get a lot less free coins now from watching advertisements etc. like they expect me to pay for everything from now on, no more free stuff.

This game "cheats" so hard it's not funny. By "cheats" I mean that the game will more often than not ask you to fill orders of things you are low on. You can be fully stocked for most things and somehow the orders for the plane and train will be the few things you DON'T have. It's definitely not random. Upgrades are measly and build/manufacturing times are ridiculous. Materials for building are insane considering how many you have to stock with limited space. Still, it's mostly fun.

Editing my review, I was playing the game for a while and then couldn't login for a few days and realized my account was hacked, was able to login but immediately got the banned message. I contacted support explaining situation and was politely told that there is no fixing/rolling back accounts by their terms and conditions so I would have to start over. After spending time and money to try and catch up to play with my friends, I had no desire to start over again 80 levels behind. Pretty disappointed in the support received. Fun game, don't recommend investing significant time or effort.

I read many people's reviews saying it cost them a lot of real money to play. But for me, I've been playing over 60 days and I'm at the level 52, and haven't spent a dine on this game. Though I have to watch a lot of ads in order for me to collect tcash, it's definitely an alternative not to get lured to spend money on "your town" that is NOT real. Yes, it's addictive but once you get to a certain level you will get bored and lose interests. I think I am about to....

Fun, but hands down the most expensive pay-to-play game ever. In comparison, Zombie Gunship, you can drop 20 bucks for some upgrades that will last a month or two. With Township you can drop 20 bucks, and it will only advance you 5 minutes. The other issue I dont like is that there are many items you can only buy with cash, but if you sell them, you will only get coins back. There is no way to convert coins to cash.

Fun game overall but they are making me too many things very difficult to achieve, either you have to wait a lot, either spend money. You get too much of some construction materials and a few others extremely rare. The puzzle game is simply crazy, some levels impossible to reach, you have to wait or try until exhausted. Support = useless. That's why I took two stars off.

It's fun at first, then it gets expensive. Even the smallest level advances become costly. Finally, it reaches the point where you can't play the game anymore without dumping $10 or so into it every time you try to play it. Even the easy levels become impossible to pass without money. Also, on PC the game crashes all the time. I'm uninstalling it from my pc today. I want nothing more to do with this expensive bug ridden junk. I'm not installing anything from Playrix again!

On level 379 of the puzzle. Ive been trying to beat this level for over 12 hours now. The algorithm of the AI controlling the game prevents you from getting the 5 in a row. It automatically changes it to a lesser number so you have no choice but to purchase dollars and you can see it in real time. You're not playing a real game you're playing a bot. Disappointing

Township is a fun game, and definitely helps to pass the time, but it seems a lot of the things you need or need to do in game are designed to make you put actual money into the game. I've played it for only a few days and already had to put 7 dollars into the game just to expand my storage capacity enough to keep playing. Trains are useful to gather building materials but the longer you play the more materials the trains require and the longer they take to get back, making money necessary.

This could be a great game but instead is designed to stress you out and pressure you into spending alot of real money. The lack of storage is the biggest problem. So many things are needed all at once but the storage isn't big enough. It costs $10 real money to increase storage by only 25. You can't grow more crops until buildings are done but you can't get the stuff without spending $5 for each building. The match 3 game can't be won without boosters that cost more real money. Not worth it.

The game has a lot of glitches. It takes forever for things to finish being made. When I make things and I am waiting for them to get to 1 min so I can pay the $1. And be done with it. Just this kerning I was waiting for the cooking to finish, it was at 2 min I left came back and it had changed from 2min to 17min but I could speed it up for $3. It has been like this forever!!! I enjoy certain parts of thos game like the regatta and building my town. BUT I HATE THESE GLITCHES ALL THE TIME MESS

I really like this game. But when i bought gems with money, it ripped me off. I was trying to buy 8 red gems for $30.00, i only got one instead of 8. This needs to change, because it misleads the players. Also the items shouldn't cost so much to get. Players would like to see some changes when it comes to buying items. This would be greatly appreciated.

Disappointed in this game. The adds suggest a walk around farming game. The add is a mini game that comes up every 10 days or so. This is actually an order filling game. You have to harvest items, make items from what you harvest, and make more items from what you just made. Sometimes you have to wait hours for things to finish. There IS a side game (match 3 or more in a row) but the levels are difficult. I unlocked the mine (Level21) hoping it would be fun, it is not. Not what I was hoping for.

The is pretty fun, a great way to dissuade boredom, but your price for the in app purchases is far to high!!!
