Also you pay for nearly everything so why must you pay for hot air balloon gifts, that you usually don't need, I think all balloons should be free, unles its a guarantee of coins, app bucks, or cupons... things like that. Just be a bit more reasonable on the pay outs in the game.

I'm beginning to see a pattern with a lot of these games, and I can only suggest to others not to get too invested in a game that requires the players to pay real $$$ to complete tasks/expand land to build/get characters and buildings. The only reason I Iike this game, is that I can name it Atheistville (based on my point of view).

This game is really fun and addictive, but they intentionally deprive you of items, and make the match game so difficult that you have to spend money in order to complete them. That is the only thing that they care about. The train never gives me items that I need, and I've never completed an adventure game because the match game is set to unrealistic difficulties, even compared to their other games like Homescape. Treat your customers better.

The game is fun, it's cute, but there is not a lot you can do, because you are always waiting on something. Oh, hand over real money, no waiting. It's too controlled, as all land expansions are level based, so you can't easily plan out your town. Can't stock up on crops, because the space in your barn is limited. You can up grade...but you have to wait on needed materials. Five star game, you wish.

I have loved this game for over a year until all my coins disappeared with zero explanation. I have spent over $100 and continue to get...nowhere. This is the 2nd and last time I lose everything. Yes, it's just a game. But losing everything you saved and spent time on, is bad form. I'm uninstalling this app and will not be playing anymore.

I love this game. I don't like the mini games and that they got rid of one of the boosters. I wish they would have left the design alone. It was so good back when I started playing in maybe 2018 or 2019, now it sucks. Some things take much longer to load than they used to. I like that you can talk to people in your coop easier than you used to be able to. But I really dislike how hard the side game levels are, especially when half the regatta tasks are completed through the mini game.

I like the game a lot but it can be really difficult to progress through the game because of storage. They want you to fill plane orders, train orders, zoo orders, helicopter orders, you need building supplies, you collect from the mine, you collect crops, etc. But it goes into ONE barn that fills up too quickly so you're forced to sell items you'll need two seconds later, then you have to wait so long to get more of that material. Hayday is my top game because of the lack of storage here.

Mostly irritating after after a while! I deleted this app because it's the same thing over and over and over...... Merge event is the worst. Match 3 isn't much better. I wasted enough time and money (I'm embarrassed to admit). The higher levels you reach, the longer everything takes. Match 3 levels alternate between hard and super hard. Without township bucks and power ups you will not succeed. I'm sure Playrix is raking in the cash though! Lesson learned by me.

I've played this game religously since 2015. Back then, game was easily 5 stars. Now I open the app about one a week. I am over it. They just want money. Events and side games are all the same and repetitive. The format of the experiments require you to play the side games. If I wanted to play the side games, I'd download another app. I'm very disappointed as I used to love this game. But I get it--money makes the world go round.

I started playing this game in 2017 & I was HOOKED. I spent real cash on this game over the last 4 years. Unfortunately, this game has become a cash grab. The mini games are IMPOSSIBLE to level up on unless you pay $. Purchased a gold pass but they make it impossible to win unless you dump even more money into it. They give you tasks to upgrade your barn but don't supply you with the materials. I'll never purchase a gold pass again! A lot of members are angry. You need to make this right.

I didn't think you could make it worse, but you have. I hadn't played in a couple of years because it was pay to win. I tried again. Nice money grab with the color match game. I will go back to not playing. Your greed destroyed a good game. I used to buy little offers, but apparently you only want the big spenders on your game. There are many block color match games. If I wanted to play them, I would download them.

At first I enjoyed the game. I was looking for a distraction during chemo. I invested about $11 and got to level 23 in five days. Now it's starting to be a lot less fun. Each time you fill a train, the next takes a little longer to return. Day 5 and my trains take 3 hours. Of course, with unlimited cash I could speed them up. And the new mini game has no learning / practice mode and I find it impossible. In the end, I will choose to delete because it's designed to become less fun over time.

I've been playing this game 4 about 5 years. Built my town, spent real $, made friends w/ co-op members, etc. Over a month ago, I suddenly had a different mini game than my teammates & it's never gone back to normal. This affects the regatta as I can't do any of the higher tasks because "event has expired." I've tried support several times & only get some generic, automated response & the conversation is closed. At this point, I'm ready to delete this game. It's become a joke. Fix your s**t!

Love this game! You can go as quick or slow as you like! You can play solo or join others in a co-op and get more prizes! Update: 10/20 Game has gotten super glitchy. Very hard to play regatta. I can only play ony phone. My tablet kicks me out of game. When they are pushing updates and new decor, we loose product and TC. This is still my favorite game. However I'm concerned that my devices won't be able to support the game at some point. 😞

The biggest problem i have with this game is that to get anywhere you really need to have game money and if you wait for that to build up on its own you wait forever. in the beginning you are not given much choice to use game dollars it encourages you to spend what you start off with to only entice you to buy more. The deadlines sometimes don't give you much time to balance game time and real life either. Then the barn capacity is never really enough.

When helping others add to their needed items on train or plane (when visiting their farm), the only option is to send ALL items. It would be helpful to be able to add to players' needed items, rather than all of them. The option of giving a few needed items becomes available ONLY when someone 'requests' a chosen item from the co-op, not when visiting the person's farm. It would be nice in both situations. Furthermore, it is unclear whose friend request is still pending.

Too many notifications. It's also a slower paced game than what I'm used to, what with the items not producing much at one time, but the currency being enough for production. I guess what I'm saying is that it gets a bit boring when you have so much money in the game to do with, but then can do so little because you have to wait on other things that amount to so little, but are crucial to game progress.

While I Love the game it Takes WAY TOO LONG! to build and complete stuff. I have buildings that's been there for weeks at a stand still because getting the materials takes too long especially when you need a lot. it's as if the game forces you to spend real money. It's frustrating and I'm soon to delete it although I'm almost at level 40. Yes I've played quite a bit and even invested real money which I never do but at this point I'm gonna have to let this game go. BTW The piggy bank is insulting

Ridiculously slow progression. After less than 10 minutes of play you have to either wait or spend money to keep going. Item capacity is reached well before getting the items to upgrade the capacity, which requires you to spend money or get rid of items that have future value. All-in-all a typical freemium game that have to pay to get anywhere in decent amount time.

I play everyday & I love it but 1. Task time frames end before they expire. 2. In game events are set up to make most people fail at them, even if you spend money to complete goals. 3. Sometimes I purchase township cash & it will disappear without using it. 4. I have been having issues with the game loading since the last update.5. No one EVER responds to reports or game reviews so I'm honestly not sure if their working on it or if they even care 🤷

Horrible!!! Tech support, horrible!!! Have had the same issue happen over & over & it's never resolved, or it takes days to get a response & even then, no fix or replacement of what you lost. Mostly, I just a request to rate my experience & then have to start all over with a new complaint ticket! Now, because of the update, I'm also unable to claim the event prize due to it crashing every time I open it. I'm stuck in the same spot, no progress & still no fix to my original issue! 😡😡😡

This game is really fun. Simple. Lots to do. I gave only 4 stars because in order to maximize the game you are dependent on the trains that bring construction materials to complete community buildings which increase your population ceiling. Only you have no idea what you will get. So at some point you're at a standstill because you aren't getting what you need. Well.... Unless you want to pay. I'm at Level 44. I play several hours a day. This is DAY FIVE of waiting for a train to bring TWO SAWS.

Fun but you need to spend to get progress. this is a really fun game and I really enjoy it! the only thing is it seems in order to grow and progressed into new levels of the game you actually have to by their game cash and spend your money. I know this is how most games make their money but this one it seems like you have to spend a lot more of your real cash to get anywhere. That's my only complaint but otherwise I like it to pass the time.

I'm downgrading my review. I originally gave them 4 stars, but they have changed the game so much. It's no longer about Township and building your town. It's about repetitive mini games that they force you to play to get any perks in the events. Now, they are even forcing those mini games through high point regatta tasks. You have to play them to stay competitive and they are boring and it's just the same thing over and over. The game glitches, and their customer service is a useless bot.

I have been playing this for a few years. As others have said, the recent update makes the game less enjoyable and makes me play it less. I don't participate in regattas, but the mini adventure game has greatly increased the number of energy points needed to clear obstacles. The creators of the game need to listen to your customers. In your efforts to try squeezing a little more real money out of the players, you're making people play the game less.

It's becoming very obvious that the game developer/management don't care about this game anymore. We still have Christmas theme decorations all over the town (it's mid Feb now). The mini Games are also becoming overly challenging in the way that you basically won't pass unless you pay heaps of real cash. So no, this game is not for me anymore after some years of playing.

Expensive glitches! Purchased items in shop to help with mini game (brooms, darts, etc) and they have failed to load so wasted money. I have bonus rockets and they won't load for use either. I want my $$ back. Makes me want to never play this again. This is not the first time this has happened. Last time you restarted the mini game and I lost all my progress! The shop purchase was 74.00!

The game in the ads is just a bonus game you get to play randomly, maybe once a week if you're lucky. You can play for free, but it's way less fun, and the way they have all the micro purchases set up is truly designed to prey on your weaknesses to suck every cent from you that they can. I can't pretend I don't like the game, but it's not what's advertised and it's truly predatory with the micropurchasing.

The game glitches and crashes everytime I click the regatta. I have ask for help several times from support and it still doesn't work. Township is all about the money, they rather focus on the next golden ticket event then fixing the issue's. There is nothing new in this game, it’s the same as every other day, the things we use to look forward to are now gone, nothing to build, nothing new in the factories to make…this is no longer about building a township it’s a puzzle game.

I am editing my rating from five stars to two because of recent changes to the game. I used to pay a little bit of real cash for the extras, figuring it was worth it since I found the game entertaining. Now that they doubled the price of the "Town Pass" literally overnight, I will no longer spend any real money for anything. I may even quit playing since much of the game revolves around the match-three side game. It's not as fun as it used to be. Still love the graphics, tho.

Been playing for about 7 years and it used to be fun to play. Now same match 3 side games to get anything. I used to love different side games each week. The monthly event that had you do tasks that involved your farm. I only stay because of my team and friends I've made through the years. I don't look forward to playing daily ad before. Bring back the old game!!!!

I love this game but storage sucks!! All the building materials take forever to get and meanwhile you have to upgrade storage just to be able to keep them. I wish they would make a special storage for them just like for the mine items... You know it's been almost 4 years since first review and you still haven't fixed the storage problem it sucks!!!

False advertising. Farming game with overly long build/grow/train times. Clearly just want your $; obtaining materials to complete buildings is painstakingly long (days/week for 1 building) without spending. If you like these type of games, would recommend Decurse for now over this one. Update: Followed dev response & contacted support. While they responded quickly, it was clear they either hadn't read the issue or chose not to respond to it. Poor CS.

Game is fun. Good to pass time, my only complaint is the in game money system. I've noticed to buy certain material you literally have to spend upwards of 5 dollars just to get it. I havent recieved paint from the train system in FOREVER forcing me to buy the material.. the amount of in game cash you have to spend to receive things like paint or anything is TO high and needs to be lowered. No one should have to spend that much money real or not on 1 or 2 of material. Ridiculous.

Pretty easy to get addicted to, but you can absolutely play without in app purchases, just takes a bit longer for some things. I've played it both ways. Occasionally have in app separate games that are actually relatively challenging, yet always a bit different in case you are good at one type of game but not another. Would give 5 stars, but an in app sale purchase twice cheated me out of part of the items promised.

Alert- Pay wall. the game would be great if it wasn't for a pay wall. Once you get to level 50 plus, it is nearly impossible to progress without spending real money for more moves. they give 10 moves for something that would require 30 moves. even if you save all your perks to use in one game, it still isn't enough. I do not recommend it. it is a waste of time. Pay to win games are the worst and are honestly poorly designed. Cosmetics are the best routes for monetary. Or just buying a game.

The mini games prizes are a wheel, so most of the time you get a brick etc. I do not want to spend my energy on a game with prizes, then end up with a brick or glass. Also the professors game started out fun, you have to pay $5. Up front to play, ok; but now you dont even have time to finish the tasks to earn the good prizes. I will not be playing that again. Etc. This game really likes to gouge for your 💰 money. This game is fun, just beware all the costs that can occur.

I love this game. It's gotten to the point where I'm slightly addicted to it lol. The only complaint I have is the new fishing tournament thing is weirdly difficult for such a relaxed game (maybe it's just me, but sometimes I'm great at it and sometimes it doesnt register that I'm pressing my screen at all and I lose a fish at the last second) and that I'm not able to see towns from people with iOS anymore, no matter if they are in my co-op or not. It's impossible to share goods like that.

Well since I am apparently limited massively with character limits here, here is the basic review. the general game is fine, great game. the events suck the fun out of it. in the current fishing event they give you way, way, WAY too many lures for one fish that barely ever shows up, and the one that is around most often I almost never have lures for, or caps to make them. I am about to sell the excess but that of course will be when all those fish show up. it's just frustrating to feel gypped.

You earn coins by completing tasks and selling goods. BUT they have dollars also which have more value and you can purchase. However, at level 11 - 56 I had over 200,00 coin and over $160. I signed out and returned and over $100 disappeared. You can buy $100 dollars game cash for about $2.99 real cash. The problem is this wasn't the first shortage I noticed. Yes I had the Cash verification more on so I wasn't spending the money without a notification that $$$ would be charged. Contacted customer

I love this game, probably a little too much. Some downsides is it gives you videos to watch at the helicopter pad for coins or Tcash and sometimes the game just resets and you get nothing. Free ad for them I guess. It would be nice to have some ways to dump production boxes or crops miss planted. However if they do, it would probably cost Tcash which isn't always easy to come by. It takes time and I love the game, I just need to learn to not stare at the game and get a life.....

There are issues with the game. It often does not save progress, which hinders game play later. When I tried contacting customer service, not only did they take a long time to respond, but basically told me they would not refund any money I spent in the game. I will be uninstalling and saving myself money and aggravation. Terrible customer service.

This game is really good fun but there is one aspect that just completely ruins the experience for me. It is too difficult to get building materials. I have three(!) community buildings that are ready except for the building materials and soon the fourth will join them. I have never sold any of the building materials, I am always hoarding them. I sent out one train after the other. And yet I can never get what I need. Unbalanced and very annoying!

The game is nothing like ads, and you have to have friends playing to get ahead, or pay to win. Everything is on timers so if you really want to play, you have to take breaks and come back as it deems, there is not enough access to construction resources to build up your town quickly, and you need to have friends who also have the game to increase your access to them. It's also pay to win, so you can spend your real life money on the game to get those things. Not good value.

Don't get very far without having to pay actual money so it's taking long on the construction 2 be completed & I can't put all my animals in their homes. I won't spend money 2 play a free game with all the problems when u update. Not right. Knor is it a fair way 2 treat the people that actually like playing. Like me. This isn't the only game that does this. But I'd really like to actually find an honest game. So I guess that would be an old fashioned board game. It's a shame.

Forces you to play match 3 games to progress in the farming/town portion of the game. The match 3 hard levels are so difficult you can't beat them without using powerups which you get very few of. Purposefully makes the barn too small. Makes it difficult to get materials to build community buildings. Don't waste your time with this game. They're just fishing for in-app purchases.

It's ok, I only played this just for the heck of it. Its like a farm game with the idea of expanding the town. The mini games are just the same thing over and over. The game really wants you to spend some money if you fail in a level and it doesn't seem like a good choice to play this. Also judging from the app icon I saw on the store, it's false advertising with the pull pin ads like any other games.

Love the game but CUSTOMER SERVICE is TERRIBLE! It takes days for contact & still no help!! 😠 Get in a Co-op where the team helps other players. You can play this game sparingly or a lot, which is nice. I used to play Klondike, but I gave up as it got boring & the energy required to do stuff let you play for less than a minute. In this game, with the frequent different competitions, and many different things to build and fill there is mostly always something to do. I highly recommend it! 😄

I've been playing for 6yrs. This game is now nothing but puzzles. There was a match game where you could win items for your town, but that stopped last year. You can't buy holiday decorations anymore, only the basic items. The regattas run too long & never stop! It seems you can't opt out of them anymore, so your level drops, too. The prizes are all for the puzzles that I won't play. This game used to be so much fun! Now, I don't even want to bother. I'm extremely disappointed!!

It's super fun but takes wayyyy too long to gain supplies and tools to upgrade your barn, finish construction, etc. After playing for a day now I just check in every couple hours and can only play for a couple minutes and then there's nothing left to do because I can't expand, craft anything, feed the animals, harvest crops etc. because I simply "my barn is full." Also, the train rarely brings what I need and you will never earn enough money to buy the supplies.

I feel like the ads were misleading even though it said it wasn't. I thought I would be moving the character around to collect supplies and fill orders like the ad. That's only a mini-game within the main game. The main game is to build buildings, harvest the resources from them, and wait. Lots of waiting. It's a lot like Farmville, which is not the game I was interested in. I thought it was going to be like the ad, moving a character around to complete tasks. Not tap and wait. Disappointing.

I truly enjoy playing this game. However, it has gotten to be an expense that I can't afford. There should be more opportunities to grow cash reserves for developing your town. From reading other reviews, the developers are making cash to use towards whatever they see fits their best interest, which may or may not involve the customers. Great game if you have a savings to spend to play the game. Going to have to drop off soon due to the expenses to play.

I used to love this game - have played for many years and belong to a wonderful coop. But the last few months have ruined it for me as it has become a cash grab - it has multiple mini games that are now. basically impossible to advance in without spending lots of money. The pirate game was the last straw. I play games to relax and this has become the opposite of relaxing! After giving it many chances to improve, I am deleting it and moving on. 😠

Not a game, a cash grab SCAM. Waiting periods for tasks to complete are long, min 2 minutes, max several days. After waiting periods, you often still need additional items to complete tasks, which means a longer, unspecified wait as the item(s) may never arrive on a train. Piggy bank was recently introduced to guarantee that players have to spend real money. Done with this shameless cash grab. Playing 3 days and already spent too much. Don't step into this trap! Devs should be ashamed.

Game is nothing like the ad. It's a countdown timer based farming game that's basically a Sims-esque ripoff. You plant crops, raise buildings, feed animals, etc... and wait up to an hour for them to process their tasks. They occasionally give you a "mini game" that's what you see in the ad, but it's a few seconds of gameplay and not what you think you're getting at the time of download. It's a total time soak unless you constantly pay in game micro transactions to advance. Installed/deleted

When I first saw the animated ads for Township, I thought, "Hey, this is the kind of thinking game I like." Unfortunately, the cute animated ads with sliding locks and choices does not accurately match the game. The actual game is better described as "Gardenscapes on Steroids." You run a city wide farm, fill orders like "Farmville" and build a town. It's crowded, it's clunky, it's no fun. There's just too much to remember to play the game, and I couldn't do it. After two weeks, I stopped playing; a few days later, I dropped the app. Let me know if they ever create the game actually seen in the ad.

This use to be a + review. Now let's discuss what has gone wrong in the last several years. The "side games" have taken over. Those being extra games within the main game of building a town and farming. Growing a town is a supreme hassle now because the devs & co. are aggressively pushing the side games. The reason being, to win side games you have to spend real cash. If you choose not to do them you are still hounded with attempts to get you to. No thanks. Let me build my town and grow crops.

Greedy mechanics, obnoxious mini games... etc. No more grow crops, bake goods and trade for rare stuff and coins, while building a cute town, peaceful gameplay. I don't like fast-paced games, hence why I installed Township to begin with. I don't mind mini games while witing for crops to grow and goods to be ready, but they should be in the same peaceful type as the main game. I've uninstalled.

I enjoyed playing this game for 3 years on my Amazon Fire tablet. In the past year at every update there were challenges. At the last update I had to give it up. There was not enough internal storage on my tablet to install the latest update. An SD card would not work because the operating system (les than 6.0) on the tablet would not accommodate it. I purchased an Fire HD10 tablet but my 3 years of progress on the game app could mot be transferred to the new device, I would have to start from the beginning losing all my progress. I loved the game but am very disappointed in Amazon not being able to adapt through the updates.

The game is addictive at first, but be prepared to spend money if you want to get anywhere. Honestly, this game is one of the worst money traps I've seen in awhile and it became boring and repetitive after a couple of weeks of playing. It needs a lot of improvement, but the barn capacity and the cost of expansions was why I quit and unistalled in the end.

I played this game years ago.. here I am again. The game runs really well. It would be cool if more gifts could be sent. With 30 slots in the co-op.. 5 gifts falls short. The plane would be a great option for the Regatta. I feel the zoo is a waste of resources, maybe if it had its place in the Regatta. And, what happened to the plane button? All in all it's a great game.

Gameplay disappears. For the longer tasks, I usually start before going to bed so I can complete them when I wake up. I log in and my progress has disappeared. With how much the points are, it makes getting a decent placement nearly impossible. It seems they want to force you into playing the event (which is repetive. Used to have more diverse side games.) tasks. Then you get tied to playing it with every other level being a hard or super hard level.

The game is enjoyable, it has good graphics and offers different types of game within a game. All in all I enjoy it. However recently, I have found that the puzzle games are rigged. Generally some levels are designed to be virtually unbeatable and to succesfully finish it, you would have to spend game cash, which also means actual cash. I understand the business aspect of it, however, this blatant cash grab is just turning me off. Hence I'm starting to slowly lose interest in this game.

Game was great for about 4 days. Now it won't let me harvest crops or goods, it keeps saying "barn is full" (but it's not full). I uninstalled then reinstalled the game, same issue. I typically don't leave reviews on products that don't work out for me, I simply discontinue using the product. But I've spent about $6.00 in upgrades (I give more than that to panhandlers), it's the principal tho. If you'd have asked, I would've donated money to support the game.

Why is the ad that plays in another game different from the game I installed? I thought I would be moving a character around to different spots collecting items and money to make things happen. False advertisements? You have earned a negative review for this no matter how popular and great your game is. Always online, gross. If you're using wifi, make sure it's rock solid or else you can't play this game.

colorful, well animated, and fun*. I made it to level 10 before the game lost enjoyment and I uninstalled it. My initial issue was being thrust into other games without an opt out. Closing and reopening didn't help, but I continued to play. Storage quickly becomes an issue as you grow, but more requires resources (or paying). In this scenario, I can manually sell to open up space, but it became less fun having to sacrifice.

The game was fun at first but it became extremely annoying later. The barn is constantly full because of the tiny space and it takes forever to upgrade your space. Treasure hunt costs too much energy to just make some baby progress. Puzzle games range from hard to impossible. How can you solve 50+ puzzles with just 13 moves? I ended up uninstalling it. I wanted a relaxing game to play, not one that made me wanna throw my phone across the room.

I have been playing township for many years. I enjoy building a team with others and getting to know numerous people from different parts of the world. Heres where my complains come in. With every up date the creators of the game are removing things that, in my, opinion, have an impact on the amount of enjoyment with the game play. They have also significantly raised the prices of things you can purchase in the game. One would think all the recent 1-2 star reviews, they would fix it

I was enjoying this game. Until you have to wait hours for anything to be ready. One item said 24 hours and after the 24 hours it is now 22 hours. It takes to long to grow the crops and to make anything. The awards are very slim picking. I stared playing this game to get gems for another game. Made purchases and made the level I was suppose to get and did not get any awards. This game is very frustrating. It seems to be the way with all games. They just want your money. It's a money grab game!!

So, the game is ok but this is NOTHING like how they advertise. I played this game for a few months and you build and harvest stuff to run your town, which is fine, but on the ad, you walk through your inventory and it loads up and you take it to the place to be sold or used, but unless it changes around level 200 or whatever, this ain't that. So, if you know what you're getting it's fine but if you were looking for the same play as the ad, you won't find it.

Making a game unplayable without money is the main problem with this game. If a person gets the hang of playing, he might even pay one-day. But it's a tough pil to swallow. Also, Advertisement didn't showed the real gameplay, at all. Whatever you do, the process takes 5 to 30 mins. Unless you buy the rare currency in game. Shame. Could've been a very enjoyable game.

Didn't take too long for me to hate this 'game'. I couldn't figure out why it had such a high rating till I saw many comments that the game had been changed from fun to a 3 match. Most of the tasks and adventure are tied to it so you are stalled when stuck in a puzzle. There are so many ridiculous low move puzzles that you will be frustratingly stuck in unless you are willing to pay. When you finally get through, stuck again. So if the goal was to make a tedious, not fun game, then congrats.

The game freezes when you use the cash to finish one of their mini games, so you lose the cash, then they say sorry about that bug...what they dont tell you is that this is part of the game they built in the freeze to take money from you hoping you will spend more. Dont buy anything! Use the free money you earn playing or dont play this game. It is a scam. They say sorry you lost that 50 dollars from the game due to a glitch...but it's really the game doing it on purpose. I am reporting it.

Same events over and over. Same mini games over and over. And they are only geared towards getting you to spend real money. No new content. Just different themes. It used to be a fun game. Now its just a time sink. They have gotten rid of all the mini games that were fun to play, and replaced them with 4 games they rotate through that the only way you get anywhere is to spend real dollars. This game has sold out, and is no longer fun like it was.

Very expensive game to play. The game they use to lure you in is just a mini game. Township is just a world building game that is addictive but to progress further you will have to spend a lot of money. After awhile I let missions like loading trains and planes take their time. Beware the market is a rip off. I paid for 5 days and it was over in 3. Don't waste money, wait for the store to restock and take your chances. The draw to make you spend is take you never get what you need.

Keeping the in-game cash that I earn hidden behind a paywall makes this game so dull and unplayable after a while. I was wondering how this game made any revenue without ads. Though this isn't fun enough that I would think anyone would want to spend money on it. More like a convenient way to waste time. It gets old quickly. Anyway I don't recommend it. I should've known better from downloading a game with a misleading ad. The ad had a mini game with none of the actual gameplay mechanics.

I like it. However the adds for Playrix games are super deceiving! They show game play that just DOES NOT EXIST! I like the game but this company is good at ruining a good game. I really miss my zoo shops that I spent time and effort upgrading for them to simply be discontinued. They're now just decorations. That's total BS! Don't spend money on this game. You never know when your efforts will be wasted by the next update. Bring back my zoo shops. My 5 stars is being reduced to 3 stars.

Game has quite a few problems and periodically they give everyone a small gift for being patient with them. I had a problem in game with not being awarded coins that I had earned in a challenge. I wrote to support and it took over 3 weeks for a response. My biggest mistake was not ceasing to play the moment it happened. By the time they responded they didn't look back to the time of the problem they looked back a couple of days, basically called me a liar and closed the ticket. Waste of money!!

I really enjoy playing this game and have played for a while now. Latest update is not installing and now lost all the time with my dealer. The dealer is great but I wish instead of paying for 1x an hour (24uses) per 24 hours, that it was per use. I pay for 10 days but we all sleep or work so you only get to use it maybe half of what you pay for. Regatta are turning into joke too, point values are ridiculously low and time consuming tasks.....13 trains for 133 points?

Please update the decorations. Nothing seems to match, which makes it hard to organize my town to look like a real place. It would also be great if we could place fences on cement pieces. What happened to the other mini-games, and why have the Golden Pass prizes become so stingy? also the buildings should be able to rotate all the way around. ive been playing for years and ive barely expanded at all becuz everything costs so much. its crazy. I dont wanna delete, read reviews and listen to us!!!

If you like to pay for games, go ahead, I never do, don't spend over 2-5k and make your own game. If it weren't for the Piggy Bank, the game would be ok, earn money for less time spent, then pay "real" money to get the game money you just earned. 🤬 A big up yours to the gamer, the only reason I can say goodbye easily. Progressively level up with buildings, not like the commercial, has a mini game that gets too difficult. All my games are difficult because I already paid for them, with life

At one time, this was a city and farming game with some mini games to play around with. That's all changed. Now it's an expensive Matching game disguised as a farming game. The greed shown by the creators of this game knows no bounds. You must play the mini games if you are going to proceed anywhere in this game. There used to be a huge variety in games and if you didn't like one, wait a few days and try the next one. I'm reading online that people are leaving this game, and I understand why.

Great game, but it takes way to long to finish tasks. They changed a lot of things in the game. its hard to earn t-cash and jewels to add to the labs for points. now it seems as if you have to focus more on the zoo than on your town. If you want to make it more fun, you should make the zoo available AFTER we reach max level in our town. Just saying.

Been playing since shortly after it's inception. It was fun because of the many interesting side games( like gumball, steeplechase, roller coaster), and reward system. But, they've taken ALL that away and turned it into just another Match-3 game (which I absolutely hate!). Also, spending cash brings diminishing rewards RATHER THAN more, or a better playing experience. It needs to be labelled as Match-3, and do not waste real life money on it...the more you pay the less you win!

I've been playing this for over 7years. I like the game. Things imo have gone downhill with the game. Mini games are no longer fun. Always a scavenger hunt. Used to be a different game weekly. My favorites were the aerial challenge and the snowboarding. The zoo had concession stands. The regatta tasks, half of them are now about the mini game. They took the plane button away and I forget to fill it. The only thing left is the farming. I do still like that part. But a lot of the good is gone

I would give a full 5 star rating if customer service wasn't almost nonexistent. And IF they do get around to replying, expect nothing more than a half-assed apology, and -never- expect compensation for lost items (from event glitches causing you to lose, or things "disappearing" when being moved to barn). Don't even bother. (Update) Here we go again. game crashed, causing a misclick, and all I got was "We don't replaces losses. Check this website to learn how to play more carefully." Horrible.

Addicting game. Customer service responds in 1-2 days, however they will tell you that whatever the problem is, is not happening. I have things in my barn that sre not retrievable and items disappear. Also when using boosters it does not work for everything e.g. if using the factory decrease production time, it does not work for all factories. When purchasing the island increase your chances for items, I have received less than before I used the gems to receive more items. Still addicted!

As others have stated, the game in general is fun but the mini games are horribly frustrating. They are impossible to get past. The game is losing its appeal. Why would I play a game that causes frustration?? After reading other people's review it seems they all have one thing in common. The mini games are impossible to get past. Players are paying, actually given them money, in hopes to get past the mini games. Yeah, no, I refuse to pay to play, unless of course, I'm in Vegas.

When i first played the game (almost 6 years ago) it was fun. The mini games were achievable. The tasks were reasonable. It rated 5 stars. Now the developers have made all tasks harder, unachievable unless you have a lot of ingame cash. Before you can get a reasonable amount of ingame cash. But then the developers made that harder to do. Now the only way to finish tasks or events is to buy (with real cash) ingame cash. Basically all the fun has been taken out.

I am dropping my review to 1 star. I have done all the game updates and find many errors happening in the game. I'll start with in app purchases. They disappear and are gone with my cash. I fill trains and planes etc. I close the game and return later my items are gone and crates are not filled. I have enjoyed playing the game but I will no longer spend money for in app purchases. I've been playing for a couple of years and sorry it may come to an end. With the other Plarix games.

I have been playing for a few years. I enjoyed the game Prior to the last few months. The mni games are now Always the same few ( not as much variety). The golden ticket Events occur one after another. The prizes are only good if you spend real money to get the golden ticket. 1/3 Of the regatta tasks are now completing mini game tasks. Ect. But the most irritating thing, The last update I have had issues opening the game And the golden ticket game will not load. 3 DAYS CANT PLAY. UGH

I have been playing this app for a while and I use to really love it,but lately items have disappeared from my inventory. I can also close out the game and return and items that I have patiently waited to get are gone. I have also seen where there is glitches and it vanished as I moved it to the final area. I am very disgusted waiting for the items that take an hour or more end up gone. Disgusted! I lost over 600 green twshp. buck$ and didn't get them.

Been playing a few years now to kill time, and the last year it seems so much has changed, mostly for the worse (layout of matching game, takes forever to get to next level without spending money, power-ups you can buy for matching game, plus a ton of other issues I'm not typing out). And now I open it, and the game is in portrait instead of landscape?

Since the latest update I have been unable to play this game both on my PC and Android phone. On the PC it opens then straight away closes most times. Occasionally it opens for a few minutes, but ultimately closes again. On the Adroid I can't even open the app. I also hate that there is no longer a short cut to the airport. I tend to forget to go there more than I remember. The previous update you changed tge Regatta and now there doesn't seem to be a way to invite people to join the team. ????

There have been multiple times when I have purchased something in the game (using Township Cash or Coins through the City Market) & the purchase does not show up. Their customer support doesn't fix the problem. They just make excuses. How would you guys feel if you gave someone money and never received the products? Also, levels are getting so difficult they're not fun anymore. This game isn't fun & isn't worth playing.

This could be a 5 star game easily but it's far from it. 1) Constructing buildings, fulfilling orders, farming, producing materials .. everything pretty much takes a very long time to complete, I literally can only open the game and play on it for a few minutes then close it because there is nothing to really do except wait, wait, wait to do anything!! You're limited by caps put on buildings, only a couple ways to earn money, which take forever, not a lot to customize at all. It's a pay to play

I've played this game daily for about a year. And lately, more and more, I ask myself why I keep going. The sheer number of zoo enclosures I need to build is just downright stupid. The cost and amount of materials you need to gather... all while using those same materials for community building... is absurd. As you progress in a game it has to get harder, yes. But there is harder and there is impossible. This game is flirting with the later.

This game is clearly designed to take your money and nothing else. If you want to actually have fun while playing, I suggest finding another game. The matching side game is ridiculously hard. Anything you tried doing on this game is very limited in the fun department. Just expect to have about 10 minutes of fun before you can't go any further. You either have to pay up or wait to get reloaded. The epitome of greedy developers. Uninstalling.

Preys on addiction and impatience. 99% of the time you're just waiting. It takes hours to get simple supplies. "Optional" mini game is heavily rng based. Even if you start with items those items will spawn in the worst possible location. Takes forever to level up. Not sure what's supposed to be exciting about this game. Every little upgrade is locked to some limited resource. This game is preying on whales

Not as advertised... As many players found out, the game advertised (where you control the character, gather products to sell and develop your business) is just a mini game that very rarely shows up. This game is entirely different and while not the worst, it is a total disappointment when you expect to play the game you saw in the ad.

Misdirection of the ads so don't expect that "pass" or "fail" simple game to last more then the first 2-5 levels it will drop it. For it's the nature of most of these games, a pyramid the higher you go eventually you'll have to spend money. Nickel & dime, when they pull the plug cause they're not raking in the cash and you're left with nothing. Not even holding a "bag".

This is the game about building your farm! Nobody wants to play thousands of puzzles. You have 4 PUZZLE GAMES already and you add add this "very interesting minigame" to your best game. Everyone will be happy if you just remove this puzzle forever instead of answering "Your feedback is important for us. Have a good day". This is a really good game, one of the best on mobile in my opinion. It is very good that there is no add... For now. But this puzzle ruined everything. And it is sad :(

The game has a regatta game that for months now, hasn't been counting the tasks I've already accomplished. You can send a message to support, but you'll only get automated sentence fragments/questions to reply. It's a bit of time before you get a response, and when I informed them that the game erased my progress, I received a reply (quite a while later), that they didn't see anything wrong. Of course you didn't, my progress was erased. Not happy with it at all.

It's a lot of fun until they start asking you for money... The side game levels are so hard to beat after a certain level. Like impossible to beat unless you spend money... That's NOT FUN!! THIS GAME IS SUPPOSED TO BE FUN. You take all the fun out of it when you can't even play unless you spend money. It's 2025 and people don't have money for games. We play these games to relax not to budget into our bills. Fix it... Make the easy games actually easy instead of like all hard levels...

I love this game but I wish you can skip one of the mini game levels. I'm one but no maker how hard I try I can't beat it! Even my mom (who is really good at this game and at the mini games) can't even beat it AND she's on a harder level than me! That level is RIGGED. Also whats the point of naming the animals if other people can see what are the names? Also sorry I missed spelled some words. Btw the mini game is the blow up blocks game that I think it is rigged on my level! Please fix this.

false advertising - the game that I got as an ad barely exists in this. It came up 2-3 times while playing the larger game, but definitely not a central part. it's a time-waster and good for passing time while bored if you need (helped with some long flights - you can play most of it offline). the main component is creating a town with various factories, farms, features - and a big side-component is playing a "match 3" game. everything about the game is fine - but addictive. uninstalled.

This game is fun when you first start playing, but by the time you get to level 100, if not sooner, it's really boring. I've been playing several times a day for over 10 years and now I pop in long enough to give daily gifts and help my co-op and I'm gone. The repetitiveness of the same mini game and the developers not listening to long time players is frustrating. And like all the other games out there the ads are very misleading. I've seen a few and NOWHERE in the actual game do you play that!

Honestly the game was going excellent. No ads. There's a way around everything and so much to do to kill time. But I will admit level 118 on the puzzle is a scam. Avoid this game. IT will make you pay money to pass that level. It's not even by the count of moves you have left. It's the small spaces that you run out of moves too fast, shuffle does nothing, and the other 3 slots are filling up with no moves. Uninstalled and I'm not paying any money to play a game. Been stuck here for 7 days now...

This game looks and feels a lot like Royal match by dream. The match 3 definitely feels the same as Royal match with none of the quality of life mods: For example, when you play match 3 and use a power up, there's no guarantee it'll actually help you. You can use a power up that will just destroy a random item on the grid that has nothing to do with your objective. It very much feels like The game is just designed to get you to spend money. Such a shame. I really wanted to enjoy it.

I have been playing for a few months now. Spent about $5 thus far. This game is fun, addictive, challenging, w/ good soundtrack and nice mini games (though wish there were other minigames). However, by the time you reach about lvl 20, things start to get REALLY difficult. A lot of the game comes down to adquiring 'marerials'. But these are EXTREMELY hard to get w/o spending much real $. Question is: is it w/ spending the equiv. of a monthly subscription for streaming service? I don't think so.

I've played this game for years. Today, it suddenly says the puzzle event "isn't available on my device" and I lost regetta tasks. You've got bugs to work out. And your customer service sucks. It's been 3 days and only a canned email telling me to read the FAQs. 😡 Update: still no response from customer service. 😡 Happened again. Why isn't this big being fixed?

The game, particularly the mini games, soft lock you from progressing in order to get you to use microtransactions. The game is like every other game like it. It has nothing novel to offer that sets it apart from other games. It's just another glorified get-rich-quick scheme. That said, after scanning the installation it comes up with a keystroke logger which only appears listed when the game is installed, meaning the installation is infected with a malicious worm.

Used to be more fun and rewarding! Now, if you buy the season ticket, which gives rewards for levels played you get less Town Cash! Instead of $10 and $5, it gives $10 and $3 and instead of $15 and $10, it gives $15 and $5. The match games are crazy hard and encourages paying for boosts or extra lives to help. I literally play one level over 30 times before finally paying for extra lives to move on! SHAME ON YOU!

After a little over a year of playing this game, I cant do it any more. The game is no longer enjoyable. Tasks get more and more difficult to complete, which I didnt mind is much, but you rarely get anything from the market you need unless you already have it. Plus the absurd amount of resources and time required to expand your town it terrible. Sadly I will no longer support this game.

it takes to long on waiting for enough bricks glass slabs . Not all of us can play but part time. The zoo is to complicated now. They ask for way to many items. You dont get nearly enough cash . Mining u always run out of something . There needs to be more rewards . Let us buy with coins the market can be to high. Or make the cash more often .I am getting discouaged .

The farming game is good, but the puzzle game is completely unnecessary. I wish it didn’t exist because it feels out of place. I bought the monthly pass, but progress relies on the puzzle game, which is honestly frustrating. If you're marketing this as a farming game, there’s no reason to include unnecessary mechanics. The progress of the pass should come from the base game, not the puzzle game. I’m never buying anything from this game again because it’s clear the devs are just being greedy.

I love this game! I love my friends in our coop. Building materials needs separate barn takes up to much space. Need more gems since everything went to gems to purchase certain items instead of ingots. Need to not have so many mini games along with the regatta, just have one every other week. Need a large farmhouse too. The game is becoming less fun, everything costs, latest update no task icon in the right corner, no free golden balloon and no free chest out in the ocean.

Good game the only issue I have is the "candy crush" part of the game. The game needs boosters and a ridiculous amount of in game "cash" to be able to complete PURPOSELY difficult levels (to which I failed so many times and refuse to use any more of my boosters so I can prove this level is only successful if I use them). So if you can't pass the levels you can't progress the season pass. The story missions are fun to progress as well as the exploring element. This, the farming, and townships

I like playing this game. The problem is not having a better way to get the hundreds of supplies needed to build zoo enclosures for animals. (Bricks, glass, and slabs) also the amount of money to buy the enclosures to begin with. Also updated the barn as much as you have to to have enough to fill orders for the train, helicopter and zoo is hard.

Really bad interface, it's very hard to select what you want to interact with and not accidentally press something else. You can even accidently use premium items because there's no warning and it's hard to tell what you're selecting(ive wasted a lot of gems and the most valuable item a skip coupon this way). Also there's too many ads its hard to focus on the game. otherwise pretty fun and addictive and nice art style.

Gave me entertainment for a while. Definitely a cash grab. I have no problem with that. I just spent a lot of money on this game over the weekend. When I went to play it today it just crashed in the middle of a level and I lost my golden disco ball thing. So, I am over it. The helicopters are not smart, they should go where they are needed. Some levels cannot be won without the golden disco ball and/or spending actual money.

I used to love the game but now all the prices have gone up, the games are harder, it's next to impossible to get all the cards for the events unless you spend real money...trying to find something similar

I love this game. However, the cost of buisnesses are way to high. We need a barn for building supplies. This limit us in helping others more in r egattas also us as well. Building takes way to long we should get them in hours not days. The dealer should be less expensive as well. This game could be more fun if they fixed this problem. Since I wrote this review they have implemented new games and advantages. The games are great. Once the shops are finally purchased it is a little boring.

Played for a couple weeks and have hit a point where many of the player base complaints start to make sense. Times to build the quantities you need are long. Getting stuck on match three hard difficulty boards. Space management. All tedious. I log in play my 5 match 3 games, use all my lives. Close it out and play another game. Different match three same result. Trash bin.

Edit: I downloaded the game again and was reminded why I uninstalled it. When you use the ball, it doesn't affect objects they are hit and should be affected. Such as curtains or blocks..etc. This game makes you work hard for little rewards. Initially, I gave it 2 stars but changed it to 1. The game is fun until you get stuck on a level for days. I don't understand why the simple levels have so many moves, but the difficult levels don't have enough. I'm not spending any money on any more games.

This game is boring in the first few levels, then when your piggy bank is full, they charge you real money to open it. Now the game wants me to update the game but won't let me play because of storage space on my tablet, I deleted 2 apps and still I can't play now. All it does is says to down load and freezes. I liked the game, but it's not worth the aggravation, of closing all the time. I do like how you can feed animals, and farming.

This was a fun game until the update last week. The interface has changed so that everything is less clear, items are less visible, and the swipe effect doesn't pick up items in a line. It's all hit or miss and ruins the ease of the game. I have to hunt for the number or info I need and spend more time trying to collect items that used to be simple. Unlikely I'll keep playing now.

They will allow you to buy things and then take it away, and never make it right.Their customer service just makes excuses why they get to keep your money while not providing what you paid for. scam! scam! scam! dont do it!!! Shame I used to love this game!

Excellent task-oriented game that keeps you busy, glued to your phone, and broke. My issue with this game is that, at least for me, it's way too easy to spend way too much your actual money. While there's lots to do within the game, it's not enough to keep you playing while you wait up to 2 days for your efforts to bear fruit without spending money to keep you playing. Had to uninstall before I spent the rent money.

So basically, this is your run of the mill scam game. Things are easily done and easy to collect in the beginning. As you progress further, it becomes impossible to do anything without spending money. This game seems easier to scam the older audience I.E. parents grandparents and the like-minded such. Yeah, you can grind it out and wait, but there's no telling how long that can take. And only stresses you out and,in the end convinces you to pay with deals and packages they offer at a lower rate.

I gave it 5 stars because I truly love it.I have noticed that some features I enjoyed in the past are no longer available, such as merging, the mining competition to rank 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and the event calendar. The energy bar is quite small, especially since we now spend more energy to clear fewer than three obstacles. The regatta coins we earn for buying items are also very limited; I wish it were more of them. I feel it's not worth it to fill zoo orders because the XP and coins are way smaller

I would give this a zero stars! It was great to begin with, the tasks were challenging and exciting. Playrix have removed more and more rewards and this new fashion pass is ridiculous. Before you got to see how many tasks to achieve to reach the next level. They have now also changed the boosters and they are even worse! Each time you play a game, you only get given ONE KEY! So they've made it 10 times harder and force you to buy more purchases! I have seen many reviews at one stars recently.

Love the game its fun to play. My wife and I both play the game. Would of definitely gave it 5 stars but it seems if you have an issue with the game the developers don't seem to care to get back in touch with you over concerns and game malfunctions. Somebody doesn't seem to know how to do basic math for the game. You would think with as much in game purchases my wife and I make in this game they would want to try and keep that bank roll going. But I haven't heawas.othing In 2 wks.

this game use to be fun years ago. i don't mind the time frame it takes to build things, but what kept me coming back were the mini games. they were all different and so much fun. now, it's only a match 3 mini game. they lost their creativity and it has lost my interest. it's taken me a while to decide on leaving a review but I guess that's because i kept hoping they would bring back the mini games.

I really liked this game and the friends I've made playing. But they have become known for their glitches and their support is no help in addressing requests for help. Currently, it loses progress when you close the game, which seriously screws up competitions and impacts your team. The response from "support" was less than helpful and I couldn't get any more help when I told them the problem continued. They're not getting another dime of my money.

Final update: I will never play this game again. It's not worth it. PLEASE DON'T FALL FOR IT! The game became super expensive to play. You'd have to spend at least $10 a week. Even with the gold ticket, you still have to purchase Township cash, which is equally expensive, basically 50 TC for $2. The 50 TC is useless because even for the seemingly cheap goods, it buys nothing. Also, the mini-games concept was the reason I downloaded the game, but these get rare and harder as you progress. 🙄

Love this game and interaction with other players but I'm done putting money into it. I actually bought "The Golden Ticket" and suddenly my barn space decreased and I can't do anything without a $30+ investment to get more game money to buy more storage. I can't fill orders or do anything. I will just delete the game as I feel it's just manipulation. I just bought a house, I can't be feeding money into this game. What was fun and interactive isn't that way anymore.

You can't effectively play this game without spending real money! Here's what happens: to expand, you need to build buildings. The supplies come in on trains and you have no control over what supplies show up. They keep sending the wrong supplies on trains! I tried to earn enough app cash to buy supplies, but it gets put in a piggy bank that you have to pay real money to unlock! If you don't pay, it all disappears. Don't play this game! It just traps you into needing to spend your money.

Played the game for several months and enjoyed it-AT FIRST. By level 50+, the updates and changes started - I stayed to level 75. Task rewards became less or smaller...barn storage too small for all needs and it kept taking longer to increase storage capacity. If you like to pay REAL MONEY to play and buy your needed level ups, and such, you will fully enjoy this game. I'm very upset at myself for thinking this game was going to be different - just another suck you in, greedy game app.

I absolutely LOVE this game. I love that you can help people and all the stuff you can do. I wake up and get happy to tend my fields. Clearly, I have no life. Update 8/29/25: I would pay for the little $4.99 pass if it didn't just depend on the puzzle game. There should be other ways to get rewards besides the puzzle game. Everyone isn't good at it and we need more variety to advance in the pass levels.

Network issues need to be fixed. Occasionally during competitions you'll be up against a player whose score is way higher than anyone else's. You assume they're cheating because their score places them 1st within 5 minutes, then you spend 45 trying to surpass them. Today I spent a good portion of my T-cash to get about 400 points ahead of the "cheater" with less than 2 minutes to go. I felt great, only to then see I was 3rd and the other players' scores simply weren't updating. BS.

This is a fun game and a great time killer. That being said, here are my gripes. First off, this game is DEFINITELY pay to play. Some items take way too long to produce. In order to meet goals and deadlines, you have to spend real money. Secondly, some of the special events and mini games are stupid. The most recent of these being the gumball machine. This is by far the worst game out of all of them. I would give 5 stars if but I high doubt my 3 star review is going to strike any nerves with it.

I started playing very recently. Initially it felt good but later it makes you spend money for the silly items which are basically critical in expanding, building the town, or clearing the level(something similar to candy crush). Not at all similar to how the advertisement appears. Don't fall for it just like how I did😏. Cannot really come to give more than 1 star!

The game is okay. There are many that are similar. What turns me away from the game is the predatory premium currency mechanics. By default, it is extremely easy to accidentally spend premium currency. There is a setting to prevent this, but it's by default off... wonder why. Also, not to mention match-3 within the game is at times impossible to beat without spending premium currency for extra moves or infinity playing a level till you get that lucky line up, which is random.

I used to love this game, this was my sixth year playing. however, it's gotten really boring and repetitive. I miss the old mini games where they were actually varied and interesting. now, it's just match-3 games and it's not interesting. I would still send planes and trains and all but without the variety, the game as a whole just gets repetitive.

I only give this two stars. It used to be fun building. Now it seems it's all about the professor's experiment. Cost money for golden ticket. I'd like to build my zoo bigger also and now there is no attention paid to the zoo. I would like to be able to expand it and add some of my décor in there. Instead now there's a room that you build and I don't pay attention to anyone else's or mine, you don't really see them. They make the puzzle so hard it ends up costing money.

This game has turned into a greedy cash grab. Mini games are made hard to get you the spend money on in game tcash so you can beat them. This is NOT fair game play. I played for several years happily. Not anymore. I have removed this game from all my devices! They have been experiencing an excessive amount of technical difficulties the past few months as well.

Despite the false advertising, this game was fun - until it wasn't. Farming is okay, but super slow. The match 3 mini game WAS mostly fun, moderately challenging, with a few Hard/Super Hard levels sprinkled in at a difficulty that took a few tries. Now those levels are significantly more frequent and nearly impossible to complete without buying your way through them. With over 100 million downloads, it's obscene what they're charging for in app purchases. NOT addicted to this game anymore.

I've had this game for about 2 years now and it seems like everytime they update the textures, they take something away. We used to have a variety of minigames, prizes, and side tasks that would be free. Now they cater towards people willing to pay for any fun add ons. We even used to have holiday decorations we had opportunities to win, and they took those away, too. I think my time with this game is almost done, it's not worth it anymore.

The game itself was fun, but every time they update the application, it got bigger. It won't even fit on my phone anymore. AFTER I tried deleting unused photos, videos, and apps. And it was a data hog too. Stop "improving" the darn game so frequently. You've improved it too much for it to fit!!! As of 12/27/19, on fifth attempt to re-download the game, it WILL NOT even download all the way, let alone install, after deleting most other apps on my (new and improved) phone. Bye, Felicia!

2.5 stars. The game is fun, but they make it too easy to accidentally spend game cash. There should be a confirmation button before the game cash is deducted in case of accidental press. The mini puzzle games are oftentimes too difficult. You have to play them over and over again or use game cash to get to the next level, and their game missions/adventures rely on the player completing a certain number of levels of the mini-game. It seems futile.

I have played this for years, and gave it a 5 star , really having fun, NOW NO MORE! YOU HAVE MADE THE MINI GAMES TOO HARD AND YOU WILL NOT GO TO NEXT LEVEL WITHOUT TOWN CASH. I'm really disappointed in the creative team. Please make it where, you can at least play a different game then the puzzle all the time too. Thank you.

The game is is not a bad game. It is the support that brings it to its knees. Chatting with others in the game I have heard of people loosing real cash in the game and support ignoring the issue. I had several game items disappear and have spent a month+ trying to have a real person, not a bot, reimburse the game tokens used to purchase those items. I am thankful I did not use real cash. Hopefully no one else will pay real cash to play. They may loose it to Playrix.

This game is very addictive game it's really too nice. but when you come to the animations of the factories it would be nice instead of boxes there would be something different in each of the factories. if that was there it would be a best game for me. Edit: I regret writing this review. I am really sad seeing how this game has evolved over the years. It was a fun city building game until the devs decided to get a bunch more (fake) players using 100% clickbaity ads. Absolutely trash.

False advertising on the Professor's experiments. Some tasks are completely unattainable due to the game's algorithms, after players spent real cash on the Gold Pass. Not the first time it's happened, but shame on me for paying the cash again and thinking the game developers had grown a conscience. Never again. Additionally, there have been no updates for community buildings or houses for over a year now. Once you hit a certain high level, there's nothing else to work towards.

yada yada yada Ya! It's dumb game after all. There is always an ask to Buy you own Bank, that's dumb but expected. I have not and will not spend a nickel on this or Any game. The more levels you achieve the more is required to build or expand and the Barn capacity expansion is so small it's ridiculous. As youadvance and build the materials seem to come in lesser quantities and buildings need more, cost more. It's progressive and progressively harder to advance or even keep up.

the game is great. however there is a huge issue I. that game cash accumulated disappears. I have followed the suggestions, it does not fix the problem. repeated contact attempts to customer support yield a run around. they do not read what I wrote, but refer me back to look at their work around. I told the. the work around were flowed and the did not fix the issue. thus..... assuming they could care less if they are fixing their game and care nothing for the players.

I've had this game since 2017 and watched it go from a really good game to a money grab. I stopped playing for a while because of that and the overall quality has just declined. 1. There used to be a bunch of mini games, now this 3 match for ALL the seasons just isn't cutting it! 2. The seasons used to be 30 days now they cap at 21 days. 3. The prizes in the regatta are ok and cost more than they should. The game is free but to have any progression in a reasonable time frame you have to pay.

4/5 stars! Township is a fun game where you build and manage your own town! However, I'd love to see a small fix: even though I've opted for confirmation when spending T-cash, it doesn't apply when adding moves to "Play On" after failing a level. This has led to accidental purchases a few times, which is frustrating. Hope you guys can fix this soon!

puzzle games are more than frustrating. I don't think it's ok to HAVE to repeat the same level so many times just because it's extra hard, using those boosters makes it even more frustrating because they are intentionally located in impossible places just so you can't use them. Not all of the boosters and combos detonate in the way the player intended, they sometimes move in a different way. Fix and rebalance the levels, it's not fun to be stuck and have to pay in game money just to pass the lvl

I used to love this game but the changes over the past 6+ months have made it much less appealing. The latest change, where it is no longer a "golden ticket" but instead a "fashion pass" does not offer even half the level (quality) in rewards and can now only being obtained through mini-game play. I have zero incentive to play the expedition as well, since the prizes from that were already on the decline prior to this. I'm growing more and more disappointed in this game with each update.

UPDATE: I just lost a little respect for Township. They used an ad that doesn't show what their game truly is! It's not a game where you put out fires and connect pipes to water. It's a fun farming and simulation game with lots of details and fun events. I wish they didn't resort to fake ads like those Homescapes people. Bad call, guys.👎👎👎 OLD: I LOVE all the the little details.

Absolute scam of a game. You can't do anything from the very start without paying for in game tokens to speed up things like growing, building, even milking cows. You're just sitting there waiting for 5-10 minutes between activities. There's nothing else to do in the game. Normally games give you at least an hour of play before that happens. I ran out of things to do in less than 10 minutes, including tutorial. Nice graphics, though. I guess. It COULD be fun without the pay-gate.

It was fun and fair during the early levels, but at 60+ levels, it's a slog. I slowly lost interest in the separate game components, but what really irked me was the 3-match at higher levels, which is ridiculously unfair. It's torture to keep replaying one of the hard levels dozens of times before the dice rolls in your favor. Time to look for another form of entertainment.

I like the farming because you can grow it at your own pace, but the games inside (matching tiles, matching patch etc) are very hard to win up to impossible. What is supposed to be relaxing, has become very stressful. It is not what i expect of a game that i play when i try to relax from day to day tasks. You can only win after you spent 15 lives. So, I will be looking f something relaxing, not this unpartial and rigged game.

Been playing this game religiously for a while, and almost reaching level 3000 on the match game. Lately I've been noticing that the hard levels come way too often (like after finishing a hard one, it's easy, and the next is hard again) and they are basically impossible to finish. The helicopters also seem to be sooo stupid in these hard levels. While I do spend money in the game, this tactic of yours makes me feel forced and it takes away the fun.

I have been playing this for 8 years. It used to be fun and challenging, but not too frustrating. Now it's just a cartoony, money-suck that is so hard, if I were a new player I'd give up. Gone are the fun, challenging minigames, replaced by (how amazing) match-3. Repetitive and boring "adventures" have replaced room decorating events. There used to be a zoo to build and fill with decor and animals, but half the players had it taken away. Don't waste your time with it!

I enjoy building this town, but that's about it. It's changed for the worse. There's now only ONE mini game, a match-3 with the same canned storyline, and it gets SO boring very quickly. They also changed up how Regatta works, so you can't reserve tasks any longer, and they deleted the cute town decorations for purchase in the store. Now the only prizes you can buy are boosters for the boring mini game, or building materials, the prices of which go up permanently after a threshold is reached.

I like the game. It literally leaves control in your hands but also adds challenges that you can participate in or ignore. The 99 cent game cash sales and the increase in receiving land clearing items have improved the game and makes it easier to expand your city. If you want to build the zoo, have extra gems, building supplies, and factory items before you start the tutorial. The game does not warn you that you will use your actual items. Other than that oversight, the zoo becomes a very lucrative asset to your town.

Over all a fun game, but the "special offers" they run for in game discount purchases take all the game money that you earned while playing the game and they want you to buy it back with your own money, at a discount price of course!!! Not liking that so called special discount offer, for the game cash I earned playing. Don't waste your time with this game, unless you want to spend your money to play it.

Once you put items in your inventory you can't get them out because there is no option to open your inventory. No button, no tab, no anything to indicate your inventory. I clicked on EVERTHING, and there I no inventory. Where do the items go? Is this a glitch? A bug? Poor design planning? Like what's up with being able to put items in the inventory, but not have it exist to retrieve the items?

2/22/25 This game has become a boring tedious obligation. The only reason I haven't un-installed it is because of the others in my co-op but I have to force myself to play for a few minutes a day. It would be one thing if the developers just stopped "upgrading" the game but there are frequent updates. They are pointless cosmetic updates that add NOTHING to the game play. Only one "match three" type side game when it used to be a variety of games. Even then, it's a very boring side game. Lame.

From awesome to money greedy and boring. I've been playing this game everyday for years. It's the longest game I've ever invested my money and time in. Ever since covid the game has become boring and repetitive. It's the same 3 mini games. Bring back the plane game, the cafe, the one where the truck has to make it to the end, it's just the same old stuff each month. Rev and ride, bubble gum and match 3. Even the professors experiments were better then this monthly nonsense. Just feels lazy.

Overall, I like it. The art is nice, game is fun, they even have little people walking/driving around town. It's cute. However, it is ridiculous that when an accidental purchase with their in-game cash is made, they can't fix it due to "internal policy". Not even once. Um, wut? That makes no sense. Even Fortnite has a 1 time fix. I started spending on this game and was fully prepared to spend much more, but I think I'll stop now. I have no interest in financially supporting such "policies".

I've been playing for quite a while, the game has gone downhill and with this latest change I'm ready to delete the app. We used to have a variety of mini games and scavenger hunts. I miss the mini games, not just the match games. The fruit, the road crossing, and a variety of other games. What happened? Even the regatta games changed. I'll give it another month, after that it's a wrap. I truly enjoyed this game, now Monopoly Go has become my #1. Sorry Township!

It is a very fun game. I would rate it 5 out 5, except for the fact that special events always center around one game. Before, 4 or 5 games would alternate, but now, it is always the same one, and it always leads to a level that is practically unfeasable. The goal is obviously to make you spend township dollars, and real money to replenish them. For that reason, I don't take part in the special event. Even if you pay 6.99 for seasonal events, in order to progress it is back to the game.

This game is engaging and fun, but I uninstalled it after the "Piggy Bank" appeared after 3 days. Originally you earn coins and cash to use as you wish.
