The Bank started to take my cash as I earned it. It would cost $2.99 to get it out. You earn cash in the game, and you can buy more with real $$ if you want. You can use game cash for optional things like speeding up play, but you also need it for essential tasks. No fair, I say! Let players buy cash if they want, but don't force us to.

Open my game to find out I can't interact with anyone because the are saying I cheated. I asked and support mentioned in game balance inconsistencies and ended the conversation. I asked again what inconsistencies and no reply. I deleted the game. Ive been playing for 5 years no problem. All of a sudden, I play every day and it says can't connect to server and now I'm being accused of cheating. Very upset!

Although I do find this game fun and intriguing....I am frustrated with a few things. For example, one of the games features if the "piggy bank" that holds your earnings however to receive those earnings, you have to pay to break the piggy bank. Another example is construction items that are only supplied by the trains...but certain items are never on those train or will only have 1 every 10 or more trains.

I've been playing regularly for several years. However, the game used to be much more fun. I understand the company was recently sold and it shows in the fact that it's all about forcing the player to spend more money (real and TC) while getting less enjoyment out of the game. Shame on you for turning a fun game into a boring money grabbing experience!!!

So addictive! I've only been playing this game for less than 3 months and I'm on it everyday, lol. Update: Been playing for 256 days in a row. I know because you get a reward for every day you log in. Great game. Edit: no longer a great game. You can't finish any of the side events or mini games unless you're prepared to spend serious cash. Very disappointed in how this game has become all about money. And don't get me started on the glitches, they are ridiculous. !!!NOT A FREE TO PLAY GAME!!!

This game looks absolutely NOTHING like the ads. I played the ads, installed the game, and after just a minute of playing it, I immediately lost interest and uninstalled. The ads show the game as a straightforward concept of dragging a character around a small stand to basically harvest food, sell them to customers, collect money, and use it to pay for any upgrades, such as hiring workers, upgrading tools, and even expanding your stand. However, the game itself looks drastically different.

Want to force tutorials? So you can force people to pay TCash? No thanks✌️ also, it lied in the game ads. It's a completely different game than the trailer shows. I've played this game many times before in the past and thought it was great and I used to love it, but now it's obvious that greed got the best of them and it's completely unplayable for people that can't pay and makes it unfair. Unless you have months of patience, I'd recommend a different game farm game if you enjoy them like I do

I wanted to love the game but I don't. The ad is misleading, it's not a farming game it's a town building one. Maybe a good one but that's not what I was looking for. The design is also way too busy for my liking, you start off with full busy map, a couple of tips and off you go - i found it too overwhelming. Shame cos I would have played the game featured in the ad much longer!

It was a fun game. I only downloaded it to get points on another game. The offer failed and did not register so I dropped the game. Theres steady progress and a puzzle game mode you can do while waiting for your crops to grow. You can progress without paying although it is slow going. Trains are your best friend. It is more enjoyable if you know other people who play it. Although there is a kind of find friends option? I never explored it.

Run with your money! First 20 levels or so u can play without money. They have mastered the art of getting you to pay. In three months of playing, I have spent $1000 or more when I haven't spent money on any other games in last 15 years, besides the initial purchase prize. With changes made July 2024 it's not worth playing. They getting too greedy, I'm done!

Was fun until it wasn't. Like others have stated, you definitely have to spend money/hours to make progress. The puzzle game is set to make you lose after 2 or 3 wins. There's never enough building stuff to upgrade your town. I have 30 paint buckets but will only get one nail every 5 trains. My last straw was in the story part of the game. i got pretty far, but the map wouldn't clear the fog. Even after using two dynamite. I enjoyed my time, but it's time for uninstall. It's too tedious.

The latest update made this gameplay suck. In yet another attempt to mirror Royal Match, the gameplay has been made harder and the dollars don't stretch as far. What has been, until now, a fun match-3 game with farming elements that I played daily has become a pathetic money grab. Additionally, my hundreds of power-ups were converted to a handful of less beneficial power-ups. I'm moving from 5 stars to 2 stars. I've been someone who regularly buys from the game to debating deletion.

I have been hooked on this game for 10 years. I used to love it. My zoo has been done for years, I have nearly 90 million coins and nothing to spend them on! Most rewards are tools I dont need because everything is done. The mini games are too hard to be fun and too expensive to play. There is no real help any more! Same boring search game over and over! Used to have fun side games. Constantly crashing and losing work and tasks. Most ratings are similar to mine. You don't care what we want!

At first it was a very easy and nice game to relax, but once you get past the initial encouragement stage, it starts demanding you to put money in. Like DEMANDING. No way you are getting through the stupid level in the puzzle unless you give us some money. 80 pieces in 10 moves, impossible. And building construction is the same. I was going to put some money in for fun but this was so obviously made to force you to put cash in, so cheeky and unworthy that I am dropping if right then and there.

I think this game is an excellent game to play on a daily basis. The only issue that I have is with the flying boosters. Their logic doesn't seem to make any sense. I've lost a bunch levels due to the flying boosters landing on the incorrect gem. It's frustrating to lose on a level because the flying booster didnt go where it was expected to go. Other than that, the game is great. 4 out of 5 due to the flying boosters issue.

This game is fun but it forces you to spend money due to materials needed to complete construction not delivered, then out of nowhere, my barn capacity decreased from 305 to 235 after paying to upgrade. I like the game but I will not be forced to spend more money....the more I spend, the less I get!!! There's no special incentives for spending money. This is unacceptable.

Great game but yoy know it would be nice to actually play the game free from the waiting and the waiting and waiting. Just give me the option to unlock everything in the game including the map expansion that way I can just free play. That would be awesome. And the little mini game I'd love to be able to just have a version of playing like that and collecting and buying the areas within the little mini game.

Frustrating. The higher levels are annoying, not a fun game. I can play the same level 20 or 30 times- why make it so impossible? And everything takes so long in the factories. Not a fun game anymore. It was fine for a bit, but now I have no desire to keep going because it seems unattainable and not what I'm looking for as a leisure game. Everything about this game screams greedy to me - they are dying for you to spend your money.

Barn size kills this game. At level 13 barn size was 90 and there are 29 different items types. So you can't build up a small stockpile of items to complete orders. Game makes to wait multiple hours to do a simple task or spend real money to slightly speed it up for a short time. Any game that is more concerned with how much money you give them rather than how much fun you have playing it, gets 1 star in my book.

it's a cute game but once you get past level 40 it takes forever to gain XP and LevelUp and the factories takes a really long time to produce. some things can take 2 days to produce, upgrade or build. I wish you can send items personally to certain players as gifts instead of them having to request them. you can't chat to other players not unless they're in your Co-op. it automatically uses your Facebook friends even if you don't want them. you can only have a Max at 50 friends not including Fb

Have had a fun & entertaining time for the last two yrs or so... years ago I was a hardcore FarmVille player, but had to give it up for various reasons, bummed about not having a way to play it on the phone. So happy when I found this game! I've just been reading comments while downloading latest update, & feel the same way as many that my only real dislike is the increased difficulty in making progress in the game without spending $$$ for in-game "cash", very frustrating at times! Like so many

As stated by many reviewers: nice farming game minus the ridiculous paid content they like to shove down your throat every now and again. The events do not start over at level 1 when it comes to the puzzles which is silly to me that they do this. Barn fills up super fast and while I end up selling stuff not needed, it gets tedious. Not exactly free to play friendly and not interested in the gold ticket even though the benefits are absolutely absurd...

I have been playing this game since 2016. It used to be a really fun game. They no longer offer new decor. Building and decorating my town was what I enjoyed. Now to get anywhere on the game you have to play match 3 games. These games are impossible to beat without spending real money. There used to be daily tasks you could complete to get ahead, but no longer. Sadly a lot of long time players are leaving. There is no new decor to look forward to so there is no point in playing.

I really like this game but after they shorted me one day for the 5-day help at the market, it's BS! There's 24 hours in one day and I put an alarm for when it'll expire. Count the days, people. Just sayin'. And now, this "fox" that keeps popping up to tell me to download wildscapes is just getting too annoying!! I've spent quite a lot already to just delete this game. Grr!

Plane missions don't make sense. You have 30 mins to complete your orders while other stuff is being made for them as that other stuff also has longer time periods. Then your plane missions always don't get completed on time no matter how you do them. Please fix your time rates. Waiting for a 3 hour product to be made is gregariously annoying. Fun game on the other hand, but timewise, it isn't worth it.

The game was great for years. I enjoyed playing and spent money to improve my town and zoo. Now it costs lots just to play. No more zoo or, a variety of fun side games. Now there's a boring, often impossible, side game called by different names. If you don't play it, you can't do much. If you don't pay cash you can't win some levels or get the best prizes. The game is now a money grabber with too many changes from the begging. It's just not much fun anymore. Wish it hadn't changed!

Game is bad. It's time delayed progress . Literally just started. Played 15 and I already got 1 hour timers just for eggs . What's the point of the game if you can't play it. They try to make you spend your in game cash(which costs irl money) which is he only way to get any progress. They said no ads which is true , but instead replaced it with pay to continue playing.

I enjoy playing this game but I wish it wasnt so money hungry. For just about everything, it asks you to pay for "more". Pay for more coins, pay for more cash, pay for the cash you earned, pay for more materials and goods. The side games would be alot better if the prizes were more of the things needed to progress in the game, such as building materials. $2 towncash or coins is pretty useless and makes the game boring. Everything costs towncash which you get prompted to buy alllllllll the time!

it's an addicting game so far, but I wish they can let us have more freedom with the edit features!! It sucks that they don't let you remove farms that I accidentally built! I mean I already spent the money by accident and now it's taking up precious space in the town... I guess that's how they make you spend real money to try to get farther in the game =.=

If you like to building cities, farming, feeding animals, having nice decorations, do not play this game. The last update ruined everything I mentioned. You will spend more time with playing the stupid matching game, which you can not win. You can obviously spend money to make it work or you can play and play and at some point get lucky with the algorithm and win.

It was bad enough that the game was falsely advertised, but I still gave it a shot. All was good and well until levels became impossible to complete. They want you to buy dollars for everything, and it's expensive for small stuff like $10 for 5 more moves as if that would help. Then the same $10 for 35 moves after playing the level 20 times, and they give out very little rewards. High demand with a very slow production and very little in return. I'm over the game now. Next.

I really love this game. I recently started playing, but have played daily. I purchased the golden ticket last month and it helped me explore other areas of the game and made things slightly more achievable, and fun. I bought the pass this month before I realized how difficult it was going to be. I don't mind supporting a free game, but this months pass feels deceitful. I want to play all areas of the game, not just match 3. I am not inclined to spend more because of a cash grab. So sad.

Fun game. Just need to be patient. No one nor animal starves to death, so there is no pressure in that respect. As the game progresses, the need for building supplies increases, while the supply of them does not, leaving building projects that might literally take weeks or months to complete (depending on your frequency of play). This challenges my will to continue with the game. I am fast approaching my limits of my patience, but will keep on playing for now.

This game used to be loads of fun with plenty to do. Now seems with every update they get rid of more stuff. Minigames down to just the match 3 when there used to be lots of different ones. With the most recent update they got rid of the puzzle decorations. I was looking forward to making it to the space themed puzzle decoration, but now they are all gone. What was even the point of getting rid of those.

Terrific graphics and you can move and rearrange whatever you want to. Expand as you can, it gets harder the more you move up a level. When you get to level 19 you can join a Co-op group. Just please read carefully what the co-op leader expects of you to join. Then you can chat with everyone else in the group It makes it more fun playing. There are a few problems with the game:example when the game updates we usually have freeze spots. Developers work quickly to resolve issues. Love the game😇😇

Used to love this game...now too greedy!! This game is quite fun but now the makers are just getting too greedy! More and more it requires you to pay if you want things. The worst is now building supplies to increase the barn. They used to slowly send supplies which was annoying because you would run out of room quickly and could not play as well. Now, it is so MUCH worse and they don't send materials even half as much as they used to....trying to force you to spend money to buy.

This is a cool game, but is impossible to work through unless you spend $. They have it set to not give materials needed to complete the buildings. I've got unfinished buildings cuz the ONE material won't come by train which is literally the only place to get them. I refuse to use my game cash to finish a building. That's not even good practice on the makers part. I don't mind waiting a few days but weeks? No. I'm thinking I will just go back to Hay Day. This game will cost you!

Decent game to pass the time. Way too much time to wait between tasks/growing crop items. Most games usually have an option to play the game to win "play money" to do more within the game. In this game you can do that, BUT then you have to BUY your earned "play money" in order to use it. Seems silly to have to play to earn something you'll just have to buy to use anyway.

Played game for 5 years. Gone 2wks and now zoo is gone?!? I spent time and money on that. They did not give us anything back for it. Did not even allow us incentives back or at least let us to decorate our town with those enclosures! I have friends in the game that play. They are about to lose alot of players. And for how much money for in-game purchases has gotten worse. I want plane button back over the build button, may never get materials due to barn capacity and never getting them on trains

I really wanted to like this game! But my issues with the game started as soon as it loaded up. The game I saw in the preview is not the game, it's a side game and I've been playing for less than a week and I've only gotten to play it twice for a minute or two both times. I bought the golden ticket the 2nd day I played, now less than a week later the game wants another 5 bucks for another golden ticket? Also like others stated, there is no value in it or and game freezes. Uninstalled!

I've been playing this game for over a year now, its quite addicting. However, lately there have been some issues that are making me consider finding a new app. For 1, whenever I come back into the game after being away for hours my township cash is down to $90. No matter how much I had before I got off the game, I come back & it's at $90. This has happened 6 times now within the past 2 weeks.The other issue is too long for this review section. I ran out of characters, unfortunately. Just beware

Imho this game is TERRIBLE. If you don't want to spend money you will not have fun. It takes an absurd amount of time to make the products you need so you will be logging in for 5 minutes at a time and then waiting forever. They have a side game that I thought would make this tolerable, but it's the same story as with the main game. It takes over 20 energy to get through 1 obstacle and you get 7 energy for each match 3 level beat. I got to level 118 and attempted it over 50 times. Uninstalling.

Do not expect to get far unless you plan to spend money. I do REALLY enjoy this game, but winning mini game challenges for in-game prizes/farm cash will cost real money. And when those of us who do spend real money (guilty as charged), a game glitches or something ridiculous happens, and you lose farm cash. It's a 50/50 chance game support replies to any issues. Still a fun game. No ads, fun tasks.

Coming up on 7 years playing this game & spending tons of money. Taking away something else every month is getting old, you're just plain greedy at this point. We have fewer ways to earn & progress in the game than ever. You guys had a good thing going & everyone loved it the way it was but you keep tweaking it & taking things away from your loyal players. I definitely don't feel appreciated. I am done with the passes & will probably delete this game once I play out this pass. Like the others!

Have you ever had a company that is either so incompetent or so malicious that their app features events which are impossible because the game fails to accumulate energy tokens as it's supposed to? Welcome to Township. You know, the game that's nothing like the adds and features bugs that mean that you may or not be able to play as you planned, depending on if the app cooperates that day. Long story short, run. Fast.

I enjoy the game itself, and I would be inclined to leave a better review, however, given that the support center does absolutely nothing except provide random bot responses that occasionally provide useless articles, but more frequently do absolutely nothing. I have been playing this game for almost 2 years. I have put literally hundreds of hours into it. But I will not be playing this game for another minute. I am done dealing with all of the problems and getting absolutely no assistance.

The game no longer has fun in-game games. They repeat same 4 in-games over and over. They even make in-games so hard you have to purchase your way out or your stuck forever. They no longer give fun decorations for Hollidays that you can purchase with in-game money. If you don't purchase golden ticket with real money, you might not as well play. I use to love playing and decorating, but now I don't even play. Township you really messed this game up!

Just a money grab! This game used to be fun now they have taken away everything you need to beat a level. They took away all the good perks in the grand prize. Also once you get to a certain lvl there aren't anymore buildings or homes to build so you literally have nothing to do. Seriously if I have to do one more Richard and Ellen quest I'm gonna lose my mind. They took away the other fun games that broke up the monotony of the game. I won't spend another time on this game!

I would rate it 5 stars if you would just listen to us once in a while! When we asked you to update the issue with reserving tasks, we wanted it so people couldn't steal the task you have reserved!!! How hard is that? But instead, your solution is to put a time limit on us? I spend a lot of money on this game and I expect better listening skills from you, you big jerks. And don't make it so hard to upgrade the darn barn!!! So stupid. My opinion, a year later, hasn't changed.

I do not like that the mini games are hard. I can't pass them anymore so I stopped trying. I also get really frustrated that their is not endless storage like on Klondike. I keep getting "barn is full" any time I to to collect goods. The amount of township cash you need to buy the extra building materials is a joke. 284 town cash just for the bricks? I'm not putting money into this game for 30 more storage spaces. Maybe 30000 more storage. Im moving on to an easier game with better mini games.

Waste of time .it's really time consuming . And they are not even providing garden cash . Even if I collect it goes to piggy bank which is of no use . They want us to spend money from our wallet . For example for a sheep to produce wool it takes nearly 4 hours . And to construct a building more than 10 hours . Game is fine but please reduce the timing and give more cash .

it's very fun but gets to a point where you can no longer play without spending actual money. I just gets harder to accomplish anything. It's also frustrating because you EARN money in the game but they make you pay to access it. so you do tasks to earn in game money in a piggy bank but you need to pay 3.99 real money you access it. Very strange. I've since deleted it. Fun game though.

Cannot recommend to new players - when I started just a year and a half ago - We had Lucky the Dog, Adventure AND merge games, Mayor competitions, Double Helicopters, able to reserve tasks, daily tasks, DECORATIONS (not just profile pictures and town signs) that you could buy if you wanted to or earn through regatta races - now I'm hearing even the zoo is going to go away! This used to be a game where different sorts of playing levels or interests could play - but no more. It is so sad!

I agree with the other reviews about missing the variety of mini games there used to be. Also, i wish you would put the plane button back next to the train and helicopter. i often forget to go back and check on the plane and since it's timed, i lose everything i loaded. Also, i miss the daily tasks we could do to help earn points towards the rewards. Lastly, there needs to be more variety in the regatta tasks. bring back the plane and zoo tasks.

I love this game, except for the edit feature where you can put things in "storage" while you redecorate. the storage area gets in the way of the screen so you can't see to add your buildings, etc. back to where they need to go along the left edge of the screen. edited to add: please also consider how unreasonably expensive things get as you advance in the game. it takes months for me to get enough to build only 1 factory..

After many years of play it's finally time to change my rating. This game was fun and I enjoyed it for a very long time. It's now become so focused on money and these miserable merge mini games that I am avoiding playing. The dealer is rigged to never have items you really need. I get it, the devs need to make money, but it's gotten to a point where the game isn't fun enough to justify the costs. I absolutely despise the mini merge game. Devs, read your recent reviews and the subReddit. Fix it.

Like all games that are fun and addictive, even if you invest few of your own$$. The supply and demand to continue playing gets ridiculous: to load a plane or train, example: large quantities of materials needed to load. What sucks also with that if you barn isn't large enough your DEADLOCKED unable to do anything with gameplay. Positive: it can be a fun game, if you can put your own money into the game!!!

I loved the game when I first downloaded it. I've been playing 2 days and already at level 20.Addictive yes, fun yes. It was all fun and games until the piggy bank come into play. I find it a slap in the face all the hard work and time you put in to create the town.Then the monies you earn you can't have until you spend real money. Very poor choice and it takes the fun out of the game. I'll come back and do another review, but if this continues I will uninstall and find something different.

I don't like that you really have to spend cash to have cash, the opportunity to earn more isn't enough. Tip: if you're part of a good co-OP that really helps each other out, you will do well. The side games, the game operator seems obsessed with Need for Seeds, To The Market, Roller Coaster, and Skiing, we all want to cook, blend more, but it appears they don't want that so I am currently looking for another game to add that I involves that since Township peeps don't listen to suggestions

I used to love this game, but now...I'm just feeling punished. The game prioritizes spending real $ on stuff, and if you don't then you will wait. And wait and wait. I get that games usually get harder as you go along, but here... the time is getting longer AND the requirements are growing AND the games are more difficult AND the cost of tasks are increasing AND the amount of tasks is increasing. It's not fun - it's manipulative.

The latest update has made this game far less enjoyable. It's now nearly impossible to complete most regatta tasks since they make you "beat" the level to retain the points and the market now sells way less items. The golden ticket is now really not worth the $4.99 every 20 days. Whomever thought of these updates is just going to drive players away. Might as well go back to Merge Dragons as I can get a lot more use out of less money spent there.

They destroyed a great game. Every time they update it, they take things away. It's all Match 3. They're not smart enough to realize the real money is in expanding on the original concept: lots of game variety and great rewards, new decor, skins, etc, more expansions, add areas similar to the zoo (parks, cities), a store to buy past decor and such, various monthly subscriptions, upgrade the coop chat, allow members to share and trade items and decor, and more. DO BETTER

For suggestions, I think it would be more visually appealing if there were WEATHER CYCLES, like rainy days, stormy weather, or winter. And I think it would be cool if it had a DAY AND NIGHT cycle. So far, I love this game! It keeps you engaged with the tasks, but I sometimes find it hard to finish other tasks and challenges, especially in the match-3 puzzle game. It obviously requires you to spend Tcash.

I have been playing this game for several days now and it never gets less frustrating. Some levels take so many tires to beat that it has me ripping my hair out. As someone who is a masochist I'm pretty sure if my dominant told me to beat 10 levels of this game, I would cite the 8th constitutional amendment. The concept of the game is fun, don't get me wrong, but the levels are either way too easy or difficult, and don't get me started on how badly programmed the helicopter booster is. Aughh!!!

I mostly like this game. Play a lot. Don't like the new update that makes it so I can't give gifts to my coop team members and turns my friends list into a competition. It is nice to see what friends need and help them more conveniently. Also, I don't like how often I have to spend game cash to win the mini game or buy saws, etc. game is not random with saws and hammers and too stingy to give them out. It is a frustratingly slow pace to build/expand some things.

This game has some annoying flaws, and is also designed to make you spend money to achieve any success. There is a limit on the number of regatta tasks you can do, supposedly 13, but it often only allows a few tasks then you are locked out for hours. The time for things such as expansions or new builds also mysteriously gets longer than originally advised. I have played this game for a couple of years but each upgrade makes it less enjoyable. Time to find a new game......

had I read all the reviews first I would have known that when you get to a certain point, it's pay to play. the match 3 mini games become impossible to advance without having to spend 10$ of cash. which is impossible to get by achieving tasks( or growing old, whichever comes first). then the little things that become increasingly frustrating and quite annoying, like when you need to produce 6 sneakers but you have to grow your rubber trees that'll take 11hours!!! when your plane departs in 5! et

this game is one of the worst match three games there is. Most match three games don't require you to spend money on them. this game is awful. fun to play for about 100 levels and then that's it. all of the levels after that fail to give you adequate moves to complete. you either play the level 15 to 30 times, or pay to progress. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS GAME AT ALL. COMPLETS WASTE OF TIME AND EFFORT

I've been playing this game for quite some time now and I've spent quite a bit of money and mostly it's the match 3 game.. when the green machine feature hits they make it impossible to get the $500 township cash unless you want to play the game 24/7!! I play A LOT and I still can't get it!! it's ridiculous and I'm about to delete the app. not to mention you have to wait hours for the factories to make products!! At this point it's not fun anymore!!

really enjoying game so far. I am involved in Facebook pages and generally there are lots of comments about how frustrating the game has got from higher level players. mostly storage difficulties, and getting building supplies and the lack of response from developers. Many are asking for relpys and saying the are near point of giving up. I spent a little real money, first time, recently to give myself a boost, but it has slowed my game play down as I now don't get offers as often...disappointed!

The game design is nice... I'm on day 2 and getting frustrated... There's no time to build up any type of supply... It takes hours to be able to fill the train and you're also suppose to be filling helicopter orders... I tried the golden ticket to see if it would help w/ time.. nope!!! You need to decrease the amt of time it takes to make things... I'm ready to give up already!!!

I would give a ZERO to not only this game but to anything Playrix owned. It used to be a lot of fun & I even befriend some people. Now, if you don't spend $ you won't win or move on. Great game, lots to do so you'll never get bored. Only bad parts are how much construction materials you need to build a building or zoo enclosure. Not as advertised. I get annoyed that I feel the need to come back more often than my other games. Materials needed for certain products are irrelevant (ex. A fun little waste of time, but way too many complications. I like that there are no ads. Love this game! It's lots of fun. You don't have to pay money to play unless you want to. The other players are great and it's great team work. Have been playing for months, It is nice that you don't have to spend anything to accomplish some tasks, especially on the beginning, because you actually get town cash for accomplishments. I like that I don't have to spend money on playing this game like other 'farm games'. I also like the teamwork that is necessary in this game and the independent control of the teams. Great way to kill time. Great graphics and I like that there's new stuff to work on. I do wish materials were easier to get to build new buildings though. I love the game, I play daily and spend money regularly on it, I also like the mini games, regattas, etc. However one has to dedicate money now to be able to finish games & decorations prizes are ridiculous, help nothing to advance or grow the town. Lack of space, to get materials, so much TIME and MONEY. They don't add to the things that help grow.

Used to absolutely love the game, I was completely addicted, but if you don't spend real money the game takes time. I've been playing for 3 years. Haven't been playing for a little while and now have newest update. What a crock! I'm so disappointed, game keeps sticking, battle to visit friends because the whole screen blacks out for a while, and sometimes I activate a booster, it takes the jewels and shows it activated but it isn't! If this doesn't get fixed soon, I'll sadly be uninstalling

Dont bother trying this. Was a wonderful game! But... after 3 years of playing, lots of changes and it became one of those games that require you to use cash for almost everything. Zoo started changes too which sucked up lots of frustrations and $$. To make things worse, the zoo is totally at a standstill and forgotten. Used to have different interesting in-game but now it's only 4 boring ones that keep repeating.

The graphics are great and it's a fun game. The problem is, unless you are willing to pay money to buy "Township" cash you will be playing at an extremely slow rate of play. You can grow the crops you need but there is no way to get the building materials short of the random delivery by train. Waiting for those items means you cannot expand and develop your town. Unless you like rearranging your streets and houses while you wait, it becomes rather boring.

Add a few more cute guys in this game. Still love it and got a serious kick out of seeing Austin from your other game. Current ads for this game doesn't accurately portray game play. The ad shows a scene where you need to select from a list of items to solve various issues. Picking the wrong item results in comical failure. This game is better than that but misleading ads will turn some people off of the game. Demoting this to 4 stars due to the misleading ads.

NONE of the changes you have made in the last few years in no way, shape, or form improved the game. You've made it repetitive and boring. From removing fun mini games (rev n' ride, sheeple, etc) to removing the Elder position and the ability to restrict in the regatta. None of these changes were useful or helpful. They say if it isn't broken don't fix it. Township broke something that was already great. Yes, you'll "pass this along". It would be nice if they would actually listen or cared.

The majority of your games are difficult to win. On the redecorating game if your not doing well it takes extra turns from you. I had 7 turns left & it said I was done. It's frustrating to play games where the success rate is low. It would be nice to change up the games more frequently. Activities with short time frames make the activities stressful. However, It's fun to play with friends without playing the games or spending money.

Experiments used to be fun. Now it is too hard. An exercise in futility. I used to be able to ignore the mini games I hate. They tied the mini games into the Experiments so now I can't ignore them. They must be played. Too many tasks with too much animal feeding, and want too many barn upgrades while the trains bring back too few building materials to make possible to complete in a month. The final chest has too many stages to fully finish before the end. Won't buy gold ticket ever again!

I love this game. The graphics are very cute. I enjoy that I have to create and build a town. I find it very challeging filling orders for customers and filling the cargo holds of the plane. Buying the Dealer's help has saved me on several occasions. The only thing that I wish was different is the way trains are filled. Once you fill one you have to send it out. Then you have to wait to see what building material come back. It takes a lot of materials to build something. The materials sit in your barn taking space from other products. When you have enough of the products only then are the buildings completed. Other then that I give the game two thumbs up. Keep up the good work on the contests and updates.

It's fun and challenging but not off putting. I like the seasonal themes, keeps things fresh and doesn't bore the players with the same thing day in & day out. I like the rewards as you level up. Also if you belong to the right co-op you'll make friends that help each other. Had to drop my Star rating due to all of the technical issues with the game freezing or not even loading.

Use to enjoy the game very much, but lately there seems to be to much problems, like with the professors adventures. When ever there is items like the paint or any building materials to be collected, it seems that all of a sudden those items just isn't coming in the trains or anywhere else. And like now with this new adventure treasure hunt thing, there seem to be a problem with the clock count down. It seems to only counts down while you are in the game and doesn't when you leave the game.

The game used to be great when it was designed for casual play with friends. Now, it's just a mainstream style cash grab with tons of competition that is forced down your throat by way of forced in game pop ups, a newly incorporated "season pass" designed only for "pay to advance" players, and very little opportunity to just be a casual player and still make advances in the game.

I've been playing this game for over 5 years, daily. It keeps getting worse now. You're unable to win the mini games in Township. In the seasonal games, the options are so-o-o minimum. In the seasonal games, one third of the options have to do with other mini games that are ridiculous. Another 1/3 of the options are available over & over again, but only once per player. So very few options. Pls fix.

Ever since I started playing this game about a month or 2 ago I've become completely engrossed in it. I've changed my phone 2 or 3 different times and I made sure to always download this game immediately. It's an awesomely fun game to play and helps to pass the time. There's just a few changes and recommendations I would like to see made if possible. Firstly, I wish there were more ways to earn cash and for a slight increase in the cash we already make. Secondly, I wish it didn't take so long for things to be made, grown, laid, or to be recieved and delivered. Thirdly, I would like to recommend is it would be so great if you could make it possible to expand on the expansions just a little bit more to have more room for everything. Lastly, if you could change the prices on some of the materials and decorations because I feel as if everything is so high and expensive to afford. Other then these few minor suggested tweaks the game all in all is absolutely awesomely fun and completely addicting. I love all the graphics, animations and all the different things you're able to do in the game. So keep up the all of the amazingly great work developer's. You're doing a great job.

Can someone help me with my issue. I love this game, it's calming and relaxing. But I'm having issues playing it since it seems as if it was updated. Once I open it, I get taken straight to the regatta challenge, which I can't skip or play. After being walked through the tutorial, the game automatically closes out. I would love some assistance as I want to continue playing.

False advertising!!! I am at level 23 and I can confirm that this game is falsely advertised. But it's also very addicting. Also you need to spend real money to really make any progress. And the currency is expensive. It's even more expensive than purchasing Us dollar in my country, which I find absolutely ridiculous. Still playing, because I find it educative on Urban/rural town planning, but would uninstall soon.

I just hate paying for my playtime. But i do love the graphics and it is an easy game to get hooked on. I am getting more unhappy, in this case: cost of the 'room improvement' game high for very little return. Every 'room improvement' game is costly. Edit on the minigames- some are ok. Most are "expensive". Could you make the Rocketship Ride whirl around?

I really enjoy this game, and I would rate 5 stars but...:my first complaint is that it is geared more towards in-app purchases to advance more quickly, and in my opinion there needs to be higher rewards for tasks in order to complete buildings, etc. Should be able to buy build materials by coin or factory. Increase barn size by level, not with materials. Lastly- speed up production and harvest times... the wait is ridiculous. I play this game a couple hours per day... very frustrating.

This game would be great if you stop pointing everything out. We see where they are. Graphics are decent. Gameplay is slow at times. Events should not be forced by you to make us play. Feeding animals are interesting. Ernie should not be a friend built into the game he is very annoying. Change up theme music. Like the fact you can change buildings around.

Developers have greatly reduced the rewards given in the game and increased the super hard levels which has stagnated progression and impacted enjoyment. It's boring now. It used to be a really good game. They got greedy though and try and force you to buy extras, I'm about to move on as I'm over spending a lot of time for little progression.

It was fun for about a week before it got too difficult. I'm not a huge fan of microtransactions but i spent Google Play credits to see if i could make better progress. I didn't. I don't like how the game keeps adding new challenges to make it even more difficult. Also the rewards arent worth it to me. Most of the time you just get coins to build more buildings. Wait a day for that building to be built, start filling orders, wash rinse and repeat. It gets repetitive.

I loved this game until the zoo changed. In its origional form it was complicated but do-able. Now, it's nearly impossible to build & collect cards & fill orders. The amounts of requested items is ridiculous. No one wants to give up that much product to help. You took the fun out of it. As far as the rest of the game it's still pretty decent. I need regatta friends that will play and communicate. Look for us REGVQM Regatta Racers, by request.

No matter what I do, uninstalling it, force stopping it, when it comes to the mine task, I get "qualified", but when it comes to getting the prizes, it freezes up and won't let me get the prizes nor will it let me keep playing. I've even deleted other apps to open more space in my phone and still it won't let me do the mine task. I've spent a lot of my money on this and it's getting very frustrating that this continues to happen. When I report it, I get accused of spamming. Very disappointed.

Love this game but....I have been playing this game for over a yr. Totally addictive. But as you level up this game is starting to get impossible to finish animal closures and buildings. Not enough materials are delivered. Also growing and making new foods are taking longer and longer. I'm pretty sure after a certain level I'll probably stop b/c its starting to get boring. Honestly the only thing that keeps me coming back are the Regattas. I'm super competitive.

just started playing this game but I already love it it's a great game to pass the time definitely and it's finally the only game I found that doesn't involve watching ads every few minutes or levels , I highly recommend it 😁❤️😊

Super fun! Can not stop playing! Love it! It does get a little slower and "harder" around level 40 cuz things get more complicated to make and do so they want you to spend real money to speed things up, and if you don't, you just wait longer for things to happen and advance in the game. Made me start playing anther game but i still play this one at least twice a day.

Pretty good for a city tycoon/manager type game... Most of the mechanics are straight forward and simple enough. During the carnival games (August 2021), the rollercoaster minigame seemed a bit unfair, as the game wouldn't register inputs/swipes to move the track up or down sometimes. Besides that, not a bad city manager game. Kinda basic and boring. But pleasant.

I used to love this game. Through the years it has become obvious that the developers no longer care about players. Tasks are fake, for example the professor's tasks, after successfully completing all the tasks, I realized that the number of points given in each task were not going to give me enough to win the prize. Most buildings and zoo enclosures will cost you a lot of $ if you want to complete them. The ridiculous amount of items you need for each one is insane.

This game used to be really fun and variable, but has just been a pipeline to a matching game for a long time now. There's no more unique events - you merge or go on an adventure just to play.. the matching game. There's absolutely no motivation to produce anything or send off planes/trains/etc. Regattas can easily be completed by - you guessed it! Playing the matching game. It has become entirely uninteresting, you're better off downloading gardenscapes cause that's essentially all this is now.

UPDATE: I played this game to the point where it became frustrating to keep it up if I stayed in the co-op, the time frame of the items and the barn's capacity. I definitely still enjoy to play but, the game hasn't improved. I uninstalled for a while now, the game keeps freezing. Keeps you busy! I wish the tools had their own toolbox. Linking up with others in the game makes it more fun.

the zoo needs to have another short cut window, just like the transportation used in order to keep up with orders. also once you get to a certain amount of coined money, one should be able to purchase cash. This would allow for one to reach the levels they want without having to pay so much money through out the game. or have an option to out right purchase the entire game.

It is unfortunate to say, but Township has taken a bad turn. They've changed regatta rules that are just too much & even have players on different mini games. This is the 3rd week in a row that I have no option to complete mini game tasks in the race, putting my team at quite a disadvantage. No Halloween decor, though there is supposed to be..?? My husband plays as well & we are playing 2 completely different versions of Township. And mine is NO GOOD. Reaching out to creators is pointless.

Update. I decided to come back 3 years later and all my progress is gone. If anyone else decides to step away you might visit once in awhile to save your progress in case you want to pick back up. 2020: I've grown tired of the game because now it seems more like work than play. Takes forever to to level up as the game progresses & the barn is always too small to make things in advance. I used to be a buyer & you need inventory space.

Once you get up past level 35 the game gets addicting. But when the zoo changed, it got more difficult to fill orders. Also, to get products that townspeople were requesting, you had to open up the clouds to the islands. This takes away from adding land to your town. it takes two saws to add land and 4 to add Island. Would be nice to get more saws from the trains.

Anyone considering downloading this game, don't! Been playing for well over a year. As numerous comments already said, this game was originally quite fun to play! Now, developer Playrix has made mini games & events impossibly difficult! I used to be willing to spend real money to advance, but myself and several other players have stopped spending real money because of the difficulty level is excessive and unnecessary, and removes the fun and makes it frustrating- not worth it!

The premise of the game is very interesting. There are a lot of items with potential. However, the joy I would get out of the game is the long production times and any cooldown times (which are utterly arbitrary and only there as a money grab). It has become a hurry up and wait game. Any game you build where the player is stuck doing nothing of significance means they shut off the game and play something else. Furthermore, the scaling mechanic of land clearing and buildings makes no sense.

I like that playrix provides mini games within township, but sometimes they cause problems. Right now the need for seeds game is in progress. I had been playing & was in second place. Now when I try to use fuel, the screen goes blank & I have to close the game to return to township. It's not the first time issues have occurred in the mini games, & technical supports only help is to reinstall the game on all these issues. It's ridiculous. Fix the problems.

Originally only got this bc of an offer in another game for extra things if I met certain goals. It quit registering my progress towards those after a while & I missed out on a lot of rewards. It was still kinda fun, so I kept on. But lately, it acts like I haven't been on all day. Factories haven't produced the things that were in progress when I closed it, the plane hasn't left even though I sent it an hour+ ago but the time limit continues to tick down, etc. Very frustrating. Uninstalling.

Do NOT download! Been playing everyday for 6 years. Used to love it but it has turned into a money pit. It is impossible to complete events without spending real money. What's worse, events no longer require gameplay to complete, instead, you have to play the same 4 repetitive NOT FUN AT ALL mini games HUNDREDS of times just to maybe BARELY get through to the final prizes. This game has become a stressful money sucker. I'm deleting it now and it makes me very sad to see what it has become.

Not at all what was advertized. I downloaded the game after seeing ads where they fixed parts of a town by removing trees, putting out fires, etc. Instead I got a simple game about building a town. Its an okay game for what it is, though the wait times can be a bit long and its really hard to find item to increase your storage. But its not the game I was lead to believe from their ads.

It's fun if you like to build your own place and decorate, and also has different challenges available. I like it, but I had downloaded the game because of the ads, so I was a little disappointed when it was nothing like the ads. (Update) I'm kinda addicted at this point lol, It's the only game I still play (Update) It's annoying that we can't play if we don't update the game, especially since it takes up so much space every update. My phone has a lot of space, but it's still inconvenient.

Used to play all the time and had a great farm. I had to change devices a few times. I installed the game again and all of a sudden my farm has gone. Everything I thought be saved was gone! I can't remember what level I was at but I tried to get in touch with township programmers to get my farm back but no answer and no help!! So annoyed, the idea of starting again was just a not for me. Such a shame... And still no answer!!!!!

this game is very detailed & oriented. I liked the game at first but the only problem is . it's a ripped off! everything required real cash to upgrade or else you're stuck! it gets boring & people can't be putting all that $ in to play a game. the purchase is too expensive too. so far I put in $20 but that's it! definitely not recommended for kids or anyone on a budget. stick with hayday!

I've played this game every day since day one. Spent a little bit of money but allot cheaper than going to an Arcade. Every thing's done on My Time. You start with a Barn and a field and build a City! I'd do it again. The games been stuck on Download Updates for the last 2 days and counting! Not Happy. Don't want to start over at too high of a Level.

I love this game . The reason I'm giving 2 stars is for the horrible experience I'm having. Since the update of about 1 month ago, the game is acting crazy, every time I tried to play the regatta, it crashed, in order to play, I have to uninstall and install the game several times a day, I'm having a hard time playing. I wrote several times to the developers and nothing. I have plenty of space, so, that is not the issue. The game instead of being an entertainment is a nightmare.

Awesome, fun to play game. I'm addicted. Unlike most game apps, this one has no annoying ads. You can watch ads from the helicopter but only if you choose to. Always something to do, especially as your town grows. Update....the ad videos are much fewer and far between now, which is too bad. Also, please make building supplies a separate storage. Even with the tool exchange I find myself selling building supplies to make room in my barn but yet have about 6 enclosures in zoo I can't build because of lack of supplies lol. Catch 22 there. But I still play every day :)

It is a decent game but I agree with other reviews on the mini games. Edit. They really should reset the matching game each time they restart it. It gets to the point where you can't advance past a level unless you spend at least 60 cash on it and even then it hardly lets you beat a level. You pay for a golden ticket that means nothing because you can't get past levels to earn points. It seems like a big money grab at this point. It takes the fun out of playing the game when you can't advance.

Sometimes have connection issues, sometimes the game doesn't work properly and I have to uninstall and reinstall. Definitely not my phone or connection. Also, takes too long for stuff to build and some things cost too much. But I love the game!! Especially love the special events, but wish they lasted longer.

My progress was saved to the cloud and when I reinstalled the game, the progress was gone. It had my achievements on my google play account, but the progress on the game was gone. 1 year of progress was all gone. Other than that, the game is pretty fun. Farming, interaction with other players, collecting materials, building houses and etc.

I want to like this game. It doesn't start with enough space and the items take too long to make and grow. An hour for milk/eggs as soon as I start? 50 item slots to start and each item counts as individual? Most games like this let you build a foundation before the time consuming ones start. The mini games become impossible to pass unless paying or jumping through hoops for 1 (!) dollar. I'll see if it picks up but completely unimpressed with this currently.

Not sure what the game us supposed to be?? Can't seem to find a balance in keeping barn stocked and delivering orders (be it train, plane or town) without bogging down because of so many duplicate items being requested at the same time. very frustrating and yet I continue to try and make progress??? After weeks if 'playing' am considering giving up as it is getting monotonous.

I really like the building the farm aspect of the game. However, I am really sad that the mini games to earn extra stuff are the same and then you have to pay for the really cool upgrades. Wish you earn them in the mini games instead of buying and then still having to bbn play to earn them. Also hate that the mini games are the same ones over and over. I sometimes just ignore them because they rarely help me get new items.

Really enjoyable just a few things keep it from being a 5 star game. Wish the graphics had 4 sides to buildings. Think the emergency vehicles should have flashing lights sometimes. Think the green money should increase more instead of going out so fast. This is for the developers......my town needs a small Parade as most small towns have. it needs to include a majorette and a small band. it would be great if it would just randomly appear also.

I love the Halloween version, so detailed. I love that you get to help other players. It isn't hard to progress in the game. I havenow moved up to the higher levels and it isn't as much fun.when you get to the next level there are no more awards and nothing else to build or work for. The main interest is a in-game contest that you have to pay 4.99 to play and its a scam. I'm still playing because I'm on a team but it just isn't fun.

Hi! This game will always be a 5 star for me. :) but I'm having some issues since last night. My game keeps rebooting to the status when I logged in 7 hours ago. The game also reboots back to that state whenever I visit a friend's town. Please help me. I cant make any progress :(

This is a game that has subgames. You can engage on several different levels, and you are free to choose how you engage. What I enjoy the most is that you can engage on those levels WITHOUT necessarily paying into the game. Yes, you'll do better at challenges if you do pay in. But it's not necessarily a requirement to enjoy them on some level. Plus, you can acquire the "dollars" by playing the game and on some of the advertising (if you choose to view it).

Not bad. Didn't end up quitting because the free ran out. Ended up quitting because after a while you're just juggling what you don't have and I don't find that fun. Also, the straw that broke the camel's back was the snowboard event. I did really well in the last two events, this one looked fun. However, in this game only, swiping and tapping(lane change and jump) do the opposite of what you expect at critical times. Then the minigame repeatedly wants more hard won game cash to keep riding.

The game is awesome. Most of my family plays it, and loves it. The only reason that I didn't give it 5 stars is because I am unable to purchase the golden ticjet during special events. I have tried just about everything including deleting the game, changing my login information, restarting the game, updating it, and even tried contacting the games help center. Still no luck. If you can help me buy the golden ticket, then I will gladly change my rating to a 5 star.

Fun game! There was an update on 9/26/2020 and the game STILL freezes and then closes after i get the daily reward. Please fix this issue, haven't been able to play for a while now. I'm just about done with this. Also, how about a "storage shed" to hold the tools, all the bars made from the ingots etc. Any and all NON-FACTORY items or items that are farmed. Just a thought to help out some of us that struggle with a constant full barn with items that NOBODY seems to want for any of my orders. :-P
It's not clear that the materials you need for buildings are obtained with the train. Also it's very easy to accidentally waste the ingame money.

I like the game as a whole, but the speed at which coins can be earned is on the slow side. It's an addictive game, and worth playing! I just wish there was a prize for a consecutive year of play! I hit 365 days in a row last week and had hoped for some fanfare... Nothing. Kinda a bummer on that front :/ I would give it 4 stars, but I hate games that constantly ask for reviews even after you've given one. Remove the nagging, and I'll give it a 4.

Had to finally change my rating from five stars to two after a few years playing. Also had to uninstall permanently after 3 times of reinstall and still wouldn't work properly. Enjoyed the game... until it didn't work anymore. I noticed many of the recent reviews are not very favorable... maybe it's time to back up and punt. Sad about it, but moving on to a new game.

Overall I like the game and its a nice idle game to kill time. But the thing that is honestly just bogus is that just like all the other games this developer has made, like Homescapes, the mini games are super fun for a while but then it becomes a point where you have to spend money in order to get anywhere in the mini games as well as development of your town. It seems like they're just money hungry. It would be nice to be able to watch an ad to help in the mini games and development.

Actually addicting, and that's not a good thing. I enjoyed the game a lot, even as linear as some of the progression feels; I REALLY liked how the cooperative aspects worked. However, with my ADHD and other issues, the game's time-based elements slowly destroyed my scheduling, making me obsess over getting as many things done as efficiently as possible. I ultimately had to uninstall due to this. Good game, good in-game generation of Cash, NOT FOR PPL WITH ADDICTIVE PERSONALITIES.

This used to be a fun game a few years back before the regattas & explosive puzzles took over the game. Gone are the days of the "FUN" mini games like fishing or the bakery. E-puzzles are ridiculously difficult with levels of hard and super hard. There are easy ones but they are few and far in-between the troublesome levels. Forget about the support system for the game! They might as well not have it because it's useless. There is no help there. Township is nothing more than a money grab now!

The Big Screen Adventure game was a great idea in theory; however, it's not all that great in principle. It takes a long time to gain energy tokens to cut bushes, chopped down trees, uncover artifacts or treasure chests or whatever just to wait 3 days to gain a few energy tokens to repeat the process. This in-game is too much of a chore and too little of fun.

I've been playing for almost 4 years and Playrix has gone from a 5 star to a 2 star. While the graphics have gotten better their algorithm's make it harder for you to add new friends, help others, earn cash w/o spending a ridiculous amount of cash, fill orders , etc. The game gets worse each year. The mini games are boring. Playrix you should really design more than just 4 mini games and stop recycling them! I wish you'd go back a couple years!

I don't have a problem with these games themselves. I have a problem with how they are advertised. Township, Gardenscapes, Fishdom, etc all misrepresent themselves in ads in other games. I've played Fishdom, and nowhere in the game does a fish have to clear an obstacle course. I've played Township, and nowhere in the game does livestock have to cross a road without being hit by cars. There have been several complaints about this kind of false advertising and still it continues!

I came back to this game after about a year break. I'm so disappointed in the new zoo and tool exchange. The zoo was fun & the only improvement needed was a reduction of building materials for animal enclosures. It totally sucks now & I'll probably never complete it. The tool exchange is confusing & does nothing but extend the time for building community buildings. People wanted a separate place to store building materials. The old version was much better.

Island event said it would start in 1 hour several hours ago, has now disappeared. Tried contacting support, was just a bot with automated responses and did not help at all. Had bought season pass, regret it now. Also used to play this game, was at a high level, recently reinstalled and it did not load my previous progress. Had to start from beginning. Very disappointing. Game itself is good, but would not recommend buying a season pass for events as the events seem unstable.

Excellent game, i enjoy playing it a lot and have gotten addicted to it! I was playing the game as normal earlier and now everytime I go into it, it say it has to be updated. I click on the download button and it brings me into the playstore and says to open the game and that the last update was 14 hours. I'm really annoyed over this I was in the middle of a quest for the race as well that only had a couple of hours left on it and all the orders I was getting ready to send off!

this games works so hard to get you to buy town money with real money, & it still puts ads in it. the game is so slow moving, taking longer to do the same steps when you progress & adding hidden cost once you bought something. but the way the game is structured of having to process goods to make other goods makes it interesting enough to play once a day because of all the wait you have to do if you don't want to spend real money.

Had to take away stars, there are costly glitches in the game. I've worked hard to build my town but I'm seriously thinking about switching to a different game like Klondike. I've tried 3 times to upgrade my school of magic and every time I get the items and start the upgrade it won't complete and I have to start all over again. won't spend anymore cash on this app.

Fun game but is a total money grab. Golden Tickets should reactivate every time its available after initial purchase. Makes the game less enjoyable when you have to think about reaching for your wallet. I still play, I just don't buy anything anymore. 1.99, 4.99 adds up quickly - you end up spending more than if you'd just purchase the more pricey. Just remove quick pay option and play for basic leveling, regattas and not the other games

I really enjoy this game. I have it installed on another phone as well. The 2-star rating is because their in-game purchases are misleading. I wish I could post a picture to explain better. The "Golden Ticket" ad shows 6-7 items that states buy the golden ticket to get. Below those is a plus sign and items in a smaller box that states "Get now and enjoy until event ends:" and there are 3 items listed after the colon. I purchased this ticket only to find ALL items have to be EARNED and are temp.

Any particular reason you guys have decided to advertise a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT game than the one that is played in the actual game? There aren't even elements of the advertised game in the actual game, aside from characters. The actual game is match three puzzles, very simple. No where in there is repair/problem solving. It actually doesn't make any sense unless you're just trying to increase download numbers. Only thing I can think of.

Every time there is an update my game gets screwed up. Game crashes when I try to click on the regatta. Sometimes it lets me play, but then I lose progress if it kicks me out mid task. I lose progress on everything. Tasks, regular game activity, etc. Ive lost real money because I'm spending a lot of tcash to try to speed up tasks before crashes. UPDATE: NOW I CANNOT EVEN GET INTO THE GAME!!! YA NEED TO FIX THIS PROBLEM ASAP!!!! Changed my rating because the app keeps closing and I lose all progress. Twice I completed tasks for the regatta. Twice I lost both tasks and it ended up incomplete. I keep losing progress with the trains, and airplanes. It resets to where I started...and I even lose money and cash.
