returned because of the advertisements on other games made it look fun again. Glad I came back. Love the Halloween decorations thank you very much. New ads are very misleading about actual game play. It's called false advertising. Please stop them game is wonderful the way it is. I just wanted to add that you have out done your selves with the Christmas decorations. Thank you. Wanted to ask question about zoo building. It would be nice to use the construction tools to build enclosures as well.

This game is easy to play and level up. However, one of the updates ruined the best feature of the game, if you buy all the items in the store then exit and reenter the store restocks itself, now it doesn't. I'll re-rate when that's fixed. Edit: This game has fallen from grace. After years of playing, it's just a money grab for longtime players. The mini games are repetitive and boring.

This game was fun at first, but as things took longer and longer to grow or build, it moved very slowly, and I logged in less and less often and then uninstalled it. Also, the ads I am seeing do not reflect the nature of the game or the kind of gameplay. At no point does the game require you to make choices for solving problems like the ads suggest. So the ads are not accurately representing the kind of game this is.

Cool game. Only 4 stars because it takes way too long between levels to be able to build things once you get past level 50ish. Who wants to only be able to build a house every 5 damn levels?? There should be more opportunity than that. Send counterproductive to me. Maybe start the build on one level and earn completion points in the interim until you reach the desired level to complete it. Idk, just seems pointless with such huge gaps.

I love this game very much... The only thing I would have a problem with is that y'all try way too hard to make us spend our own money.. and why do we need parts to build our other buildings like nails bricks and paint? Not going to be spending my own money finishing them... And another thing some items take way too long to build over 12 hours for some buildings really. It is a good game though. Very addicting but needs some upgrades on the stuff I mentioned above

Like the game, hate the corralling to join coops, to unlock certain areas. The long time to grow and then the time to produce items. That is unless you use town cash, ever pushing to buy it, if you do not have patience. Also hate not beening able to cancel o order. Yes a nice game requiring lots of patience, if you do not what to cost you. Also can not rest the game back to a new game

it really is a great game , but they don't give you an opportunity to rearrange things very well without losing them! for example, when you first start building homes and factories and excetera excetera- I just had a tendency to put them wherever. I need to get in there and rearrange everything to where it's more functional oh, they need to make that easy! They also always want money! That's getting old

I had my rating at 5 stars, but I changed it because not only does the expansion slow right down once you get up to a certain level but I have been playing for 3 years. I've earned and spent a lot and I just found out that a lot of the things I bought with it are gone. For example and Ice castle that I would bring out around christmas along with a few other winter items are gone. Those were expensive and I am actually very upset about it. So my rating has gone down to 2 stars.

Been playing for years but now having issues for the last couple of months. I'll complete a task, like filling a train/ helicopter order and then leave the game, come back a few hours later and then having to complete the EXACT SAME tasks all over again. It's the same with the crops. I'll harvest leave the game come back and it's like I never did anything. Changed from 5 stars to 2.

So addictive...only thing I would change; things that require township cash are *really* expensive, requiring one to buy a lot at a time in order to finish buildings and grow population numbers. It's difficult to progress in the game without buying coins or cash; I understand it's a pay to play, but maybe give us more gain for what we're spending or more in the packages.

Addicting. Fun time waster. To move up fast you need to purchase, but can play free... Editing. I've played this game for 4 years DAILY. the events were fun, but now the mini games have become impossible and cost you in other aspects of the game when you don't win. The drive is all about spending money and it's more stressful that relaxing. Very disappointed 😥

Used to be totally addicted... It would be nice to message individual players. Also, it takes forever to get enough building materials to finish a building or animal enclosure at the zoo!! It also cost too much township cash that you have to buy with real money! (I feel as though profit is more important than players satisfaction & experience.) I just can't afford the game anymore. I've earned 11 animals at the zoo & can't afford to finish the enclosures. I used to love the game.... used to.😟

It's decent but kinda obviously a cash grab also. It's a good game to "check in on" every little while to collect stuff and complete tasks but everything you need to do to progress either takes a long time or is very expensive, and the rewards you get are always super minimal. Sort of like the smallest amount of incentive possible to still be playable, but never really enough. It kinda feels like the game is punishing you for playing it. TLDR: HayDay is objectively better in many ways.

Editing this review... Used to be 5 stars... Now, I can't even finish a building because not enough glass. Plus barn is always full because too many different items that are needed to fill orders, feed animals, ship on train/plane... I've spent close to $200 over a year but game doesn't progress, just like the 80s arcade game quarter eaters. How about rewarding those who spend cash with a level up instead of just making it so one has to spend more cash. Give incentives to those who are loyal.

This game use to be fun, but now it is getting a bit difficult considering the mini games... They are so difficult they hinder you on your progress on the main event. Also, building of the animal habitats you need so much material to build now you don't have space in your barn to collect them. And a suggestion to extend the water near the ships to make a water park... I play daily and it's getting more difficult to play... Also, I'm trying to play the mini game and the game itself keeps closing

Uninstalled. It started off great, but eventually you'll have to wait hours/days just to concoct an item or build something. The further along you get, the more ingredients, tools and time it takes to upgrade or build, which wouldn't be that bad if there were a fluctuation of times but with every level and new ingredient, it just makes you wait even longer. From 3 mins for corn to 3 hours for a tree! You also have to pay to use the "cash" you earned. Just wish everything didn't take so long.

Have been playing this game for many years. It is a building game, town, farm and transportation. There are co-ops you can join to get help with playing in the regatta. Those things are all great, but once you get into the higher levels, the building materials are useless, nothing to build anymore. The mini games have become repetitive, some of them have been eliminated, like the fishing, cooking and smoothie game. I'm not a big fan of the added challenges to get you to spend real money.

This game is awful now. The dude games repeat over and over and you can never win a good prize because you have to spend a lot of money. The games are also difficult. I liked the games that dealt with adventure, like trekking through the woods or snow to help people or find a treasure. Now it's the ridiculously hard rollercoaster, that weird chicken/pier thing, the ball drop, and a couple more over and over. No longer worth me spending my play money on.

I don't see why anyone still plays this. They used to have fun mini-games. e.g. plane flying, fast food assembly, lost temple exploration. These days, they have backslid into an endless mind numbing cycle of match-3, bridges, sliding coaster, and falling gumballs. None of those new "insta-fail" games are nearly as fun as the old ones where you upgrade and progress toward a goal. I wish this game would go back to what it was in the late 2010s. It was more fun back then. Has been un-fun too long.

Love the game! It is very addictive however it seems the train never bring the nails to upgrade the barn. And the barn seems to get bigger but the storage stays the same so you can never produce the amount of items needed for the train, plane, people and animals at the same time as you never have enough room to do it. It also seems that as you increase in levels it takes more supplies to make an item than it did on the lower levels. What is up with that??

This game is great so far. Ive been playing for about a week and its so addictive. I love the small details like watching the people go about the town and engage with one another. Update - I'm removing a star from my review. I hate the zoo feature. It's already difficult filling orders for the train, plane, and helicopter to now have to fill orders for the zoo. Im trying to avoid this part of the game, and thankfully it doesnt seem to have too much of an interference with moving my town along.

Used to be my FAVORITE game and even would spend money playing it. However, not any more. It takes SO LONG to build things and to have some crops grow. The rewards used to be worth the wait but they are no longer. The mini games are tired. The game has become so buy that regardless of what device I am using, it keeps freezing up. I'm going to try reinstalling one more time. If it still is buggy, then I'm letting my co-op know I'm out of here. Not worth the frustration!

Now the game won't even open. I just get a black screen. This is BS! Still getting kicked out of game when trying to access regatta. Fix the game or stop having regattas until you do. Can't get into regatta tasks. Throws me completely out of the game & I lose progress so I keep having to repeat things over & over. Problems started during upgrade. Very frustrating & unfair to my team. Been playing almost 2 yrs & ready to quit.

I have been playing this game for years, because I like world building games where I can build and decorate. Used to be fun, with great seasonal decorations and some fun side games. It has really gone off the rails in the past couple of years though. They haven't done any work on the ACTUAL main game of Township in a long time. They just keep doing "events" where they tie points and prizes to the same difficult, not-fun mini-games. OVER AND OVER AND OVER... Blatant money grab by the developers.

Did they sell out for profit? I started playing over 5 years ago. It was great fun in the beginning and a few years in, but now, the (Same) mini games are harder and harder to play and advance. And now every month gets Golden Ticket tasks. The free tasks don't even get any good rewards. I have bought the Golden Ticket more times than I can count but now it is harder to get to the end. Make it a bit simpler and you would get more people paying to advance, now I feel it's a waste of money.

The game Township is fun. I like the graphics of the buildings and creating the town and zoo. However it is getting very expensive 😬 to continue creating my town. I feel stuck in the game which is no fun and can't keep enough game cash to consistently play. Which is no fun. It appears I have reached my limit with the game . Further more the time constraints are ridiculously long and breaks up continuity of the game play.

The actual gameplay is quite fun. One of the best of these type of games. But the "Piggy Bank" that gets introduced soon as you've gotten the hang of things totally RUINS the game! I'm ok with grinding in free to play games and paying for some things as I may want. But the piggy bank system basically blocks your grind progress coins behind a mandatory pay wall you can't unlock without buying into the game! So it becomes impossible to progress without recurring buy-ins. I'd rather have ads!

This game keeps getting worse. I am now lowering rating to two stars. The mini games used to be fun, but now they're just too hard to be enjoyable. The new makeover mini game is no exception, and robs you of rewards you have earned. In specific, I have earned multiple mini milestones to be rewarded pink tickets, but the game doesn't actually give them to me. All of the upgrades/makeovers cost a stupid amount of these pink tickets, so it's very frustrating. I'm close to deleting the game.

Charming fun that can be very frustrating! Building materials are scarce, making it difficult to finish buildings, needed to raise the population, needed to grow the town, needed to buy more buildings that are difficult to finish. There's still some stuff to do: filling orders, mining, zoo, decorating, & fulfilling timed tasks. NPCs have their own quirks, like hot dog guy turning to look at you. The global community is friendly but competitive. I quit playing because I didn't want to $pend more.

Since the prize wheel was introduced in the mini games, it is impossible to earn a decent prize. I no longer get new profile pics or town decorations. All i get is building supplies. The Professors challenge is another impossible task. Even if you finish all the tasks (again impossible due to barn upgrades) you have to pay real money to open the safe! On top of everything, it requires to many building supplies to build that you are often stuck.

Graphics are good. Concept is good. But I do have to say it is a money grab . Worse than others for sure. On the mini game I mean how do they expect u to beat it with 10 moves? They don't, they want u to PAY for boosters etc. I have been stuck on the same level forever . It also takes too much time to create items . It's OK but I have better that I can play!!

I really enjoy the game. I would give 5 stars but I find it very annoying there are no ways to cancel or stop ships or factories if they are waiting in line but already ordered. You can't speed anything up without "town cash" and you can't earn enough to make much of a difference, unless you pay real money for it. But mostly it is fun and interactive.

Love the game! Too bad the buildings can't turn 360°, when searching in any of the construction hat items, wish there was a back to beginning button and most importantly, when in orders from the helicopter, wish I would be asked if I'm sure if I want to delete this order if I hit the trash button. I've accidentally hit the trash button twice and oops there goes that order! Other than that, lots of fun!

Pretty fun game, fairly easy to play, but still has some attributes that engage you. Decent amount of asset management required, and you can play this without having to make in game purchases, but like all games now in-game purchases make the game easy to advance, and give you a competitive edge. Con- no ability to cancel items, or rearrange them in the factories.

I want to give this game five stars. I don't even mind purchasing currency from time to time. The issue for me is that the mini games are sometimes too hard and it hinders progress in some of the larger events. Specifically, I loathe the sheep game. The concept is adorable but it's too fast. I basically ignore the sheep and the roller coaster mini games while they're up. Bummer.

Terribly misleading. You don't *have* to make purchases, but it's slow and hard to progress if not. Final straw came when I paid a small amount to finish a mini game. I'd gotten very far with the free attempt; once I dropped money, suddently the mini game yielded more "oops, you lost!" endings and poorer rewards. Uninstalling this game is not good enough. I've requested total deletion of personal data. Even this was difficult due to more misleading info within their "help and support" section.

Not what I expected. The ad that got me to download the app consisted of you solving problems in a town. For example choosing the right tools to fix a bridge or a plow in a barn. The actual app is nothing like that. However, it is fun to play. Not many ads to deal with so that's nice. The time to make certain items are a bit unbalanced but that's to be expected in an app like this.

I've never had any problems with this game until the latest update, and I've been playing for 3 years. Now anytime I try to access the regatta to select tasks, or to collect rewards at the end, the game freezes and crashes and I get booted out. This happened several times during the last regatta and caused me to have to repeat my task several times. I also lost township cash from chests because my progress wasn't saved before the game crashed. When I "reopened" the chests it was something else

I really enjoy this game and the graphic are great! It is highly addicting. My only complaint is some tasks take too much time and then instead of being exciting to come back to, it becomes monotonous. For example, they should ask you which goods you want in the train rather than randomly supplying you with things you don't need. I have 6 buildings waiting to be built, because I have receive the same tools everytime.

7/14/21...I haven't played this game in years. I started all over with a new town. It was initially just to get bonuses for a different game, honestly. I've kept playing because I really enjoy the game BUT the tasks were near impossible to complete for the grand prize without playing ALL day and/or spending lots of money. You can't use cheese and sugar as much as required for the grand prize with so few items requiring cheese and sugar. So, no grand prize for me after working so hard to get it.

This game is very fun, addictive, and user-friendly... to a point. After a while, the game becomes too intense with too many goals to meet and things to do. Boat races, painted block events, planes, trains, mining, collecting artifacts, and way too many factories and friends to keep up with. While I understand that games are intended to become more challenging over time, this ultimately is what made me stop wanting to play this game.

I usually have a lot of fun playing township. But the match-mini game during the renovation events is really a head ache. Some of the levels are so overwhelming that I don't even feel like opening the app again until the event gets over. A lot of regatta tasks and event tasks depend upon solving the levels and with such levels its unable to make progress in these as well. I would request team township to consider making some of the 'very hard' levels a little playable and enjoyable.

It's a pretty fun game. I go through waves of playing and not playing. I once left it for over a year and when I went back, everything was just as I'd left it, waiting for me. They've made some great improvements & while progress can be kinda slow if you don't spend money (and it's hella expensive if you DO buy the game's cash & coins) it's still decent. I do wish there was a way to cancel things in progress. I've bumped my screen & started things I didn't want but couldn't cancel. :(

Township is very fun to play in the beginning. However, once you get further into the game, it's just annoying. It was very hard for me to balance the work of filling orders, loading trains and plane crates, finishing construction, and many other tasks. The game has real potential, and the idea is great, but it only gets more annoying as you continue -- which is the same with your games Homescapes and Gardenscapes. Graphics are good, I'll give you that. I just wish the game was better.

Favorite game of this style. Amazing flexibility and design control. Awesome way to connect in co-ops with people all over the world. Awesome competitive game if you're looking for something to add to the creative side of it. Very interactive with constant ways to keep you interested, and using your town to the highest capacity. The updates are regular and always getting better. Could not recommend a more thorough game. Can be entirely free, but obvious money options are at your disposal if you choose to go that route. Happy gaming, from an enthusiast about this one.

It is not what the ad looks like. The game is a whole different concept than the ads show. The game is fun even though I sometimes have to pay real money to even go farther in the game. Also the game is filled with ads and when I accidentally click them it auto-installs the game and end up having 10+ games downloaded that I even intentionally got.

I like this game. It has mini games and regattas. I have a good team on here that is very understanding. But right now they keep repeating the same 4 mini games. It is boring. There are a few that they stopped doing. It used to be so much more fun. When you fix the mini games I will make this a 5 star review. Update... they added a couple of games and fixed one that wad really hard. They also brought one of the old games back. So not bad. I am adding one star back.

I used to enjoy this game. When the professor’s experiment was 3 to 4 times a year and the tasks included things like build a bunch of sweaters or harvest a bunch of silk there was variety and it was possible to steadily move through the levels. Since it switched to one starting right after the other it is not interesting and the all-minigames-all-the-time aspect takes away the fun. The explosive game has gotten so hard you can’t win and the sheep game hasn’t been winnable since it started. What happened to the burger building game? Other aspects have changed also. This last time there was not even a race of champions between regattas. Once all the buildings are built there is not a lot to keep someone in the game except variety. Doing the same stuff over and over again sucks.

I've been playing about 5 yrs. I enjoy the game, but Playrix is grabbing. It costs too much real $ to get anywhere in the game. It used to cost less, & the levels weren't so hard. I may quit soon. Not only does it cost too much, but Playrix took away any breaks we would have between regatta seasons. Every1 is getting burned out. Things need to change back. On top of all that, support is no help. Even the replies to reviews here are all the same. They seem computer generated or scripted...

Hate the puzzle mini game I've been playing for a little while, and like most everything in the game except the puzzle/match game. It's very difficult to get through, not enough moves, and too overwhelming at times, and they last too long. I'd like to see maybe a mini bubble shooter game or something similar. I enjoy the roller coaster, arcade style, sheep run, and the gum ball mini games. I even enjoy the little mini one you can do where you get your orders for the deliveries by helicopter.

This was a 5* game for me too, but these mini games are made harder every time they start a new one. We do pay cash to play and for that I don't want that much of a challenge. I used to be able to finish the 30 day challenges in about 27-28 days. Now I'm lucky to finish 2/3 of it, and I'm talking the last 3. Not likely to play those anymore, much less play Township.

I began playing several years ago and then quit playing. I picked it up again several months ago and have been playing. The game itself is very good but I am now trying to install on my laptop device .because my earned township dollars kept disappearing from on my desktop. I notified the company numerous times and now they no longer even send :a pretend I'm interested email to address the issue. last night I had 22 dollars showing, only to look up and see I had only two. This is so frustrating because it takes so long to earn the dollars to begin with. I also kept getting a video that will reward with money of dollars which would not close and thus earned no rewards. When I notified then of this, they simply stopped enabling the opportunity to view the videos at all. They seem very uninterested in fixing any problem.

Great graphics and gameplay, but it sizzles off after a while. The real-time wait to make things increases until eventually you can only do a few things when you log in each time. I'm a binge player. I like to do a bunch of stuff at my leisure, not collect a few things and log back in a few hours later for the next step, just to log back in a few hours later for the next step, repeat, repeat. Basically I've been playing for a few weeks and it's lost excitement. There's no challenge. Just waiting.

It is super fun and easy to play even for kids 4 and up! Edit: 1 year later 10/18/20------------------------------------------------------------------------Township definitely down graded. It was really fun before, but then I decided to download it again but it would not load. I have tried for one week now and it still does not work. I would really like if you would fix the glitching that happens constantly please.

l've had it with their ads with many sections. you have to keep pressing "Next" after long waits, and the "Next" and "Finish" buttons each take a long time to respond- all for one ad! The ads are in portrait mode while the game is in landscape mode. There's often no pictures or fun things to do while you wait- just a bunch of boring text to read. Its too annoying. I'm leaving this game because of the kind of ads they choose. Fun game, but not worth the stress its causing me.

I really like the game but it could definitely use some tweaking to keep players from getting discouraged. For instance, creators should add factories to create the building supplies. Also, I wish friends could donate just 1 item needed rather than the entire batch. The current policy makes it harder to be neighborly. The slow progress of filling orders due causes me to lose interest at times.

Really enjoy this game! I have a stressful job and it helps reduce my stress level. One thing I'd like is to be able to get 2 hammers, buckets of paint, etc in the mini games. Also in sheeplechase and others when you start winning a lot of runs in a row it switches and speeds up so you can't win for a while. It also does that when you win lots of hearts as a prize. This makes the mini games frustrating.

I love this game, it's a lot of fun being the mayor of my own town. Easy to figure out. I like that you can check in through out the day to progress the game, and don't have to invest long chunks of your time. I recommend this game. 10/2019 Playing almost 3 years, still like the game, but the developers changed the way the zoo is played and can no longer make alot of coins selling goods through the shops. So now it takes a very long time to make coins to buy anything. Just way more difficult.

I loved this game for several years & gladly paid for it. It was that good. I've invested so much time, energy and money into my town. I'm quite proud of it. The game didn't require hand eye coordination, there were a few puzzles but it was mainly strategy and teamwork. The original introduction of the experiments was wonderfully done and so much fun. It brought a new element into an existing game without changing the game's design. Then they started focusing on mini games. Now to get good decor you have to grind through these horrible non-township related mini games. When they first added mini games to the experiments, it was minor and you didn't have to do them to complete the experiments. But now, it's not only flipped, they've made the difficulty level so high that only those who cheat or don't mind spending hours doing the same thing over and over again will get anywhere. In order to get 1/3 of points needed to just get through 1 of the 25 stages, I have to play the friggin' mini game 200 times (400 boosts, 2 boosts each game, is 200 games, it's crazy). I am unable to play hand-eye coordination games so I don't do it and I don't enjoy them. Support has been useless, they just say "we'll pass it along" but nothing ever changes. Are they getting THAT much more money from these changes or something? I know not from me, I only make one small purchase a month now. It's killed the joy that this game brought to so many of us. I've continued to pay for the gold pass in hopes that this will get better, but so far, it just hasn't. I'm starting to look for another game that is what Township used to be. I don't want to play knock off frogger or a gum machine or road spans game. I installed Township - I'd like to play that game again.

Been mayor of Township for over 4 yrs. Really enjoyed the game when I first started but more recently I have become increasingly disappointed and dissatisfied with the program. The mini games have become a huge distraction and the levels are sometimes impossible to conquer. I also appreciate the Township cash that is provided when reviewing new games when filling Township orders but other than that, the distractions are beginning to make me think if I should now consider leaving the game.

Use to be fun, but getting worse. This time the gem game, i got to play like 4 levels. Then a super, super, super hard level came on and i was stuck there the entire game. I didn't even get to sweep the floor. I always paid for the upgrades but... I quit paying for "the experiments" after the last one they were talking about score a phenomenal amount of points and beat like 30 levels in a row without dying. Just way too rediculous. Scared me and my checkbook away.

Boring for those that have all the zoo & extensions. Needs store house for tools. The mini games are just too get us to spend cash now, not fair that they're included in the main task either. Your forced to do them or lose out on points. The pirate game is a good example Used to be a good game,now it's just frustrating. I've played since the game was brought out 7 years ago, it used to be fun, not anymore. I like many others will be looking for a new game to play soon if things don't change.

I have been playing Township for over 2 years, and have found it fun and addicting. But lately I have noticed that the mini games are becoming more challenging it being nearly impossible unless you spend alot of money. But that's not the worst, if you watch the advertisements it locks up your game and you don't get the rewards for watching. Solution don't watch the advertisements. (Wonder what the advertiser think about that).

Fun to play, however the long waiting times and many undeveloped buildings due to the lack of materials makes it frustrating to the point of turning it off and not wanting to play at all. I'm constantly trying to find a way to make room in the barn to continue. All factories and quests take too much time to do. some of the timed events are impossible when it takes longer to make items then the event allows. I've quickly lost interest in playing due to these issues. GL with your game. I'm done.

Game is very fun when it wants to be. Every rotating mini game is really fun except the "puzzle" minigames. It basically becomes impossible unless you spend cash to continue, and never gets easier. Once you reach "super hard" that mini game is forever that difficult, even when a new season or event starts. If this game wasn't terrible "puzzle" games 90% of the time, it would be really fun. But I went from someone who buys the ticket, to basically done playing in about three months. It's a shame.

The game has been very fun and addicting. But recently, there has been a glitch. When I play mini games and win, it just freezes. I have to quit and open the app afresh and the progress of that game is not recorded, despite the fact that I won it. Sometimes after re-opening the appand I play the game again, when I win it freezes again. Please do something about it because it's starting to get annoying especially when the level is a hard one and I have spent a lot of time trying to cross it

I have played this game for 4 Years! I rated it 5 stars the first 2 years and then 2 stars after a totally messed up update. Those problems have been corrected. I now rate it 4 stars! It has a lot of in game items that cost money, but with no commercials within app, that is expected! I am a little disappointed that it appears they may be eliminated the championship corporate race. It is the most popular mini game on my team.

Very addictive, but lots of fun. Great for getting the brain thinking. Nice to be able to help others also. Still playing occasionally, but not as enjoyable as a few years ago. Starting to become Impossible to finish building zoo enclosures other buildings. The costs or equipment required is so out of reach for the ones that don't spend actual money.....Losing interest very quickly.

Helicopter order screen was glitching. Not all orders could be seen on the screen. I uninstalled and reinstalled, hoping that would fix it. My entire progress was lost. 7-8 years of play, gone. When I attempted to contact support, only automated responses were given and no attempt to restore my progress has been done. One response accused me of attempted hacking!! Very disappointed. I spent a lot of time and money on this game.

Started out like a nice little game. Seemed cute - mindless way to pass spare time. Except after 10 or 15 minutes it flipped back to the train conductor tutorial, which I had already done, and I can't do anything. Tried to close the game out completely and that didn't fix it. Restarted my phone even and the gameplay jumped right back to the tutorial and froze again. This is really disappointing.

Township is a fun and enjoyable game. Cost for ingame item purchases is far too expensive. So called "free game" is extremely slow and boring to play for free. Should be easier to play for free, reduce time it takes to acquire needed items to complete tasks and expand. Make purchasing currencies affordable. I have personally made several purchases and always feel taken advantage of.

After a previous update my tablet no longer plays the game without crashing (despite being within requirements). Despite from the need to play on the small screen of my phone, the game play is engaging, and my co-op is super helpful. However, some of the mini-games are obvious cash grabs. Just wish I could work on a bigger screen and organize my town more easily.

This game used to be so fun. It crashes any time I try to collect regatta rewards. All these monthly experiments games make it impossible to win now that they keep track of your previous game levels. Just disappointing. I miss the fun mini games, like the restaurant. Too many updates and things going on at once so it constantly crashes. I've played for over 4 years. Endless cycle.

In the past 6 months the game is getting repetitive. The mini games are the same. I remember when this game had alot of unique features and cool mini games. Now it's about getting you to pay more without dloper creativity. Its next to impossible to get the necessary building supplies you need to build your town without paying for the products. I miss the airplane mini game.

This game is fun, but beginning to become mundane. The mini games are starting to be too difficult! The matching games are nearly impossible to beat without using game money. I'm also tired of the same four over and over (rev and ride, gumball machine, the bridge one, and matching). I'm also bummed they took away the fall colors for the trees this past fall. It was a nice touch.

This app is great, you can join clans, send off ships, trains, and planes. But you have to work up to certain levels to unlock those things, which gives you motive to continue working on the game. The only reason I am giving it a 4 star is because sometimes it glitches and I can't get in, or it glitches when I am in the middle of doing a minigame. Also when I try to move the helicopter pad, it increases in size and takes up my whole screen, so I can't see where I am moving it to

Really enjoy playing this game as much as my other games.One of the only things that's badis the waiting for crops to be grown, products to be made, and factories and homes to finish building. I understand that the developers are trying to be realistic, but sometimes fun and just playing the game in general should be prioritized over that. Also another thing that is a bit annoying, is that I wish there were more ways to obtain items to construct buildings. Ex: includes glass, brick, nails, etc.

I'm in agreement with Blair! I love this game! Been playing for 3 years! But all I get now is glitches, crashes and wipeouts of what I could get accomplished. I can't play in the regattas at all anymore. Also, bought the golden ticket but can't complete the tasks because of the crashes! Very frustrating! Been going on for over a week now! Please FIX ASAP!

I really like the game. But even if for some it's a simple game, it's not so for me. I have some memory disorders, and it takes time to remember and like all the games I played it's mostly trial and error before I can find my way around. Where other games I could delete after learning, Google does not allow to erase the game data so can start anew. In a few years it won't really matter when alzeimer kicks in.

The game started out really fun! The latest match mini game has gotten ridiculously hard....to the point that it's no fun anymore. I'm really good at match games and they've made them pretty much impossible to beat without using tons of town cash to buy specials like the sweep and drop moves. It's discouraging to be stuck on the same board since the mini game started. The mini games used to be fun and a way to earn extra town items. It's a money grab now. Beware...

I would have given it 5 stars if it weren't for one little bug. You work really hard to build up your supplies only to have them disappear in the barn! I've sent feedback twice and heard nothing. You will also notice that progression is fast, but production is REALLY slow. Takes forever to earn dollars, and the game pushes you hard to progress. Also beware that if you load some cargo in the planes and don't fill it in time, you lose what you loaded. Otherwise the game is great.

Uninstalled it after many years of playing, just would not save my progess. I did not like the mini games. Same ones, hard to advance. Both boats and factories take too long. Really everything takes too long to progress. It was fun to a point but you would expect improvements to keep it fun. Interesting, and challenging but that never happened.

Great game so far. Only complaint is it takes way too many tools to finish buildings and zoo enclosures. It takes too long to finish these items. The train does not bring enough of these items in my opinion. Also maybe letting the market man (whatever he is) fetch these items would be something to include in the game. I spend a little money trying to move ahead but I can't do it much more. Just can't afford it. Other than that I play every day.

The perks aren't as good as before on this Halloween event and the mini games are getting too difficult, where you have to spend money if you want to get ahead. Do better, or many players will leave. Several ppl in my co op are already getting frustrated with the level of tasks. It's supposed to be fun, not a 2nd job. Update: I stopped playing. It was getting repetitive and boring. A shame since it had great potential.

I love this game so much. But... It got slow once I hit level 21 getting coins is super easy but takes a lot of time. It's hard to find building supplies and things to expand the land with. Shovels.. etc. Wish it was a lot faster and easier. I love the co-op of the game. Definitely makes the game with playing. Never can get tired of it for sure but it's not a daily player. It gets boring if you pay it continuously because of how hard it is to find materials. You just patiently wait unless you want to spend money on it. Not my forte.. but overall a great game. I hope they change it soon.

Once, this was one of my favorite games, but it has shifted over time to a focus on the same 4 or 5 minigames year round, and the escalating difficulty of these games seems to be there to drive people to spend in-game or real life currency on clearing them by getting retries, extra turns, or special items. It really feels like the creativity of the team behind the game is flagging, and for players like myself who have no intention of spending real cash, some of these minigames provoke enough annoyance that I don't even bother playing anymore when they're active. The actual running and building of the town is still the best part of the experience here, but the events are only fun if you enjoy the minigames they introduce. I, for one, do not enjoy most of them.

I hate the zoo. I wish we could totally opt out of it, it feels like a clunky add on the enclosures suck up materials and the vistors want too much. I never help anyone with zoo requests. I hate that I have to be in a club for the regattas. Most aren't friendly or helpful. Besides that I have never had an issue with lag or freezing. It runs phenomenal. You don't have to pay a cent to play or advance, I love that so I always DO spend for the experiments and bucks. The graphics are INCREDIBLE.

A good game for a 'pay to play', interesting complexity but gets slow to play once you get past level 20 unless you spend real world money. Did feel a little cheated with the introduction of the piggy bank. Good variety with the mini games. I refuse to 'pay to play' so I don't know how much better the game could be but the sales seem to be reasonably priced. You can play without paying but some of the build times are long.

I'm level 117 and I've been playing this game for 3 years. It's starting to get a bit boring and repetitive. Except for the new fabulous game Steeplechase, you keep giving us the same mini games. And you've linked them to the main task game. But even worse than that, now they're linked to the Regatta. You can't finish in the top three unless you do all mini game tasks at 150 points. Game isn't pay to play and requires teamwork. building your town adds to the play, but the whole layout is awesome. addictive, but allows you to get to the point of putting your phone down and nit missing out. I am level 98, been playing for 6 years, and I look forward to coming home from work and playing my game, as others are saying I have spent a lot of money playing this game including buying the gold pass this time for the professors experiment, right after that the update it booted me out and I can not get back in, been trying for a week. Great game! I would like more 'match two' games, levels and prizes to create more 'rooms'. I would like to reduce the time it takes to grow plants, create items, etc. I leave the game and come back later because it takes 3, 4, 5, even 14 or 15 hours to get anything done! That's too long to wait.

If you're here because of an ad with bunch of choices like use hammer or fire on a broken bridge, nope -- it's not like that at all.. BUT!! I actually really like this game! It's a farm/production simulation and it's one of the best one I tried. I honestly didn't expect to ever play a farm simulation game again, but this one got me hooked. The quests, requests and events are challenging; you actually need to balance time, inventory management, and strategy. The social aspect is a nice touch too!

It's my favorite game. Great graphics, fun challenges, leveling up is fast...update 2/18/22, used to love this game but its impossible to play now, the glitches are constant, I'm lucky if I can actually open the game 2 or 3 times in a week, I've lost money and am now finally fed up enough to uninstall it. I'll miss the game but won't miss the BS or losing actual money

This is an excelent family game. It would be better if they put the building that turned your bricks into gold coins back in the game. I used to love this game. I finished the Cabin challenge. But there was a glitch in the game. We all experienced it. Anyway, I lost the cabin and the game started over. The owners apparently are more into greed then having an awesome game.

I like this game I do play often, however I feel it takes too long to build and expand on the town and zoo. I used to sit and play for hours but it's beginning to feel like a pick and choose game rather than for leisure and fun. The regattas are nice, the factories take a while to make some materials

Great graphics, colors, attention to details and was fun at first but costs too much real money, and items take waaaay too long to finish, such as buildings, properties, factory articles, and ships. We should be paid at least 1 green dollar for mortgages on all the buildings, houses, and businesses we have built that sit around doing nothing. The barn is a nightmare! So sick of up grading! Maybe we could have a roadside farm stand and all those people wandering around town could buy from us, at market price. The only reason I am still playing is because of the Halloween Haunted House and the mine. Without those, I would be bored waiting for everything else. Thank you for a beautiful game, with just a few flaws, in my opinion.

Game Devs constantly offering new mini games requiring a lot of time, almost impossible tasks to complete and requiring $$ to purchase helps to reach goals. Not nearly as much fun as original game when I started to play many years ago. I feel it's all about getting us to spend money.... Not have fun. The regatta is no longer any fun at all. High point tasks are very hard to get and a lot of competition. If I was looking for a game now I would choose another.

it's only great at the beginning or if you are willing to spend serious real money on it. I wouldn't have a problem with spending the same amount as for a regular video game, but it wouldn't even come close to unlocking all the content, sadly. I had fun when I started, now all i do i wait for hours for the crops to finish. There is no more enjoyment in it at all. This game was fun in the beginning. However, be prepared for it to turn into a "pay to play" money pit! Almost every "bonus" costs T Cash, which you can either win (rarely) or purchase. I'm very disappointed as I really enjoyed playing this game. I have contacted in game support twice regarding my issues/concerns, but didn't hear back.

I watched lots of advertisements pop up in other games. Finally bit on one and it is really a different game than the kind I interpreted from the ads. This is a colossal time waster. If that's what you're looking for this is perfect. However, it is repetitive and I found it stressful and boring. Things take too long to complete and stuff "costs" too much to acquire in the game. There are some time limits on the games within the games and without networking with other players they are impossible. It is not as advertised as a game where you fix up stuff. I got to level 37 and none of that was available.

I like the game in general. Seems like the higher level you get the more difficult they make it to keep moving forward. You need more and more material to build things which takes forever to collect. Then they require you to get tools which you have to trade the same material for to get. Again a ridiculous quantity that takes avery long time to get. I refuse to spend real money on a "free" game. In addition this latest update has caused the game to be slow and glitchy.

Very addicting! But disappointed in how long it takes to complete buildings I purchase, or the fact that it literally takes hours for recipes to be ready, for some crops to grow, and there is not near enough storage because of all building materials that pile up in there. There should be a separate storage for that. Materials don't come fast enough. And in the zoo... ive got 6 attractions that i havent completed building and theyve been this way for months, but tons of animals, with no home. Grr

Addicting game especially for time management OCDers. Updates seem to take an unusually long time which can hinder players from getting ahead in competitions. The barn fills up quickly a lot which is frustrating considering the number of news items introduced at each level. But overall fun game and like the ability to interact with others in the Co-op.

This is a game that I enjoy, but there's a few things that are a little outrageous. The game starts off simple, but when you start progressing, it takes so many materials to progress the game. To upgrade the barn, you either need to spend a ton of cash or just wait until you get the materials. By the time I can upgrade the barn, half of what's taking up my inventory is just the materials it takes to upgrade it and the supplies for the community buildings take up a ton of space too. Another thing is that it takes a stupid amount of time for some things to grow/produce. It shouldn't take 15 hours for silk to grow. If you have that as something for the plane or something that needs silk to produce, you have no time at all to produce that item unless you pay to create it. Some things take a ton of materials that take a ton of time to make and it's just unreasonable for it to take so much time for any of it. The last big complaint that I have is that sometimes Township will just forget something that I do. If I completed a task in the regatta, it'll forget that I finished it and send me back to have to finish it. To point out a few things that make the game fun, I enjoy the competitions, it's a fun way to want to play the game and earn rewards for it, but they're increasingly hard and it takes a lot to keep playing the games if you fail, it goes zero to one hundred really fast. I like the idea of having a cooperative team to work with during regattas and earning coins through deliveries, it's just that you don't even have to use that many coins, it's really just the materials and it takes so long to get all of that.

Since updating my review a few days back regarding the paint cans being severely scarce, they have improved a bit. I've gotten to 64/70 as to the 42/70 I was stuck at for days. I'm still not seeing them quite as much as before. I'm literally having to stay in the game constantly, bringing back planes, trains and refreshing my store early, going in the mines, paying to play the lucky house. I will be 10 points short if I don't get the last 6 cans of paint, and I didn't miss 1 day of the event...

This game is very laid back, easy to learn. Overall I love the graphics and animal sounds when to tend to them. It deserves 5 stars. :-)

I really, really love this game. But on the negative side I don't like how the higher you get in levels the more expensive the new items cost. Some things take way too many hours to complete, the expansions cost way too much, the trains don't usually bring the goods you actually need, and I dont like how long it takes the dealer to rest when you have spent your tcash to use him. Overall the game is addicting and fun. I just have those small complaints.

This game is really addictive and I love it. it challenges you to really think through things as you are seeing up your town. Love the game. There are definitely improvements needed. I also agree with other reviewers that it takes too long to get building materials, I have several uncompleted buildings due to this.

Fun game, but takes too long to earn dollars and coins needed to progress. I find it very frustrating. The barn doesn't hold enough, and waiting for building materials makes building aggravating. I love the game but there are a few things which I rate it as okay. Some of the wait time is ridiculous even with upgrades. The clovers you get when filling other carts. Starts off fun but once you get into the mid 20 levels the factories and other buildings cost way more than what you make. Other than that it's a fun game, way better than Farmville. *Update* After 4 years of playing it gets better as you go. I play daily.

It's fun but there are too many extras by playing special games within this game.Like to try to meet all the regular challenges myself. If I realize I can't I will ask for help. Cute game can come to it when ever and pick up. Update 2021 March: The front photo of the game is miss leading. I used to enjoy playing this game until they continued to give you the same mini games over and over again with absolutely no change. So I'm still living there game but I do have a couple of suggestions. 1) When searching for items in the market, can you put things in alphabetical order instead of by amount owned? I've played this game for over 4 years and really loved it but with updates over the last 6 months this game is no longer worth playing. Not as good as it once was. I have been playing Township for 4 years. I have enjoyed it a great deal. Takes waaaay too long to build anything.....train takes forever, takes too long to get items from the factory especially the wool items. The plane asks for items hard to get and grow. I love playing but I find that it takes too long to get materials for expansions and opening buildings. Absolutely love this game. I play it every day. It reminds me of Sim City!
