I get that nothing is free, but every few levels are so hard that it costs too much to play. We keep losing people in our co-op because of the greed. I lowered my stars from 5 to 1. If they go back to the way it was a few months ago, maybe I'll change it.

It's alright. The regatta can be annoying, you need to remember to click on the finished task or else it wont count toward your co OP total. Not a huge deal. However I'm annoyed I started a task that allowed for 5 days to complete but not even 24 hours into the task it says I failed? This issue paired with the annoyance of completing tasks RIGHT before the end of a regatta and forgetting to click on them to claim them, meaning I didnt officially 'take part' in the regatta and received no rewards, is turning me off of the game as it's now more frustrating trying to take part.

Like many others, I have been really disappointed with the game. I have been playing for 4 years now and I really liked the game. But recently tbe events and mini games are getting impossible to complete witbout spending a LOT of money. The game used to be fair to everyone to at least complete events without spending money if you played enough. But now, if you don't spend money you would have to play every waking hours to get a chance to complete one event. I will not play anymore...

I enjoyed this game a lot, spent many hours on it. I liked that there's different games within the game itself to keep me busy and interested. The one thing that bothered me was how difficult the match-3 levels can be. I found that the one booster to help the most on the harder levels was the double helicopter booster. Now that they've taken that out of the app I see no reason to continue playing.

After playing for 8+ years I'm fed up. I hate the side games. You can't get anywhere unless you spend real money. Takes forever to collect supplies for finishing buildings. And as of tonight I can no longer play on my cell phone. Keeps telling me to update when there are no updates. It took me to earlier version and I lost over 8 years of progress. Yes, it's attached to FB but the phone version won't let me do anything. At least it's still on my tablet. Thanks for nothing.

Used to be pretty good, but they've been stripping out features and games for a while and now it's just a cash grab. They've purged a lot of the variety to the minigames to only rotate in the ones that are the most apt to get cash spend to complete (removing interesting ones that emulate a cooking game, a fruit chop game, a fishing game, and a slingshot game, for example), so now you only see the same few games (a match game that's rigged, a platform drop game, a platform laying game) over and over. They stopped putting effort into seasonal events, instead focusing on re-naming an old "professors experiments" event repeatedly to give the illusion of variety. They haven't added new content in forever, once you get to about level 90 or so, you're pretty much out of things to build or expand to. This game feels like it's at the end of its development cycle and now they're just trying to squeeze the last few doucets they can get out of it.

There's a few things that don't make sense. The ratio to which you get building supplies is extremely skewed. can take weeks to get paint to upgrade the barn. Paint is a rare reward which is a main supply needed to upgrade the barns storage capacity. Also why is my barn the main storage? should have a warehouse for building supplies and ingots. I appreciate the game has mini games as advertised, unlike the gardenscape app. You have to open the playground area w/ event calendar to play them.

Everytime I install it, I have to forcefully follow the tutorial for so many levels. There is no option to skip the tutorial. Even for adding Facebook account, you cannot do that immediately after installing the game. You need to play few levels before you can add fb account. After that the game syncs and you can start from your actual game level. This is super irritating.

Well to start off this game is awesome.I love how there are many activities within the game and dollars are easily earned.There is never really a time where you have to pay real cash. If you spend cash its because you wanted to. The only down side to the game is the waiting period.Everything you do has a waiting period.Long waiting period. An hour is ok but 3 hours or more is to long for a game. Sometimes it means you run out of things to do and cant play the game until the waiting period is over

initially i would've given 5 stars but after i realized that I was spending 1k+ in game coins to build a building that took 5+ hours to build only to realize i still couldn't use it because I needed parts from a train that never brings you what you need (slabs). You need buildings to build population and with the train not bringing supplies your stuck unless you spend real money. And every train trip got longer and longer. Other than that it's pretty cool. But I'm 4 days in still no supplies.

The game used to be wonderful but the developers seem only interested in making money. It's become incredibly boring with match 3 "adventures" or merge games with "rewards" so large that there's not enough room for them all. Some of the match 3 levels are so difficult you can't complete them without spending money to buy enough "township cash". And the "tips" you give are worthless. I've been playing for almost 5 years and missed only 1 day but I'm ready to quit because it's become so repetitive

A few things wrong. The blatant money grab. The cost of buying dollars is ridiculous. If doing the match 3 part of the game, requiring dollars to continue is about the dumbest thing. We have gold that could be used. And costing 10 dollars to continue shows the greed of the developers. Eliminate having to use dollars where they shouldnt be required. This is basically a low end version of Farmville.

first off: the ad for the game is NOTHING like the real game play. it's a farming game. 2nd: I actually enjoyed playing it for a few days but then things started getting boring. you have to wait a while for buildings to finish but when they are done you also have to fill a train with stuff to get the materials to finish your building.. which also takes a while AND you don't even get the materials you need. frustrating. 3rd: Piggy Bank is dumb. save up cash but then pay for it?

I use to like the game but everything has become an ongoing purchasing scheme (can't get anywhere without real cash). The crops now have to be paid for by coins, the items cost too much town dollars - rewards are minimal for the amount of effort and costs to play and there's even a forced piggy bank (that you CAN'T opt out of) you now have to pay 2.99 real cash to get your rewards out of, on top of everything else you need to pay real cash for. I'm deleting the app, I've been scammed enough.

I have been playing over 5 years. I loved it until recently. Variety of mini games (sheeplechase, gumball machine, snowboarding, etc) are gone. Just the same maze over & over. Too much energy required. No hope to get anywhere. The match games are impossible unless you purchase Tcash to purchase boosters. So many other changes that are bad. Do not recommend this game anymore.

I am finding it to be enjoyable only if I play it off and on throughout the day. Because I am not allowed to use " Real Money" in the game, I have to wait for things to happen. I wish that we could swap building materials with other players. I'll have seven buckets of paint but only one hammer, when I need four of them. I also Hate the Piggy Bank! I Need those dollars right then and there! Also wish the houses, buildings, etc. could rotate 4 sides, not just 2. Great Fun Otherwise!!

I love this app. it would be great if it turn night when it's night in real life, rain when it rains in real life. Etc... I spend a lot of money on this game and it would be more fun if it took less time to produce products. Also it will be more fun if the purchase of items were less expensive. Please take time to see what you can do to make this happen. if I lose my phone or break my phone and I need to re download plz make it easy to find my account. Like send me a link to my email with a code.

Good game, addictive. Just too hard to get supplies to complete buildings, make barn larger. Need to add a way to ask friends or something. The professors experiments are fun but they use the same minigames over & over & make some of the levels so hard you can't get past them w/out spending real $ on T cash. Also, he shows up too often. The 1st year I played he showed up a couple times. He lasts approx a month & when over he'll start again in something like 10-14 days.

Expensive game to play. The game is fun, but the game is designed so that players hit the pay wall quite fast if you want to expand and get to higher levels. For those earning in Dollars and Euros, the game could be affordable. But for most or the rest of the world, this game is expensive and you will need to spend real money quite frequently. You can't progress without having enough storage for your resources, so the game devs purposely put this as a bottleneck restrictor among other things.

I love the fact that I can play this game without having to spend a bunch of money. The ads are not running every two minutes, either. One suggestion... an item that allows you to destroy something in the queue, say, some doodad that costs $X township cash to get rid of some crisps in the queue because you need popcorn more urgently. But all in all, a great farming game. Also, the other players are helpful!

Had loved the game, I've been playing since it was new,, but the most recent update does not work with the regatta, it crashes the game everytime you try to tap on the dock... so I have put you at 1 star until you resolve this issue. My lady is having the same problem, we both use an Android platform with the Samsung a10e. Please fix soon, or at least compensate for the inconvenience.

I like the game but it seems like I can't get anywhere. I have done like 6 up grade's to the barn. It doesn't give very many more spaces. They need to add another building call it maintenance, construction, or builders shed. Something for the building materials cuz I think most farms have a different building for constantly materials then where they keep the animals feed. It would be great if that could be added soon.

Way too much energy used for navigating through the events! How could a huge pile of rocks take 8 energy but a small little tree needs 50?!? The game is very stingy with town cash, barn constantly full. Also, you should not have to keep using town cash just to open a chest. I don't mind spending some money (I have) to purchase things in your game but you make navigating through some of game impossible. It's frustrating because I really want to love your game!

barn is too small, annoying trying to figure out what to sell or set up to produce to make room to gather items for orders! Also, destroying beautiful natural areas complete with deer to make room for more houses and fastfood places didn't feel good! I know that happens often in real life and I don't like it there either! Lastly, I really felt bad about the poor production animals! uninstalled.

The game has nice graphics and is fun to play. It does have a few flaws, but overall, it's a very entertaining game that I used to enjoy playing. Now, it irritates me with the constant mini games that are just ploys to get you to spend money while I do still play daily. I play way less than I use to, and I no longer participate in any of the game events.

Game is very fun and involving to play, it's a great time eater. That being said I've noticed that the in game mini-games have gotten almost ludicrously hard to play. I understand that they need to make things challenging for everyone so that the game is entertaining. However, when I find myself unable to beat levels without having to pay in game money (majority of which you receive from buying with real money) it makes what was a fantastic game seem a little bit more like a cash grab.

Having problems with the game freezing ..ALOT please address this I love playing this game I had made it as high as level 58...but now I'm back at level 19 and I'm finding it seems to be much more difficult to complete certain task but I still love the game!!! If the "freezing of the game could be fixed I could and would rate this game 4.8 or higher!!!! Thanks so muck

It's an awesome enough game for a mobile phone. only thing i think that could use improvment is the fact that at least on my phone, a moto play, i can't split screen with a translation app and that makes it super difficult to communicate with folks who don't have english as their native language. if you guys were able to make that happen that would be super and I'd give you a better rating. thanks.

a good game but all of a sudden the mini games having a glitch. Last week am playing the magnate mini game, and i have one train to filled. When i filled with last item and to send it off, the game shuts down. Went back in, that same train cart is still empty. I had to wait for the mini game to end to send cart. As of today, i am having problem with entering the regatta. chose my task and now trying to enter back in the regatta the game shut off. Overall, it is a good game, but damn fix issue

Over the years the developers have turned this game from fun to a pure money grab for them. the recent changes for T cash have multiplied your earning by 25% but they changed the cost for items by 90% They say it's to make it more fun....lies lies. don't download or play.

I have been playing this game for 5 years... they have changed the entire game from what it used to be. The mini games went just adventure they had decorating, adventure, and a few others. To get energy for the games it's all match 3 now. It used to be a mix between match tiles (mahjong), match 3, and one other mini game. All of the options were a nice change not the same ole same ole every time. Now it's gets so boring it's like the same thing over & over. so sad....

The game cheats against you. When you are playing the game levels to earn rewards, the game will cheat you out to prevent you from winning. For example when you reach the levels with the bubbles that expand to nearby spots when you don't pop them in a previous move. They'll expand even when you do, especially when you're near winning. The helicopters will also not pop all the way if it means that move wins you that level. It also 'freezes' but then stops when you spend money.

"Why's there only one Hayday game", I hear you say, "Can't we have two?" ... Well sure we can, here you are: Township! But that in itself isn't a good reason for a low rating .. however, continuously advertising this game, as if it were an entirely different sort of game, is! After enjoying the 1-2 minutes trial gaming in the ads several times, I decided to press install, only to be presented with this Hayday clone. Disappointing.

Fun game, keeps your interest. However, they have this system where the more real cash you spend the more real cash you have to spend for the next packages. Started around $3, then the next week it was up to around 7, then 15, then $27! I stopped at $15. At that point there were no more "discounted" packages to buy because you dont even have the option to buy lower packages again. Kinda shady. But it backfires on them because I no longer want to spend money on it and its lost its allure.

The game is fun, but I have some problems. The "traps". For instance, with the restaurant serving mini game. I might move an item of food to one area, but the game will set it to be in another. And then, there's the instance where a customer outright said that her order was wrong when it wasn't. Wasted time. Another trap is the fact that you can't undo a move. If you accidentally start something in a factory, for example, it cannot be removed. More (possible) hours wasted waiting for it to pass.

Don't bother paying for the professor lab experiment events. They are no longer possible to be finished...if you have a job, or some other life. We actually did the math and it is almost impossible to finish unless you are glued your phone now. Used to be a fun event, no longer. I reached out to the devs but they basically said some aspects of the game are just harder... which is bs because they gave my friends a different response.

The game itself is fun, but the match-3 game that is quite a big part of the overall game is unreasonably difficult, bordering on impossible for certain levels without very good luck or using money for extra turns. I wonder why... And I would genuinely buy the 4.49 pass every 3 weeks if it weren't for this.

Constant and unnecessary time barriers prevent you from building most of the important buildings in your town, so most of your time is spent playing a terrible matching game that every three levels presents a "puzzle" that can't possibly be completed without spending lives and/or power ups constantly. Mobile games are always money sinks but this game does not hide the fact that it wants to soak every penny you have to even play the game at a basic level, let alone "get there faster". Garbage. F-

I have recently started a new town and it's horrible... Due to a bug we cannot ask for help in trains and planes so developing your town is nearly impossible. Also in order to send helicopter orders you HAVE to constantly play and win the mini game (which of cors means spending a lot of money). The algorythm for sending you building materials is also off so it keeps sending you the ones you don't need unless you sell them (?! ). This game keeps getting worse and worse with every update.

Uninstalling! It is a good game for someone with a lot of time and money. Play cash, which you earn and which you need to play the game, fills up in this piggy bank. You only have access to this 'Play Cash' if you purchase the piggy bank everytime it fills up and costs $2.99 to get access to it. I've paid it way to many times and I only had it one week!!

4 stars because I love the gaming experience. I don't mind paying real money but some prices are ridiculous. Some concerns: too many buildings and their cost, I don't want to share space in barn and materials between town and zoo, takes too long to complete buildings, little room when barn upgrades and unable to complete rooms. I love the professor's experiments, regattas, the mine, the farming aspects but the Rollercoaster game is a no as well as some others. Please review some of the events.

Updated review... I still MOSTLY enjoy the game. Still play everyday, for the last 4.5 years. Someday I want to quit, but being a Co-Op Leader, I don't want to disappoint the friends I've made in my group! So, that is the main thing that motivates me to play. But the Dev Team has certainly found ways to part you from your $$! And to enjoy the game, I've definitely spent WAY MORE THAN A HEALTHY AMOUNT! When you ask for Tech help, be prepared to wait 7-10 days for an answer that does no good!

What used to be a fun game is now all about developer greed. The game is no longer about building a town, it's about side games you can NOT win without spending real money. The side games are super boring and quickly escalate to difficult levels that are impossible to win without buying assists, and that translates to using your real cash. Long time players are leaving in droves. Worst of all, the developers don't seem to care. "Support" is all but non existent. Save the grief. Look elsewhere.

Boring. You have to wait too long for things to grow or be made because they want you to buy stuff. So it's only fun if you spend $$$. Plus the stupid matching game is not fun at all. They suck you in with ads about selling eggs using a tractor or whatever but then you get the stupid unwinnable matching game instead and the search for stuff game you can't play for more than 5 minutes without buying stuff. Frustrating, no fun, bait and switch game that is just trying to get $$ out of you

Just tried to download the update 4 times and no luck. Lost all my progress had to uninstall game. What a huge, huge disappointment. Please fix this. Ps. Allso took all my data in the process !!!!!! Not good. I just had 106 000 coins and now I have 557 coins. What the heck ???? Took long to make the 100 000 mark. Please fix this fast.. I'm on level 60 now. I'm not starting over again. 🤬🤬🤬

I've been playing for about 7 years and at first I was obsessed but lately I've been liking the game a lot less. there have been some graphics changes that I really don't care for but the biggest issue currently is the lack of variety in the mini game/events. there used to be a rotation of four or five every few weeks, now it's just a candy crush-style game to get energy points for a side story where you can win some prizes. it's lost its originality with the mini games.

Was my favorite game! Like Farmville but 100X better! Never glitches! I played everyday. I've been playing for over 7 years now. Every other level of jewel game is now hard or superhard. So I'm stuck most of the time and can't earn energy for the event. It's not fun being stuck most of the time and unable to participate in the event. So sadly, I'm uninstalling. Township I hope you fix this.

Been about a year and half loved game. Did not mind buying gold tickets and spending some cash to buy gren cash in game. But the last two times had extra event inside the game to get extras or new decos. First took a bit to come up and this time will not even show. Help desk doesn't care, trying to say that trying to cheat really. Don't get on. Don't not waste time and really don't waste money!!! And block you from events if think you're getting ahead to much .. really!!! Great real it is game.

Advertisements helped with coins and T cash, but the ads are now one a day...in other words, no money to buy. Not much of a game if I can't play. Everything cost too much to level up. Why must this game be like others...must pay/clear land with limited space. Free and clear land would help lots, especially given that I play solely to design town...making desire to play lacking. Wheating is useless for 1 coin per field per 2 mins, limited barn space and BORING.

Help/Support is very poor. Lost my town after buying a new computer and could not get any help to restore it. Only the bot in the game and it did nothing. I was at level 40 and wasted a lot of time trying to get it back. When you send in a form in the game you get an email requesting you go through the game for help. It is a loop of them doing nothing to help. Never heard from an actual live person.

Absolutely love this app. Very addictive. Lots of things to do. Build your town and farm, arrange them the way you want, grow food, feed your animals. Unlock more as you grow. Can't say enough about it. 💜💜💜💜💜 Edit :The only things I don't like about the game is how many materials you need to build something and how long it takes once you FINALLY get them. You can pay to play, but not everyone has that kind of money. Also don't like the updated zoo.

I give this game 3 stars only because of the longest production times ever. I dont get what is the negative implication to the developers if the times are reduced to minutes instead of hours. Everything else about this game is just awesome. Just sad that if you wanna succeed further and fast, you'd have to spend real cash, not to mention ultra expensive. Hoping for this to be looked into and changed.

Township is a pretty cute game, the only issue that I have with it are the Mini games like the flower shop they are referencing, the levels are super hard to beat and most of the time you end up losing and waiting on lives because they do not give you enough moves to to do what you need to do to progress with the mini game The only way to progress with these games is by paying actual money and that's kinda sad really.

Been playing over a year. It was fun but I did spend real cash for a while. I did advance quickly because I spent $$$. Now I'm through with it getting more and more nickel and diming for people who have supported you guys. As the song goes...."the thrill is gone!" No more $$$ for this game and agree with the reviews I read. I read a lot! The game isn't worth checking in most of the time. People read the reviews before wasting time and money. Original review I gave was 5 stars.

In-app purchase, or in-app extortion ? Asking users to pay for things to be used, or speeding up building activity is all ok, and also expected otherwise how will the game ever earn anything. But the concept of Piggy Bank which cannot be opened until you pay, is just plain extortion. If a user is ok to play slowly, and just wants to enjoy the game once in a day, please let them do so. You cannot force payments.

Hi, This game is good. But I'm very disappointed because of your team support. My friend lost his town and asked help to your customer care and they asked details to backup the game progress. And asked friend invite code. We send the invite code and all other details. And they dumped my town progress to his device. At a time we can't play together. As that device is having my account. So I'm going to uninstall this game. Very bad experience.

This game has turned into a money grab. The mini games go on forever and are impossible to finish. All of them are boring minus the match game which, you sneeze and it's over, and you are back to the cash grab again. There are no more cute decorations to purchase during a seasonal event, now you must use real money which I refuse to do. I find myself playing it...never.

I've been playing this game over 5 years and have spent too much actual money on this game. Recently they removed items and rewards from the Golden ticket that were uncollectible that were paid for rewards. They wouldn't give any compensation. That is a scam!! This game has gone down the toilet, they don't even supply new decorations anymore. I didn't start playing this game because of match 3, which the game has turned into. It's pretty boring now. Don't recommend.

Addictive game. I especially enjoy the mini games and events that make waiting for the builds in the main game so much more tolerable. Than being said there always seems to be a glitch in the monthly events, it's mini game and rewarding. In particular the mini game involving matching and using tickets, 'garden in the sky. Last month I never received the gift after completing the full scene. This time there is a level with a popcorn machine that when it to detonate, crashes the whole game!

Update: I'm not having as many things disappear as earlier, but things still go missing now and then. I enjoy playing most of the time. 1 top suggestion I have to give is separate the building supplies into their own storage barn. I spend too much time trying to find room in my barn for the production products. I am from a farming/ranching background and also a business history, this game makes a mockery of our livelihoods. It would be much more enjoyable if it resembled that industry more

So much better than the old addictive Farm game. More options, lots of extras, just better game play and cute graphics. Oh and your crops don't die if you dont play daily! There is strategy to this game but anyone can play. You play at your own pace and don't get penalised. If you want to play competitively the challenges are available. You can spend money on the game but it's not forced or necessary. Yes, there are ads to keep it free but they are minimal. A+ to the developers!

It's a cool game with lots of events, but it is innately bad since it doesn't scale: the longer you play, the longer the game takes time to produce something. First crops/production take 2 minutes, then some of them take 4 hours, then 12, then 24, etc. There are some mechanics to shorten this time required, but it really is insignificant (around 5%). And there is no way to automate production, so it becomes really bothersome to control everything.

I have been absolutely loving this game up u til yesterday when they've changed how the township cash is earned and spent. I hate it and it's becoming impossible to do things without spending real money to get enough township cash to have. Please put it back how it was. It's spoilt the game

the pricing in the game now is absurdly expensive, I'm on a really good team for the regatta and now I cannot afford to contribute like I normally do because the valuation of the dollar in the game changed so significantly I will spend less with this game now, period

I loved this game. Played it all the time. But it's getting worse. It always needs a new update. It won't let me update later. It also needs more space to update. So I'm constantly uninstall and reinstall which is very annoying. The good side is the game along with the side games are fun. The regatta set up is really cool. It's interesting to interact with people from all over the world in the regattas. Making new friends while playing an addicting game. It's good addicting though.

No longer fun. This game is extremely engaging, and I've spent around $4 of real money to keep progressing with Township Cash. Suddenly, it's costing 50, 60 dollars in Township cash to continue opening buildings, which is like $2 of REAL money. I'll pass. It's not that I don't have $2, it's just the principle of it all. Before I know it, $2 will turn into $200, and I have bills to pay. This is likely one of those games that'll fade into the background for me - it was fun for about 3 days.

So far, interesting enough game. If you like toiling a few minutes here and there developing your own town. I agree with others, gaining materials takes a long time, if you aren't willing to spend real money. This actual game you download is nothing like the fun, high pressure ads we see all the time. Which is why I downloaded it in the first place. I would really appreciate if the game was more like the ads or at least had more of those legendary mini puzzles of read in other reviews....

I like the upgrade. Everything looks great. I love the game. Also, the ZOO button would be handy next to the plane, train, and helicopter buttons on the bottom.

Love it!!! I need to make an update to my review. they lost my town. guess they erased it for inactivity because I stop playing due to health issues. My co-op and I really enjoy this game, we are experiencing some problems that need to corrected.When my team members go to harvest their rubber trees,the trees dissappear after they pick them, it's as if they were never planted.Sometimes while at the train station the game will exit on it's own, when you go back the train that was just sent is back but with different goods and the good sent prior are not in the barn, also while doing a task for the regatta, a task was failed that had 20 hrs left.

Was fun at first but they made the game nearly impossible to play and enjoy without shelling out real money after level 20. It's impossible to expand your land or complete all the orders needed to progress without spending money or waiting for a very long time to obtain the needed materials. I went from playing daily and really enjoying the game to almost never opening the app because it's just a chore now.

This game is a good time waster. Some the Regattas are quite annoying at times because you have more than one task to complete before you can advance to reach one shovel or something not really worth all the work. You're waiting for the train in hopes to get materials to expand and they keep delivering bs you can use later but dont need at the time. There's other things the developers can add or subtract. But after all I play every day lol.

If you're thinking about getting this game because of the ads you saw: DON'T! It is nothing like them. Which is a shame because my friends and I agree that those little puzzle games would be amazing. If you got addicted to FarmVille back in the day, then this game is probably for you. It is a fun casual game, no need to spend any money. Just close the game and come back to it during your next coffee break. It even includes short demo versions of other popular games as events. Fun game, ads lie

I have been playing this game for a long time. I was playing the 1,000 grand prize competition that just started. Got off the game for a few hours, got back on and the competition was gone. It was supposed to last 3 days. Not 10 hours. And I've had coins disappear. Buildings disappear. And pretty much every problem you can think of. I've contacted support several times. They tell me my game is possibly not updated. But the game wont let you play without the latest version.

I've had this game a long time. It's the only game I've ever spent money on. It used to be fun with all the mini side games we got, but now they're money hungry. Repeating the same 3 mini games for almost 2 years now. They don't listen to their customer base at all. It used to cost 5 tc to keep playing, now it's 10. The pirate game? 45 tc to keep playing.
